agents in Shanghai.

The "Evening Post" dispatches correspondets to this ar-
my to take interviews. Chinese journalists of communist leanings
go there together with foreign journalists,deliver speeches,bring
back photographs and praise throughout the world the heroic deeds
of guerillas,who kill the Japanese by attacking them from behind.

Just try to tell them that they are causing much harm
by embittering the relations between foreign powers and Japan.
They will be suprised at you,as their American or British pas-
ports guarantee their safety. As to their souls - they have been
bought by Mr. Kaganovich ( Stalin's right hand man ).

Let us have a close look at those who are engaged in
the conducting of anti-Japanese propaganda:-

Our common friend, J.B. Powell of the "China Weekly"
is an American Jew.

Emilie Ham of the "Candid Comment" is an American Jewess.

In the "China Press" there are lots of Jews,including the
son of Leonoff,well known Soviet citizen in Paris, and Ginsburg,
a Russian Jew,speaking only English.

In the "North China Daily News", apart from the owners,
we see two prominent Jewish journalists.

The entire staff of the "Evening Post",including Bruss,
are Jews.

The "China Journal" with the famous Bruno Crooker - are
all Jews.

And all these people ,such as Mills, Batti and and other
crowd of journalists bought over by the Comintern daily carry on
anti-Japanese propaganda in the press,through news agencies and
radio broadcasting stations. This is both fashionable now and in
accordance with orders from the Comintern.

The war between China and Japan is an affair concerning
these two countries. What have all these gentlemen to do with it?
Anyone may,of course, sympathize with the people of
China, but these sympathies may be expressed in London or Moscow,
if Stalin or Chamberlain wish. We are of the opinion, that it is

在上海的代理人。

《晚邮报》（Evening Post）派遣记者前往该部队进行采访。具有共产主义倾向的中国记者与外国记者一同前往那里，发表演讲，带回照片，并在世界各地赞扬游击队的英雄事迹，这些游击队通过从背后袭击来杀伤日本人。

你只需告诉他们，他们加剧了列强与日本之间的紧张关系，造成了极大的危害。他们会对你感到惊讶，因为他们的美国或英国护照保障了他们的安全。至于他们的灵魂——它们已被卡冈诺维奇先生（斯大林的右臂）所收买。

让我们仔细看看那些从事反日宣传的人：

我们共同的朋友，《中国周刊》（China Weekly）的 J.B. 鲍威尔（J.B. Powell）是一名美国犹太人。

《坦率评论》（Candid Comment）的埃米莉·哈姆（Emilie Ham）是一名美国犹太女性。

在《大美晚报》（China Press）中有许多犹太人，包括列昂诺夫（Leonoff，巴黎知名的苏联公民）的儿子，以及只说英语的俄罗斯犹太人金斯伯格（Ginsburg）。

在《字林西报》（North China Daily News）中，除了业主外，我们还看到两位杰出的犹太记者。

《晚邮报》（Evening Post）的全体员工，包括布鲁斯（Bruss），都是犹太人。

拥有著名人物布鲁诺·克鲁克（Bruno Crooker）的《中国杂志》（China Journal）——全是犹太人。

而所有这些人，如米尔斯（Mills）、巴蒂（Batti）以及其他被共产国际收买的记者群，每天都在报刊、通讯社和广播电台进行反日宣传。这既符合当下的时尚，也符合共产国际的命令。

中日战争是这两个国家之间的事务。这些绅士们与此有何相干？当然，任何人都可以同情中国人民，但如果斯大林或张伯伦愿意，这些同情可以在伦敦或莫斯科表达。我们认为，

extremely dangerous to express these sympathies in such an in-
solent manner here,in the zone occupied by the Japanese Army

A prominent Japanese is reported to have said that

flict may be repeated in Shanghai."
Does the communist party exist in China? - Yes.
Has any Chinese communist agent or any secret communist
base been discovered? - No.
But in 1927,when the situation here was less favourable
than now, the Municipal Police cleared the Settlement of all com-
munist elements,including foreign agents of Moscow.
Foreigners refuse to understand that the process of So-

the peace has been restored in this country, the combined efforts
of all powers will be required in order to exterminate the commu-
nist elements."
There follow a few remarks tending to illustrate the trea-
cherous policy of Moscow communists in China who pretend being
friendly towards foreign powers and at the same time conduct ac-
tive propaganda against all capitalistic countries.
" Having established the fact that no one in Shanghai in-

have become so insolent that they have turned their attention to
the propaganda amongst foreign soldiers and sailors, as was re-
ported by the "Shanghai Times" of June 21.
Communists have seized Shanghai, The British and French
protect them. The Kuomintang cooperate with them. Japan struggles
against them. Some sort of compromise must be reached for the

first place by those who regard the communists as their friends,
and the Japanese - as their enemies and aggressors.".

在此地，在日本陆海军占领区，以如此傲慢的方式表达这些同情是极其危险的。
据报道，一位显赫的日本人曾说：“这些人迟早会被封住嘴巴，因为天津的冲突可能会在上海重演。”
中国共产党在中国存在吗？——是的。
是否发现了任何中国共产党员特工或任何秘密共产主义基地？——没有。
但在1927年，当时这里的局势比现在更不利，工部局警务处清除了租界内的所有共产主义分子，包括莫斯科的外国特工。
外国人拒绝理解，中国的苏维埃化进程正在全面展开，共产党人已在中国巩固到如此程度，以至于在这个国家恢复和平之后，需要所有列强的共同努力才能消灭共产主义分子。”
接下来是一些旨在说明莫斯科共产党人在中国奸诈政策的评论，他们假装对外国势力友好，同时积极对所有资本主义国家进行宣传。
“既然确定了在上海无人干涉反日宣传，共产国际的特工变得如此傲慢，以至于他们将注意力转向了在外籍士兵和水手中的宣传，正如6月21日的《上海泰晤士报》（Shanghai Times）所报道的那样。
共产党人占据了上海，英国人和法国人保护他们。国民党与他们合作。日本人与他们斗争。为了民众的利益，必须达成某种妥协。这种妥协的主要要点必须是消除共产国际在这个巨大城市中的影响。这一公理首先必须被那些视共产党人为朋友、视日本人为敌人和侵略者的人铭记于心。”。

1. Article entitled " Greetings to Tientsin!"

The taking over by the Russian Anti-Communist Com-
mittee in North-China of the building which in the good old
time was occupied by Russian Consulate-General is an outstand-
ing event in the history of Russian emigrants. This building
in which at one time a centre of the communist infection had
been located, was vacant, for representatives of the Comintern
government prefer, as they do in Shanghai, to live under the
protection of the democratic authorities of foreign concessions

It is a victory. It is a result of the concentration
of willpower so characteristic of Russian emigrants in Manchou-
kuo and North China at present, their efforts directed towards
one goal - the salvation of Russia, her revival; towards de-
ciding victory over the evil of communism.

We convey our greetings to Russian emigrants in North
China on the occasion of this victory. We admire the efforts
they are making for the Russian cause. We also are grateful to
those who render assistance to this cause, to those who give
to Russian emigrants the possibility of standing firmly on
their own legs and consolidating themselves on certain sec-
tions of the anti-communist front.

The news of the occupation of the building which be-
longs to Russia and not to the USSR was received with satis-
faction on the anti-communist front. German newspaper "Hamburg
er Tageblatt" approves this action of Russian anti-communists
and expresses the hope that the time is not far away when Rus-
sian three-coloured flag will be hoisted over the property of
Russian people in all places where Russian emigrants reside.

All of us, whose sole aim in life is struggle against
communism, have in this hope the stimulus to live. It consti-
tutes the main emotion in our existence.

（批：E.）

1. 题为《向天津致敬！》的文章

华北俄罗斯反共委员会接管了在美好旧时代由俄罗斯总领事馆占据的大楼，这是俄罗斯移民历史上的一件突出事件。这座曾经作为共产主义感染中心的大楼一直空置，因为共产国际政府的代表们，如同在上海一样，更喜欢生活在外国租界民主当局的保护之下。

这是一场胜利。这是目前满洲国和华北俄罗斯移民特有的意志力集中的结果，他们的努力指向一个目标——拯救俄罗斯，使其复兴；致力于决定性地战胜共产主义之恶。

我们就此胜利向华北的俄罗斯移民致以问候。我们钦佩他们为俄罗斯事业所做的努力。我们也感谢那些协助这一事业的人，感谢那些使俄罗斯移民能够自立并在反共战线的某些部门巩固自身地位的人。

占领属于俄罗斯而非苏联的大楼的消息在反共战线上受到了满意地欢迎。德国报纸《汉堡日报》（Hamburger Tageblatt）批准了俄罗斯反共分子的这一行动，并表示希望在不远的将来，俄罗斯三色旗将在所有俄罗斯移民居住地的俄罗斯人民财产上升起。

我们所有这些生活中唯一目标是与共产主义作斗争的人，在这一希望中获得了生活的动力。它构成了我们存在中的主要情感。

2. Article entitled " On the eve of establishment of new or-
der in Asia".

After a brief review of foreign press comments on
the situation in Kulangsu and Tientsin, the "Russian Voice" en-
dorses the opinion that only war can discharge the atmosphere:-
" Yes, only war! We are firmly convinced of this
and we know that during the whole existence of Japan no war
was as popular as would be a war against Britain.
" One is astonished at the inability of the British
and French to understand the true state of affairs. Perhaps,
they pretend not to understand?
" It is not for the interests of Great Britain and
that blood is being shed here. It is being shed in the inte-
rests of new China and peoples of Asia, who are masters of the
situation on the Asiatic continent.
" No one is going to drive away the British and
French. They are guests and traders in Asia in the same way as
are other peoples of Europe and America. But it is high time
to deprive them of the possibility of utilising China and Asia
for their own political and economic ends. China is not a Bri-
tish colony. It is a sovereign, independent state, which has
been converted by the British and French into their colony. The
necessity of abandoning this attitude has been discussed for a
long time, but the British are literally laughing at the de-
mands of Japanese representatives and have adopted an arrogant
attitude.
" It appears from the statement made two days ago
by General Itagaki, Minister of War in Japan, that from now on
there will be no further demands. The time has come for action.
" New China and new Asia are being born amidst suf-

这一希望应将我们在反共战线上统一为一个强大且有权威的团体。
我们敦促所有俄罗斯人团结他们的力量。

2. 题为《亚洲新秩序建立前夕》的文章。

在简要回顾了外国媒体对鼓浪屿和天津局势的评论后，《俄国之声》赞同只有战争才能净化气氛的观点：
“是的，只有战争！我们对此深信不疑，并且我们知道，在日本存在的整个历史中，没有任何一场战争像对英战争那样受欢迎。
“人们对英法两国无法理解真实事态感到惊讶。也许，他们是假装不理解？
“这里流血并非为了大不列颠的利益。这是为了新中国和亚洲人民的利益而流的血，他们是亚洲大陆局势的主宰。
“没有人要赶走英国人和法国人。他们在亚洲是客人和商人，就像欧洲和美洲的其他民族一样。但是，是时候剥夺他们利用中国和亚洲为其政治和经济目的服务的可能性了。中国不是英国的殖民地。它是一个主权独立的国家，却被英国和法国变成了他们的殖民地。放弃这种态度的必要性已讨论了很长时间，但英国人简直是在嘲笑日本代表的要求，并采取了傲慢的态度。
“从日本陆军大臣板垣将军两天前发表的声明来看，从现在起将不再有进一步的要求。行动的时刻已经到来。
“新中国和新亚洲正在苦难、

White Russians Seize
Tientsin Consulate

Tientsin, June 10.
Staging a dramatic coup, re-
presentatives of the White
Russians' Anti-Comintern Com-
mittee here occupied the former
Soviet Consulate today, hauled
down the red flag on its roof
and hoisted a tri-coloured
emblem in its stead. Situated
in the Third Special District,
the former Soviet Consulate
has been unoccupied since the
evacuation of its staff and only
the red flag has remained.
After occupying the building
the committee issued the fol-
lowing statement:
"Churches and other build-
ings in the Third Special Dis-
trict of Tientsin have been
handed down from the days of
the Czarist régime, and we
white Russians have the right
to take possession of them. As
for the Consulate we have
occupied, it has been unused
for the past two years. In view
of the report that the Soviet
Union is going secretly to send
Communist agents into Tien-
tsin and use or sell the Con-
sulate building, we intend to
keep it in our possession until
the birth of a genuine Russian
regime."

1. Article entitled " For information of Russian community in
Shanghai ".

During the past week registration forms of the
so-called "Anti-Communist Union in Shanghai" were distributed
amongst local Russian residents with the request to fill them
in and return to Mr. M.N. TRETIAKOFF, Chairman of the Union,
94 Wayside Road. Persons distributing these forms stated that
the registration was compulsory and was carried out by order of
the Japanese authorities.

Following immediately the registration of Rus-
sian emigrants carried out by the Shanghai City Government this
new registration aroused much comment and doubts in the local
Russian community.

According to information from responsible Japa-
nese circles, the Japanese authorities did not issue any in-
structions regarding new registration of Russian emigrants with
the Anti-Communist Union of Mr. M.N.Tretiakoff. The said or-
ganisation and registration, it was stated, are Mr. Tretiakoff's
personal affairs and have nothing whatever to do with the local
Japanese authorities.

As before, the Russian Emigrants' Committee head-
ed by Mr. Ch.M. Metzler, Representative of Russian Community in
Shanghai, and Colonel N.K. Serejnikoff, his representative in the
Japanese controlled area of Shanghai ( office at 211 Yangtse-
poo Road ) are recognized as official organs of the Russian emi-
grant community in Shanghai.

Registration certificates and passports can be
obtained only through the medium of one of these institutions
which at present deal with all affairs relating to Russian emi-
grants in Shanghai.

1. 题为《供上海俄罗斯社区参考》的文章。

在过去的一周里，所谓的“上海反共联盟”的登记表在当地俄罗斯居民中分发，并要求填写后归还给联盟主席 M.N. 特里亚科夫（M.N. TRETIAKOFF）先生，地址：威赛德路（Wayside Road）94号。分发这些表格的人声称，登记是强制性的，是根据日本当局的命令进行的。

紧随上海市政府进行的俄罗斯移民登记之后，这次新的登记在当地俄罗斯社区引起了诸多议论和怀疑。

据日本负责方面人士提供的信息，日本当局并未就 M.N. 特里亚科夫先生的反共联盟进行俄罗斯移民新登记发出任何指示。据说，该组织和登记纯属特里亚科夫先生的个人事务，与当地日本当局毫无关系。

此前，由上海俄罗斯社区代表 Ch.M. 梅茨勒（Ch.M. Metzler）先生及其在上海日控区的代表 N.K. 谢列日尼科夫（N.K. Serejnikoff）上校（办公室位于杨树浦路211号）领导的俄罗斯移民委员会，被承认为上海俄罗斯移民社区的官方机构。

登记证书和护照只能通过上述机构之一办理，这些机构目前处理与上海俄罗斯移民有关的所有事务。

Thus, the fact of distribution of these registration
forms is another indication of the wish of certain irrespon-
sible persons and groups to establish their authority in an ar-
bitrary manner.

The article concludes with a series of sharp remarks
regarding attempts on the part of various incompetent persons
to imitate the activities of Russian anti-communist organiza-
tions in Harbin and Tientsin.

2. Article entitled" A new wave of red terrorism directed
against White Russians".

Contains a comment on the attack on N.I. KORGANOFF
which took place during the evening of May 8,1939 in Rue Paul
Henry when knife wounds were inflicted on him by two unidenti-
fied individuals. The article points out that this is a second
attack on Korganoff, the first one having taken place in 1934
also in the French Concession, when he was engaged in a cam-
paign advocating boycott of Soviet goods.

.." The following instances of terrorism directed
against Russian emigrants should be noted:-

The kidnapping and subsequent deportation to the
U.S.S.R. of DAVIDOFF, an engineer, who escaped from the s.s.
"Sever". He was seized on a street, taken to the Soviet consu-
late. Later he was taken to Woosung in a Soviet owned car and
placed aboard a ship bound for Vladivostok.

Two attempts on the life of a prominent anti-commu-
nist which took place in the French Concession in 1938,when
a bomb was thrown in the window of his room,but failed to ex-
plode. Despite a number of clues this case remains undetected.

The case of D.I.GOSTEFF, who was arrested at night
time and subsequently handed over to the Chinese authorities
still remains obscure. The Soviet influence and participation
is evident in this affair."

..." We are interested to know why the French Police
do not take any action in connection with these attempts (on
Korganoff)."

因此，分发这些登记表的事实，再次表明某些不负责任的个人和团体企图以专断的方式建立其权威。

该文结尾处发表了一系列尖锐评论，针对各类无能之辈试图模仿哈尔滨和天津的俄国反共组织活动的行径。

2. 标题为“针对白俄的红色恐怖新浪潮”的文章。

文中评论了1939年5月8日晚在亨利路（Rue Paul Henry）发生的袭击N.I. KORGANOFF事件，当时两名身份不明者持刀将其刺伤。文章指出，这是针对科尔加诺夫（Korganoff）的第二次袭击，第一次发生在1934年，同样是在法租界，当时他正从事倡导抵制苏联货物的运动。

..“以下针对俄国移民的恐怖主义案例值得注意：-

工程师DAVIDOFF被绑架并随后被驱逐至苏联，他曾从“谢韦尔”号（s.s. "Sever"）轮船逃脱。他在街上被劫持，带往苏联领事馆。后来他被用一辆苏联所有的汽车带往吴淞，并被送上一艘驶往符拉迪沃斯托克（海参崴）的船只。

1938年在法租界发生两起针对一位著名反共人士的未遂暗杀事件，当时有人向其房间窗户投掷炸弹，但炸弹未爆炸。尽管有许多线索，此案至今仍未侦破。

D.I. GOSTEFF一案，他在夜间被捕，随后被移交给中国当局，此事至今仍不明朗。在此事件中，苏联的影响和参与显而易见。”

...”我们很想知道，为何法国警方不对这些（针对科尔加诺夫的）袭击采取任何行动。”

WITH A FEELING OF ADMIRATION WE WATCH THE VICTORIES OF

WE FIRMLY BELIEVE THAT IF THE WAR OF 1914 RESULTED IN THE

E.
IN MISFORTUNE ONE FINDS OUT ONE'S FRIENDS. THE RUSSIAN

H.
AND, OF COURSE, THOSE WHO INTEND ONCE MORE TO SAVE THEMSELVES

The British conservatives leave no stone un-
turned in order to secure moral and military support of the

Moscow welcomes this idea. Of course, it is not

1939年4月16日。由杨树浦路21B号俄罗斯出版公司出版。责任编辑 - A. A. Antonoff（A. A. Pourin）。

1. 头版标题。

我们怀着钦佩之情注视着组成反共产国际集团的各国人民取得的胜利。

我们怀着恼怒之情阅读到英国和法国在共产党人的协助下利用俄国人民来维护这些国家利益的努力。

共产党人欢迎与英国和法国达成协议，因为他们从中看到了自身的救赎。

但是，与共产党政府达成协议并不意味着与俄国人民达成协议。

我们坚信，如果说1914年的战争导致俄国人民被奴役，那么即将到来的战争将使他们从共产主义的枷锁中解放出来。

E.
患难见真情。俄国人民在漫长的苦难岁月中已经认清了谁是他们的朋友，谁是他们的敌人。

H.
当然，那些打算再次躲在俄国人民宽厚背影后以求自保的人，不能被称为他们的朋友。

S.V.C.
此外，这次这种伎俩不会得逞。

2. 社论摘要译文。

英国保守党人不遗余力，以便在这个对英国极其困难的时刻获得苏联的道义和军事支持。英国政治领导人努力说服每个人相信，一旦能够促使共产主义俄罗斯与赢得上次欧洲战争的列强携手合作，“极权主义国家”的“侵略”就会终结。

莫斯科欢迎这一想法。当然，这并不是因为莫斯科的共产党人非常担心英国和法国如今的遭遇，而是因为他们从中看到了利于自身的机会。但是，当然，共产党人没有忘记，援助英国和法国的问题是一个非常难以解决的问题。

to the Comintern.

The powers comprising the anti-Comintern group are faced with two problems, a favourable solution of which will give them all they require. In the first place, they must satisfy the needs of their respective countries and, in the second place, they wish to establish an order in the world, which would be immune against attempts of any international forces to disturb it. In the pursuance of their first aim Germany and Italy have taken certain actions, which affect the interests of Great Britain and France and will finally result in a breakdown of the power of these countries, which is based on their colonial policy. Complete solution of the first aim will reduce the influence exercised by Great Britain and France in the world affairs.

In one word, a struggle to the bitter end is beginning. The classic phrase " to be or not to be" acquires now a tremendous importance for the country in which it originated.

In her endeavours to save the situation Great Britain regards with hope the Red Moscow. Chamberlain, Lloyd George and Churchill are not slow in making advances to the Red Capital.

In an article which appeared in the "Daily Telegraph and Morning Post" Churchill writes:-

" We are perhaps not in a position to form an accurate conception of the real strength of the Soviet Union, but of one thing there is no doubt whatever: the U.S.S.R. firmly carries out a policy directed towards the maintenance of peace"..

In a way Churchill is right. The U.S.S.R. undoubtedly carries out a peaceful policy, because a war will inevitably wipe out the U.S.S.R. and restore Russia. Communists have always been afraid of a war between peoples and have always preferred to provoke civil war in all countries and are past masters in this latter art. In the present desire of the U.S.S.R. to join the " anti-aggression" group of powers we perceive the desire of the Soviet communists to conceal their true aims by

致共产国际。

组成反共产国际集团的列强面临两个问题，有利地解决这些问题将满足他们的一切需求。首先，他们必须满足各自国家的需求；其次，他们希望建立一种世界秩序，使其免受任何国际力量扰乱它的企图。为了实现第一个目标，德国和意大利采取了一些行动，这些行动影响了英国和法国的利益，并最终将导致这些基于殖民政策的国家实力的崩溃。彻底实现第一个目标将削弱英国和法国在世界事务中的影响力。

简言之，一场殊死斗争即将开始。“生存还是毁灭”这句经典名言对于其起源国现在具有巨大的重要性。

英国在努力挽救局势时，寄希望于红色莫斯科。张伯伦、劳合·乔治和丘吉尔不失时机地向红色首都示好。

在《每日电讯报暨晨邮报》（Daily Telegraph and Morning Post）发表的一篇文章中，丘吉尔写道：-

“我们或许无法准确构想苏联的真实实力，但有一点毫无疑问：苏联坚定地执行着旨在维持和平的政策”..

从某种意义上说，丘吉尔是对的。苏联无疑执行着和平政策，因为战争将不可避免地抹去苏联并恢复俄罗斯。共产党人一直害怕人民之间的战争，并且一直倾向于在所有国家挑起内战，他们是后者这门艺术的大师。在苏联目前希望加入“反侵略”列强集团的愿望中，我们察觉到苏联共产党人试图通过

Great Britain and France . And if, contrary to all expectations,
this moral pressure on Germany and Italy achieves the result de-
sired and succeeds in averting the war, the Red Moscow and the
Comintern will then have the field cleared for their subversive
activities throughout the world. This axiom should be borne in
mind. The anti-Comintern group of powers is a real menace to
communism. Sooner or later they will bring about its destruction.
The present events in Europe accelerate the coming of the con-
flict between this group and the Comintern. Germany and Italy
who consolidated their power in the process of struggle for their
respective nations, know the real value of the "strength" of the
U.S.S.R. too well to allow themselves to be influenced by the
"psychologic" pressure on the part of the "anti-aggression" group
of powers. They understand perfectly well that, if the Red Moscow
did not lift one finger in order to save Czechoslovakia - her
out-post in Europe- and demonstrated the futility of her efforts
to win the struggle in Spain, it is highly unlikely that she will
defend the interests of Great Britain, a country which prefers to
beat the bush while somebody else catches the hare. Diplomatical-
ly, the U.S.S.R. will do everything in her power in order to as-
sist in this intimidation campaign- it is both profitable and
safe. But it will not be possible to intimidate Hitler and Musso-
lini, as they are true leaders of their respective peoples and
real dictators in Europe.

Latest reports indicate that an agreement between Lon-
don and Moscow is almost an accomplished fact. The worse for
London. At present moment it only means pouring oil into the
fire.

英国和法国来掩盖其真实目标。而且，如果出乎所有意料，这种对德国和意大利的道义压力取得了预期的结果并成功避免了战争，那么红色莫斯科和共产国际将在全球范围内为其颠覆活动扫清障碍。这一公理应被铭记。反共产国际列强集团是共产主义的真正威胁。他们迟早会导致其毁灭。欧洲目前的局势加速了这一集团与共产国际之间冲突的到来。德国和意大利在为各自民族争取权力的斗争过程中巩固了其统治，他们太清楚苏联“实力”的真实价值，以至于不会让自己受到“反侵略”列强集团的“心理”压力的影响。他们完全明白，如果红色莫斯科连一根手指都不动去拯救其在欧洲的前哨——捷克斯洛伐克，并证明了其在西班牙赢得斗争的努力是徒劳的，那么她极不可能去捍卫英国的利益，英国是一个喜欢让别人去抓兔子而自己只负责敲草丛的国家。在外交上，苏联将尽其所能协助这场恐吓运动——这既有利可图又安全。但是，希特勒和墨索里尼是无法被恐吓的，因为他们是各自人民的真正领袖，也是欧洲真正的独裁者。

最新报道表明，伦敦和莫斯科之间的协议几乎已成定局。这对伦敦来说更糟。目前这仅仅意味着火上浇油。

Subject: Articles in the "Russian Voice" of 5-3-39 indicating possibility of
changes affecting Russian community in Shanghai - further report.
Made by... D.S.I. Prokofiev Forwarded by C. Clauson S.I

With reference to the arrival in Shanghai from
Tientsin of Mr. A.D. KOSMIN, ex-General of the Russian army,
(vide report dated 9-3-39) it is reported that the object
of his coming here is to make a study of the situation in
the local Russian community. It is also reported that this
task has been undertaken by him on behalf of Major TAKI, of
the Japanese Military Headquarters in North China. Major
Taki is known to have played an active part in the estab-
lishment of the "Anti-Communist Committee of Russian Emi-
grants in North China", which organization has now branches
in Peiping, Tsingtao and Chefoo. In connection with the
first anniversary of the Tsingtao branch of the said commit-
tee Major Taki and Mr. E.N. PASTUHIN, head of the Anti-Com-
munist Committee in Tientsin, are expected to arrive in Tsin-
gtao on or about 27-3-39 and are likely to pay a visit to
Shanghai. Hence a wave of excitement amongst members of
the Russian political group represented by the newspaper
"Russian Voice".

Enquiries from usually well informed sources show
that whatever power he may have in the administration of
Russian emigrants in North China, Major Taki cannot play a
similar part in the affairs of Russian emigrants in Shang-
hai. Moreover, it is reported that responsible Japanese
circles are not at all satisfied with the state of affairs
in the Russian emigrant communities in Manchuria and North
China. Therefore, it is believed that a general revision
of the "Russian question" is likely in the near future.

D. C. (Special Branch)
A. Prokofiev
D.S.I.

主题：关于3月5日《俄罗斯之声》文章显示可能影响上海俄国侨民社区的变化 - 后续报告。
制作人... D.S.I. Prokofiev 转呈人 C. Clauson S.I

关于前俄国陆军将军A.D. KOSMIN先生从天津抵达上海一事（参见1939年3月9日的报告），据报他此行的目的是研究当地俄国侨民社区的局势。另据报道，他是代表日本华北军司令部的高木（TAKI）少校承担此项任务。众所周知，高木少校在建立“华北俄国移民反共委员会”方面发挥了积极作用，该组织目前在北京、青岛和烟台设有分支机构。鉴于该委员会青岛分部成立一周年之际，预计高木少校和天津反共委员会负责人E.N. PASTUHIN先生将于1939年3月27日左右抵达青岛，并可能访问上海。因此，在由报纸《俄罗斯之声》所代表的俄国政治团体成员中引起了一阵兴奋。

向通常消息灵通的来源查询显示，无论高木少校在管理华北俄国移民方面拥有何种权力，他都无法在上海俄国移民事务中发挥类似作用。此外，据报日本负责圈子对满洲和华北俄国移民社区的现状并不满意。因此，人们认为在不久的将来可能会对“俄国问题”进行全面修订。

1. LEADING ARTICLE ENTITLED "LESSONS FOR RUSSIAN EMIGRANTS"

Following a short comment on the successes of the
national movements in Germany and Italy and on Japan's
struggle against the communist influence in the Far East,
the article stresses the necessity for Russian emigrants
to form a United National Front.

"The idea of creating a Russian National Front is
the only idea capable of organizing Russian emigrants into
one monolith, without which they can do nothing. To carry
this idea into effect is the task of the day, the first
real task with which we are confronted after all the years
of exile.

Russian emigrants in Shanghai have to begin this
work from the very beginning. They must create conditions
similar to those which exist in Manchukuo and North China.
Russian emigrants in Shanghai must create an administrative-
political organ whose authority would be binding for all.
Only after they have accomplished this task can Russian
emigrants in Shanghai, as well as those in North China,
participate on principles of equality in the work of the
organized units of emigrants in the formation of a United
Front against Communism.

In this organization work we must fully utilize
the experiences of our brethren in Harbin and Tientsin.
Moreover, we must readily and gratefully accept their
assistance as well. For the sake of the common cause,
all petty ambitions, all considerations of a personal
character must be done away with, once and for all.

Assistance from Harbin and Tientsin must be
accepted also because all political elements from

.........

1. 题为“给俄国移民的教训”的社论

在对德国和意大利民族运动的成功以及日本在远东对抗共产主义影响的斗争进行简短评论后，文章强调了俄国移民组建统一民族阵线的必要性。

“创建俄国民族阵线的想法是唯一能够将俄国移民组织成一个坚如磐石的整体的想法，没有这个整体他们将一事无成。实施这一想法是当务之急，是我们流亡多年后面临的第一个真正任务。

上海的俄国移民必须从头开始这项工作。他们必须创造类似于满洲国和华北存在的条件。上海的俄国移民必须建立一个行政-政治机构，其权威对所有人员具有约束力。只有完成这项任务后，上海的俄国移民以及华北的俄国移民才能以平等原则参与移民组织单位的工作，共同组建反共统一战线。

在这项组织工作中，我们必须充分利用我们在哈尔滨和天津的同胞的经验。此外，我们也必须欣然并感激地接受他们的援助。为了共同的事业，所有 petty ambitions（小野心/私心），所有个人性质的考量都必须一劳永逸地消除。

必须接受来自哈尔滨和天津的援助，还因为所有政治元素来自

page_data.en:
- 2 -

Manchuria and North China have assembled in Shanghai
and therefore the struggle against them is not a matter
of local significance only, but a common task of all
Russian emigrants in the Far East.

With a feeling of joy and satisfaction we note
that the day is not far away when the state of disunion,
so characteristic of Russian Shanghai at present, will be
definitely done away with. Persons arriving in
Shanghai for the first time are bewildered by all they
see and hear in local Russian public and political
circles. In order to find a way to the hearts and minds
of various individuals playing one part or another in
the public and political life of local Russian community,
they have to overcome obstacles similar to barbed wire
entanglements.

The greater must be the satisfaction of these
persons when, after an intensive work, they feel that
they have at last grasped the situation and have found
correct solutions of various local problems based on
their personal observations as well as on interviews
with other persons.

So far, the situation in local Russian community
is far from satisfactory. In no other place can such a
chaos be found, as that prevailing in the public and
political life of Russian emigrants in Shanghai. The
only consoling thought is that such a situation exists
only in Shanghai and that, therefore, it will not be
difficult to do away with it by common efforts of the
organized units of Russian emigrants."
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

满洲和华北的俄侨已汇聚于上海，因此，针对他们的斗争不仅具有地方意义，而是远东所有俄国流亡者的共同任务。

我们怀着喜悦和满意的心情指出，目前上海俄国人社区中那种极具特色的分裂状态被彻底消除的日子已为期不远。初次抵达上海的人，会对当地俄国公共和政治圈子里的所见所闻感到困惑。为了打开在当地俄国社区公共和政治生活中扮演各种角色的不同人士的心扉并影响其思想，他们必须克服如同铁丝网纠缠般的障碍。

当这些人经过紧张的工作后，觉得自己终于掌握了局势，并基于个人观察以及对他人的访谈，找到了解决各种地方问题的正确方案时，他们的满足感必定更为强烈。

迄今为止，当地俄国社区的局势远不能令人满意。在上海俄国流亡者的公共和政治生活中盛行的这种混乱局面，在其他任何地方都找不到。唯一令人欣慰的想法是，这种情况仅存在于上海，因此，通过俄国流亡者各组织单位的共同努力，不难将其消除。”

page_data.en:
- 3 -

II. Article entitled "A TOUCHING ALLIANCE"

"During the course of the past week the British
Ambassador in China, together with members of the
Committee for the Relief to Jewish Refugees, visited
the Jewish barracks in Ward Road and had a tiffin with
the Jewish refugees.

In the light of this fact, one cannot but believe
Theodore Hertzl (Vol. III., page 303), namely: that on a
given signal all Jews will be at the service of Great
Britain, who will thus acquire 10 millions agents for
the work of the expansion of her influence and power.
Then Great Britain will realize how important it is to
have Jews on her side."
page_data.zh:
- 3 -

二、题为“感人的联盟”的文章

“在过去的一周里，英国驻华大使偕同犹太难民救济委员会成员，参观了华德路（Ward Road）的犹太难民营，并与犹太难民共进午餐。

鉴于这一事实，人们不得不相信西奥多·赫茨尔（Theodore Hertzl）（第三卷，第303页）的观点，即：一旦发出信号，所有犹太人将为大不列颠效力，从而使英国获得一千万名代理人，以扩展其影响力和权力。届时，大不列颠将意识到拥有犹太人支持的重要性。”

Forwarded herewith is a translation of extracts from local Russian weekly newspaper "Russian Voice" of March 9, 1939. These articles are significant in more than one sense.

In the first place, they clearly indicate that the Russian political group represented by the "Russian Voice" admit their failure to enlist the support of the Russian community in Shanghai.

It also appears that, realising their failure, they have invoked the aid of the "Tientsin section of the United Russian Anti-Communist Front in the Orient" where the situation is alleged to be well in hand, as far as Russian emigrants are concerned.

Finally, as it is an open secret why the situation in North China is "well in hand", the articles in question would seem to suggest an intention on the part of the Japanese officials in charge of Russian affairs in Shanghai to introduce certain changes in the methods of administration of the local Russian community. The fact that the political group referred to above was never satisfied with the non-political attitude of the Russian Emigrants' Committee, is also well known.

In connection with the above the arrival in Shanghai from Tientsin on 25-2-39 of Mr. N.D. Kosmin cannot escape attention. 首先，它们清楚地表明，《俄罗斯之声》所代表的俄国政治团体承认，他们未能争取到上海俄国社区的支持。

此外，看来他们在认识到失败后，已寻求“东方联合反共战线天津分部”的援助，据称在俄国流亡者方面，那里的局势已得到良好控制。

Translation of extracts from Russian weekly newspaper "Russian
Voice", March 5,1939. Published by the Russian Voice Publishing
Co., 211 Yangtsepoo Road. Responsible editor - Mr. A. Antonoff
( A.A.Pourin ).

1. HEADLINES APPEARING ON THE FRONT PAGE:

Russian section of the International Anti-communist
Front in the Orient is completing the unification of its forces.

Now it is Shanghai's turn to join it.

Creation of an organized Russian Anti-communist
force is the task of the day.

Organized Russian emigrants in Manchoukuo and North
China are ready to extend their help to Russian Emigrants in
Central China. First steps in this direction have already been
made.

The time is near when Russian emigrants in Manchou-
kuo, North China and Central China will be united into one detach-
ment of the Russian National Front.

2. LEADING ARTICLE ENTITLED " FRIENDLY HELP ".

Expresses satisfaction and joy over the news regard-
ing the forthcoming friendly help from North China:

"We publish in to-day's issue of our newspaper a
leading article which appeared in the Tientsin Russian newspa-
per"Revival of Asia", dealing with the position of Russian na-
tional-thinking emigrants in Shanghai. This is not the first
article devoted by Russian emigrants in Tientsin to Russian emi-
grants in Shanghai. It is not the first time that they express
their sympathy towards us. Tientsin has already passed through
the phase in which Shanghai is at present. Russians in Tientsin
stand firmly on their own legs as an anti-communist force. Na-
tional activities are being carried out there on an extensive
scale ,and strong anti-communist cadres are being formed. Having
the internal situation in the Russian community well in hand,
Russian Tientsin is in a position to extend its help to those
sections of the front where the situation is not quite satis-
factory. And Tientsin is ready to help Shanghai. Not only
Tientsin, but all Russian emigrants in Manchoukuo and North
China as well. We say " all Russian emigrants" because there
are almost no Russians there who keep apart from the anti-commu-
page_data.zh:
译自1939年3月5日俄文周报《俄罗斯之声》摘录。由《俄罗斯之声》出版公司出版，地址：杨树浦路211号。责任编辑 - A. Antonoff 先生（A.A. Pourin）。

1. 头版标题：

东方国际反共战线俄国分部正在完成其力量的统一。

现在轮到上海加入了。

建立有组织的俄国反共力量是当前的任务。

满洲国和华北的有组织俄国流亡者准备向华中地区的俄国流亡者提供援助。在此方向上已迈出第一步。

满洲国、华北和华中地区的俄国流亡者统一为俄国民族前线的一个分队之日已为期不远。

2. 题为“友好援助”的社论。

对来自华北的即将提供的友好援助的消息表示满意和喜悦：

“我们在今天的报纸上刊登了一篇发表在天津俄文报纸《亚洲复兴》（Revival of Asia）上的社论，内容涉及上海具有民族意识的俄国流亡者的处境。这并非天津俄国流亡者首次撰写关于上海俄国流亡者的文章。他们也不是第一次向我们表达同情。天津已经度过了上海目前所处的阶段。天津的俄国人作为一支反共力量，坚定地自立自强。那里的民族活动正大规模开展，强大的反共骨干队伍正在形成。由于牢牢控制了俄国社区内部的局势，天津俄国有能力向那些局势不太令人满意的前线部门提供援助。天津准备帮助上海。不仅是天津，满洲国和华北的所有俄国流亡者也准备提供帮助。我们要说‘所有俄国流亡者’，因为在那里几乎没有任何俄国人置身于反共

page_data.en:
-2-
nists, because such elements have for various reasons and pur-
poses been concentrated in Shanghai. The combined mass of this
mixed company weighs heavily on the anti-communist section of lo-
cal Russian emigrants.
Shanghai may be considered as the last place in the
Orient which has not yet been purged of agents of the Comintern
working under various forms of disguise. Shanghai is a cloaca
where undesirable elements from the whole world have assembled,
it is the main field of activities of agents of the Comintern.
There is plenty of the purging work to be done here, and this
task can hardly be carried out by isolated efforts of the local
forces, especially because the disintegrating influence of the
international riff-raff has already become noticeable even
amongst the sound elements of both the Russian and foreign commu-
nities here.
The time is now ripe for starting the work of purging
Shanghai by combined efforts. This purge is not only an act of
self-defence. It is a part of the struggle, a plan for which was
laid long time ago and is already being carried out out in Man-
choukuo and other places of China.
Shanghai is one of the most important sections of the
International anti-communist front. The sooner it is brought
within the sphere of influence of the anti-communist front, the
better for the common cause.
The first steps in this direction have already been
made. The first news has been received to the effect that Shang-
hai has been included in the programme of extension of the anti-
communist front. We hear and read about moral support every day.
This gives us new strength in our activities for the cause, for
the sake of which we became emigrants, to which we have since been
serving and will continue to serve until our last breath or until
we reach our goal -- a matter of world wide importance, namely:-
final victory over communism and the Comintern."
page_data.zh:
-2-
运动之外，因为这些分子出于各种原因和目的已集中在上海。这群混杂人群的合力沉重地压在当地俄国流亡者的反共部分身上。
上海可被视为东方最后一个尚未清除伪装成各种形式的共产国际代理人的地方。上海是一个汇集了整个世界各地不良分子的污秽之地，是共产国际代理人活动的主要场所。这里有许多清洗工作要做，而这项任务很难靠当地力量的孤立努力来完成，特别是因为国际渣滓的瓦解作用甚至在当地俄国和外国社区的正派分子中也已变得明显。
现在是时候通过共同努力开始清洗上海的工作了。这次清洗不仅是一种自卫行为。它是斗争的一部分，其计划早已制定，并已在满洲国和中国其他地方实施。
上海是国际反共战线最重要的部分之一。它越早被纳入反共战线的影响范围，对共同事业就越有利。
在此方向上已迈出第一步。已收到初步消息，称上海已被列入反共战线扩展计划。我们每天都听到和读到关于精神支持的消息。这为我们为事业进行的活動注入了新的力量，我们正是为了这一事业才成为流亡者，此后一直为之服务，并将继续服务直至最后一息或直到达成我们的目标——这是一件具有世界性重要意义的事情，即：最终战胜共产主义和共产国际。”

page_data.en:
-3-

3.LEADING ARTICLE REPRINTED FROM THE TIENTSIN RUSSIAN
newspaper "REVIVAL OF ASIA", FEBRUARY, 1939.

"Sad news has been received from Shanghai section of
the Russian Anti-Communist Front .... The situation is very dif-
ficult there.. Although there are active elements in that city,
although their crack groups are already engaged in a bitter
struggle against the multifarious international, the latter is
too strong and local Russian emigrants are too terrified by in-
ternal forces of the Comintern and its associates and remain
passive onlookers at the time when their vanguard is breaking
down with fatigue..."

"The necessity becomes more and more apparent of uni-
fying all sections of the Russian Far East into one Far Eastern
section of the Anti-Communist Front in the Orient. In the mean-
time it is necessary to detail active forces from sections, which
are well in hand, to Shanghai section in order to assist them in
their struggle against the multifarious international.

This is a sacred duty of all Russian emigrants... It
should be borne in mind that owing to the present situation,
Shanghai has become a centre where assembled all undesirable ele-
ments, all opposition, intriguers, irresponsible critics, Soviet
agents, agents of the Comintern and criminal elements, who have
been thrown out by Russian emigrants from Manchoukuo and North
China.

This was done not because we bear a grudge against
Russian emigrants in Shanghai, but because there was no other
place in to which these undesirable elements could be thrown. We
fully realised at that time the harm their concentration in
Shanghai would cause to honest Russian emigrants in that city.
Therefore, now when our brethren from Shanghai ask for help, we
must help them. If we fail in this, we shall be not worthy of
the honest name of Russian emigrants.

Russian emigrants in Manchukuo and North China must
extend their help to Shanghai. For this purpose active forces
page_data.zh:
-3-

3. 转载自天津俄文报纸《亚洲复兴》（REVIVAL OF ASIA）1939年2月的社论。

“从俄国反共前线上海分部收到了令人悲痛的消息……那里的局势非常困难……尽管该城市中有活跃分子，尽管他们的精锐小组已经投身于对抗形形色色的国际势力的激烈斗争中，但后者过于强大，且当地俄国侨民被共产国际及其同伙的地狱般的力量吓得魂不附体，在其先锋部队因疲惫而崩溃之际，他们仍只是被动的旁观者……”

“将俄国远东所有分部统一为东方反共前线的远东分部，这一必要性变得日益明显。同时，有必要从那些局势已得到良好控制的分部抽调活跃力量前往上海分部，以协助他们对抗形形色色的国际势力。

page_data.en:
Special Branch,
March 9, 1939.

Articles in the "Russian Voice" of 5-3-39 indicating
possibility of changes affecting Russian Community in Shanghai.

Forwarded herewith is a translation of extracts from
local Russian weekly newspaper "Russian Voice" of March 9, 1939.
These articles are significant in more than one sense.

In the first place, they clearly indicate that
the Russian political group represented by the "Russian
Voice" admit their failure to enlist the support of the
Russian community in Shanghai.

It also appears that, realising their failure,
they have invoked the aid of the "Tientsin section of the
United Russian Anti-Communist Front in the Orient" where
the situation is alleged to be well in hand, as far as
Russian emigrants are concerned.

Finally, as it is an open secret why the situ-
ation in North China is "well in hand", the articles in
question would seem to suggest an intention on the part of
the Japanese officials in charge of Russian Affairs in
Shanghai to introduce certain changes in the methods of ad-
ministration of the local Russian community. The fact
that the political group referred to above was never satis-
fied with the non-political attitude of the Russian Emi-
grants' Committee, is also well known.

In connection with the above the arrival in
Shanghai from Tientsin on 26-2-39 of Mr. N.D. Kumin cannot
escape attention. Formerly a Major-General in the Russian
army he was prominent in the Russian monarchist and fascist
circles in Harbin and later participated in the activities
of the "Anti-Communist Committee of Russian Emigrants in
Tientsin". Although it is reported that he left Shanghai
owing to his disagreement with Pestov, the head of the
said Committee, he displays an active interest in the
affairs of the local Russian community, which would seem to
indicate that he is not acting in his private capacity.

Any information of interest regarding this matter
will be reported.
page_data.zh:
特别处，
1939年3月9日。

1939年3月5日《俄国之声》中的文章表明可能发生产生影响上海俄国社区的变化。

现随函附上本地俄文周报《俄国之声》1939年3月9日（注：此处原文日期与前文及标题略有出入，依原文译出）摘录的译文。这些文章在不止一个意义上具有重要性。

首先，它们清楚地表明，《俄国之声》所代表的俄国政治团体承认其未能争取到上海俄国社区的支持。

此外，看来他们在意识到失败后，已寻求“东方联合俄国反共前线天津分部”的援助，据称就俄国侨民而言，那里的局势已得到良好控制。

最后，鉴于华北局势为何能“得到良好控制”已是公开的秘密，有关文章似乎暗示，负责上海俄国事务的日本官员有意对当地俄国社区的管理方法进行某些变更。众所周知，上述政治团体从未对俄国侨民委员会的非政治态度感到满意。

鉴于上述情况，N.D. Kumin（音译）先生于1939年2月26日从天津抵达上海一事不容忽视。他曾任俄国陆军少将，在哈尔滨的俄国君主主义者和法西斯圈子中颇具影响力，后来参与了“天津俄国侨民反共委员会”的活动。虽然有报告称他因与该委员会主席Pestov（音译）意见不合而离开上海，但他对当地俄国社区的事务表现出积极的兴趣，这似乎表明他并非以私人身份行事。

有关此事的任何感兴趣的信息都将予以报告。

Translation of extracts from Russian weekly newspaper "Russian
Voice" March 5, 1939. Published by the Russian Voice Publis-
hing Co., 211 Yangtsepoo Road. Responsible editor - Mr. A.
Antonoff (A.A. Pourin).

1. HEADLINES APPEARING ON THE FRONT PAGE.

Russian section of the International Anti-Communist
Front in the Orient is completing the unification of its forces.

Now it is Shanghai's turn to join it.

Creation of an organized Russian Anti-communist
force is the task of the day.

Organized Russian emigrants in Manchoukuo and North
China are ready to extend their help to Russian Emigrants in
Central China. First steps in this direction have already been
made.

The time is near when Russian emigrants in Manchou-
kuo, North China and Central China will be united into one detach-
ment of the Russian National Front.

2. LEADING ARTICLE ENTITLED " FRIENDLY HELP"

Expresses satisfaction and joy over the news regard-
ing the forthcoming friendly help from North China;

"We publish in today's issue of our newspaper a
leading article which appeared in the Tientsin Russian newspa-
per "Revival of Asia", dealing with the position of Russian na-
tional-thinking emigrants in Shanghai. This is not the first
article devoted by Russian emigrants in Tientsin to Russian emi-
grants in Shanghai. It is not the first time that they express
their sympathy towards us. Tientsin has already passed through
the phase in which Shanghai is at present. Russians in Tientsin
stand firmly on their own legs as an anti-communist force. Na-
tional activities are being carried out there on an extensive
scale, and strong anti-communist cadres are being formed. Having
the internal situation in the Russian community well in hand.
Russian Tientsin is in a position to extend its help to those
sections of the front where the situation is not quite satis-
factory. And Tientsin is ready to help Shanghai. Not only
Tientsin, but all Russian emigrants in Manchoukuo and North
China as well. To say "all Russian emigrants" because there
are almost no Russians there who keep apart from the anti-com-
munist movement, because such elements have for various reasons and pur-
poses been concentrated in Shanghai. The central idea of the
above quoted article dwells on the anti-communist struggle of
local Russian emigrants.

俄文周报《俄国之声》1939年3月5日摘录译文。由《俄国之声》出版公司出版，地址：杨树浦路211号。责任编辑 - A. Antonoff（A.A. Pourin）先生。

1. 头版标题。

东方国际反共前线的俄国分部正在完成其力量的统一。

现在轮到上海加入了。

创建有组织的俄国反共力量是当前的任务。

满洲国和华北有组织的俄国侨民准备向华中地区的俄国侨民提供援助。在此方向上已迈出第一步。

满洲国、华北和华中的俄国侨民统一为一个俄国民族前线分队的时候已近在咫尺。

2. 题为“友好的帮助”的社论

表达了对来自华北的即将提供的友好帮助的消息感到满意和喜悦；

“我们在今天的报纸上刊登了一篇发表在天津俄文报纸《亚洲复兴》上的社论，论述了上海具有民族思想的俄国侨民的处境。这并非天津的俄国侨民首次撰写关于上海俄国侨民的文章。这也不是他们第一次向我们表示同情。天津已经度过了上海目前所处的阶段。天津的俄国人作为一支反共力量坚定地自立。那里的民族活动正大规模开展，强大的反共骨干队伍正在形成。由于俄国社区内部局势得到良好控制，天津的俄国人处于可以向局势不太令人满意的前线分部提供援助的地位。天津准备帮助上海。不仅是天津，满洲国和华北的所有俄国侨民也准备提供帮助。之所以说‘所有俄国侨民’，是因为那里几乎没有俄国人置身于反共运动之外，因为此类元素出于各种目的和原因已被集中在上海。上述引用文章的中心思想着眼于当地俄国侨民的反共斗争。

page_data.en:
- 2 -
Shanghai may be considered as the last place in the
Orient which has not yet been purged of agents of the Comintern
working under various forms of disguise. Shanghai is a cloak
where undesirable elements from the whole world have assembled,
it is the main field of activities of agents of the Comintern.
There is plenty of the purging work to be done here, and this
task can hardly be carried out by isolated efforts of the local
forces, especially because the disintegrating influence of the
international riff-raff has already become noticeable even
amongst the sound elements of both the Russian and foreign commu-
nities here.

The time is now ripe for starting the work of purging
Shanghai by combined efforts. This purge is not only an act of
self-defence. It is a part of the struggle, a plan for which was
laid long time ago and is already being carried out out in Man-
choukuo and other places of China.

Shanghai is one of the most important sections of the
International anti-communist front. The sooner it is brought
within the sphere of influence of the anti-communist front, the
better for the common cause.

The first steps in this direction have already been
made. The first news has been received to the effect that Shang-
hai has been included in the programme of extension of the anti-
communist front. We hear and read about moral support every day.
This gives us new strength in our activities for the cause, for
the sake of which we became emigrants, to which we have since been
serving and will continue to serve until our last breath or until
we reach our goal - a matter of world wide importance, namely:-
final victory over communism and the Comintern."

3. LEADERSHIP AND ORGANIZATION OF THE WHITE EMIGRANT
MOVEMENT IN SHANGHAI

"And more has been promised from General Anufriev of
the Russian Anti-Communist Front... The situation is very dif-
ficult here. Although there are active elements in that city,
although their small groups are already formed they cannot
decisively influence the international developments. The reason is
page_data.zh:
- 2 -
上海可被视为东方尚未清除伪装成各种形式的共产国际代理人的最后一个地方。上海是一件斗篷，世界各地的不良分子都聚集于此，它是共产国际代理人的主要活动场所。这里有许多清洗工作要做，这项任务很难靠当地力量的孤立努力来完成，特别是因为国际渣滓的瓦解性影响即使在当地俄国和外国社区的健全分子中也已变得明显。

现在是时候通过共同努力开始清洗上海的工作了。这种清洗不仅是一种自卫行为。它是斗争的一部分，其计划早已制定，并已在满洲国和中国其他地方实施。

上海是国际反共前线最重要的分部之一。它越早被纳入反共前线的影响范围，对共同事业就越有利。

在此方向上已迈出第一步。已收到初步消息，称上海已被列入扩展反共前线的计划中。我们每天都听到并读到关于道德支持的消息。这为我们为事业进行的活动中注入了新的力量，我们正是为了这一事业才成为流亡者，自此一直为之服务，并将继续服务直至最后一息或直到我们达到目标——这是一个具有世界性重要意义的问题，即：最终战胜共产主义和共产国际。”

3. 上海白俄运动的领导与组织

“俄国反共前线的Anufriev将军承诺提供更多帮助……这里的局势非常困难。尽管该城市中有活跃分子，尽管他们的小组已经形成，但他们无法对国际局势产生决定性影响。原因是

too strong and local Russian emigrants are too terrified by in-
fernal forces of the Comintern and its associates and remain
passive onlookers at the time when their vanguard is breaking
down with fatigue..."

"The necessity becomes more and more apparent of uni-
fying all sections of the Russian Far East into one Far Eastern
Section of the Anti-Communist Front in the Orient. In the mean-
time it is necessary to detail active forces from sections, which
are well in hand to Shanghai section in order to assist them in
their struggle against the multifarious international.

This is a sacred duty of all Russian emigrants... It
should be borne in mind that owing to the present situation,
Shanghai has become a centre where assembled all undesirable ele-
ments, all opposition, intriguers, irresponsible critics, Soviet
agents, agents of the Comintern and criminal elements, who have
been thrown out by Russian emigrants from Manchoukuo and North
China.

This was done not because we bear a grudge against
Russian emigrants in Shanghai, but because there was no other
place in to which these undesirable elements could be thrown. We
fully realised at that time the harm their concentration in
Shanghai would cause to honest Russian emigrants in that city.
Therefore, now when our brethren from Shanghai ask for help, we
must help them. If we fail in this, we shall be not worthy of
the honest name of Russian emigrants.

Russian emigrants in Manchoukuo and North China must
extend their help to Shanghai. For this purpose active forces
are now being formed and trained. They will be sent to the
Shanghai Section of the Russian Anti-Communist Front...In the
meantime, detailed reports regarding the enemy are expected from
Shanghai."

译自俄文周报《Russ...》（原文残缺）
1939年2月5日。由“Russian Voic... Co.”（原文残缺，疑为 Russian Voice Co.）出版，地址：杨树浦路211号。责任编辑：tonoff ( Pourin )（音译）。

面具揭下。

1932年，日本是唯一一个受共产主义影响的国家，所有列强的力量都指向她。
在整整十年间，这些力量利用中国对抗日本，违背了美国、英国和法国资本家（占60%……原文残缺）以及这些国家的官方代表的意愿，他们支持中国共产党员和国民党。当时，从满洲推行将共产主义影响扩散到……的政策。
日本在大陆上的被迫行动，是由于这个大国努力以自卫和自……的名义争取独立。然而，世界外交界从不厌倦地给日本的这一行动贴上侵略性目标的标签。世界外交界在其秘密指挥者的指使下，其任务是孤立日本，并剥夺她与中国——她的天然盟友——的友谊。
阅读《锡安长老会纪要》第五条，看看1901年做出的预言是如何成为现实的。
伟大的俄罗斯人民正处于痛苦挣扎之中，整个世界认为这不过是某种内部纠纷，对我们的呼声充耳不闻；只要在世界某个地方捏一下犹太人，地球上的各国就会发出抗议声，其重要性被提升到世界灾难的高度。
为了不在犹太人的……下灭亡，德国不得不进行全国范围的清洗。

出于某些原因，所有这些是民主国家所不能接受的，它们非常希望中国目前的混乱状况持续下去。这在各方面都是有利的。例如，在巴黎公社时期，由于革命混乱，法国除了犹太人之外所有人都遭受了苦难：到20世纪初，20万法国犹太人拥有的资本是4000万法国人拥有资本的两倍。整个法国工业被摧毁，经济活动停止。然而，没有一位犹太银行家遭受损失，在1871年公社统治期间，巴黎没有一所犹太人的房屋遭到攻击和掠夺。俄罗斯也发生了同样的情况。现在在中国也可以观察到类似的事实。除了犹太银行家，即除了金融国际（Finintern）之外，这里的每个人都遭受了苦难。

共产国际和金融国际向中国提供大量的武器、资金、专家和物资，使其能够继续进行对日战争。只要金融国际和共产国际存在，亚洲乃至整个世界就不会有和平，也不可能有和平。必须由拥有生命力的国家来摧毁它们。无论实现这一目标需要多大的牺牲和努力，都必须摧毁它们。人类历史上最大的问题是：世界将会变成什么样。

要么是在金融国际和共产国际权力下的普遍奴役，要么是由日本、德国和意大利领导的，以民族主义战胜当前共济会成员、犹太人和共产党人的全球侵略为名的最后决战。

CHINA PRESS.

FEB 1 1939

Ex-Chief Of Customs In
Peiping Denies Japanese
Charges Of Pro-Communism

Mr. N. Konovaloff, Wife, Arrive Here After
Brief Detention In Northern City
On Trumped-Up Charges

Because both he and his wife,
Mrs. O. I. Konovaloff were accused
of having direct connections with
the Comintern Mr. N. A. Konovaloff
was deported from North China in
the last days of December, 1938.
Mrs. Konovaloff was also ordered to
leave Tientsin.

Arriving in Shanghai on January
7, Mr. Konovaloff, former adviser
to the Chinese Government and
more recently Commissioner of
Peiping Customs, kept in seclusion.
He avoided giving interviews to the
press, and it was only a few days
ago that he received reporters.

He denied all charges against him
which had resulted in his short
detention in North China and con-
sequent deportation. It was alleged
that Mrs. Konovaloff made frequent
trips to Soviet Russia, and was
"apparently an agent of communi-
cation between Moscow and Lenin-
grad on one side, and Paris, Stock-
holm and Berlin on the other."

In addition, it was alleged that
the Konovaloffs had a relative in
the U.S.S.R., "one Jdanov," who
was stated to be an important com-
munist worker of the Comintern at
Moscow.

It is believed that this reference
was to Andrei Jdanov, member of
the Supreme Council's Presidium of
the U.S.S.R. As far as is known,
there is no other public official
named Jdanov occupying any post
of importance in the U.S.S.R.
Andrei Jdanov is also the secretary
of the Moscow Committee of the
Communist Party.

1939年2月1日

北平前海关负责人否认日本关于其亲共的指控

N. Konovaloff 先生及其夫人在北方城市因捏造的罪名被短暂拘留后抵达此处

由于他和他的妻子 O. I. Konovaloff 夫人被指控与共产国际有直接联系，N. A. Konovaloff 先生于1938年12月底被驱逐出华北。Konovaloff 夫人也被责令离开天津。

Konovaloff 先生于1月7日抵达上海，他曾任中国政府顾问，近期担任北平海关税务司，一直深居简出。他避免接受媒体采访，直到几天前才接见记者。

他否认了导致他在华北被短暂拘留并随后被驱逐的所有指控。据称，Konovaloff 夫人频繁前往苏维埃俄罗斯，并且“显然是莫斯科和列宁格勒一方，与巴黎、斯德哥尔摩和柏林另一方之间的联络代理人”。

此外，据称 Konovaloff 夫妇在苏联有一位亲戚，“一名 Jdanov”，据称是共产国际在莫斯科的重要共产主义工作者。

人们认为这一提及指的是安德烈·日丹诺夫（Andrei Jdanov），苏联最高苏维埃主席团成员。据所知，苏联没有其他名为 Jdanov 的公职人员担任重要职务。安德烈·日丹诺夫也是共产党莫斯科委员会书记。

page_data.en:
Mr. Konovaloff was appointed to
a position in the Chinese Maritime
Customs before the turn of the cen-
tury, in 1897. He first spent six
months in Ichang as the fourth as-
sistant, after which he was trans-
ferred to the Peiping Customs.

It was during his stay in the
former capital that the Special
Customs College was founded in
Peiping, and he was immediately
asked to teach the Russian language
in this school.

He accepted and remained in this
post until 1900, after which he was
appointed the personal secretary to
Sir Robert Hart, called the "Grand
Old Man of Chinese Customs."
Three years later, he became the
Commissioner of Customs at Ying-
kow (Newchwang), where he re-
mained until the occupation of this
port by the Japanese. He was then
sent back to Peiping, and made a
Commissioner of the General In-
spectorate of the Customs.

In 1907 he took part in the talks
between the Russian and Chinese
Governments with regard to the
opening of Customs in Harbin, and
became the first Commissar in this
city when the Customs were estab-
lished later.

In 1910 he became the technical
advisor to a Chinese mission which
went to St. Petersburg to discuss
the Treaty of 1881.

He later became an advisor to the
Chinese Government Board of
Control in Peiping when, with the
formation of the Salt Monopoly, this
board was reorganized, and at the
close of the World War in 1918
became a member of the Inter-
national Board which had general
charge of the Chinese Eastern Rail-
way. He remained in this post until
1924, when the road was taken over
by the Chinese authorities.

Mr. Konovaloff is planning to sail
shortly for the port of France to
visit his family.

Mr. Konovaloff left for Shang-
hai yesterday morning on the S.S.
"President Wilson" en route to
France. He will be accompanied by
his wife and daughter. Mr. Kono-
valoff has been connected with the
Chinese Maritime Customs for over
thirty years and has held many im-
portant posts. His departure will be
regretted by his many friends in
this city.
page_data.zh:
Konovaloff 先生在本世纪之交前的1897年被任命为中国海关的一个职位。他首先在宜昌担任四等助理六个月，之后被调往北平海关。

正是在他居住在前首都期间，北平成立了专门的海关学院，他立即被邀请在该校教授俄语。

他接受了这一职位并任职至1900年，之后他被任命为被称为“中国海关老前辈”的罗伯特·赫德爵士（Sir Robert Hart）的个人秘书。三年后，他成为营口（Newchwang）的海关税务司，一直任职到该港口被日本占领。随后他被派回北平，并被任命为海关总税务司署的税务司。

1907年，他参与了俄国和中国政府关于在哈尔滨开设海关的谈判，并在后来海关成立时成为该市的第一任委员。

1910年，他成为中国赴圣彼得堡讨论1881年条约的代表团的技术顾问。

后来，随着盐务专办的形成，该董事会改组，他成为北平中国政府审计院（Board of Control）的顾问，并在1918年世界大战结束时，成为负责中东铁路的国际董事会成员。他一直担任此职直到1924年，当时该铁路由中国当局接管。

Konovaloff 先生计划不久后乘船前往法国港口探望家人。

Konovaloff 先生昨天上午乘坐“威尔逊总统号”轮船离开上海前往法国。他的妻子和女儿将陪同前往。Konovaloff 先生与中国海关共事三十多年，担任过许多重要职务。他的离去将使他在本市的众多朋友感到惋惜。

Translation of extracts from an article entitled " A question
of principle" which appeared in the Russian newspaper " RUSSIAN
VOICE" on 15-1-39. ( Editor - Mr. A.A. Pourin )

A QUESTION OF PRINCIPLE

In the issue dated 6-1-39 of the local pro-Soviet news-
paper "Novosti Dnia" appeared an article regarding the depor-
tation from Peiping of a certain M.A. Konovaloff. The heading
of the article speaks quite eloquently of the nature of infor-
mation it contains:-

" THE BLACKMAILING COMMITTEE IN TIENTSIN HEADED
BY HABITUAL DRUNKARD PASTUHIN, EX-COLLABORATOR
OF THE 'NASHA ZARIA', IS OPENLY ENGAGED IN ROB-
BING UNFORTUNATE RUSSIANS WHO HAVE BEEN PLACED
UNDER THEIR ADMINISTRATION".

We publish in to-day's issue of our journal the official
statement issued in this connection by "Domei" News Agency,
which with an equal eloquence explains the origin of the "foam"
from Chilikin's dirty mouth.

We already stated some time ago that, on the whole, we
consider the situation in Tientsin as satisfactory. This opi-
nion is shared by certain local public leaders who in connection
with their work have to face absurd opposition on the part of
some people, complete lack of understanding, unjustified hatred,
harsh selfishness or provoking attitude on the part of others -
in one word - all that is typical of the life of Russian emi-
grants in Shanghai, this Eastern Babylon.

There is no Russian authoritative power here, - this de-
scribes accurately the situation in the local Russian community.

In the Russian community in Tientsin there is such a
power. Even Chilikin admits it. That this power is not to the
taste of people like Chilikin - is another question. It also
cannot be disputed that this is a kind of power, under which the
possibility is excluded of "activities" of various people of
the Chilikin type.

.... Of course, there still are people who consider this
new power as something incompatible with the usual conception
of the character and structure of a power, as something un-
page_data.zh:
译自1939年1月15日俄文报纸《RUSSIAN VOICE》（《俄国之声》）上发表的题为《原则问题》的文章摘录。（编辑：A.A. Pourin 先生）

原则问题

在1月6日出版的本地亲苏报纸《Novosti Dnia》（《每日新闻》）上，出现了一篇关于某位 M.A. Konovaloff 从北平被驱逐的文章。该文章的标题相当生动地说明了其所含信息的性质：-

“天津的勒索委员会由‘NASHA ZARIA’（《我们的曙光》）的前合作者、惯酗酒者 PASTUHIN 领导，公然抢劫置于其管理之下的不幸俄罗斯人”。

我们在今天的期刊上发表“同盟通讯社”（Domei News Agency）就此发布的官方声明，该声明同样生动地解释了 Chilikin 脏嘴里的“泡沫”的来源。

我们不久前已经指出，总体而言，我们认为天津的局势令人满意。某些当地公众领袖也持有这一观点，他们在工作中不得不面对一些人荒谬的反对、完全缺乏理解、毫无根据的仇恨、严酷的自私或挑衅态度——总之，就是上海这个东方巴比伦的俄罗斯移民生活中典型的一切。

这里没有俄罗斯的权威权力，——这准确地描述了当地俄罗斯社区的状况。

在天津的俄罗斯社区中存在这样的权力。甚至 Chilikin 也承认这一点。这种权力不合 Chilikin 之流的心意——这是另一个问题。同样不可否认的是，这是一种权力，在这种权力下，排除了各种 Chilikin 类型人物的“活动”可能性。

……当然，仍然有人视这种新权力为与通常对权力的性质和结构的观念不相容的东西，视为某种不……

usual and unacceptable"...
reference is made to the case of N.A.Konovaloff,
Russian resident in Peiping, who was deported from that city
recently because, it is alleged, he always had been keeping
apart from Russian emigrants and their affairs, but at the same
time, according to official information, had been engaged in cer-
tain affairs of an " international" character.
" As to Chilikin's outbursts, they can be described as
bolshevist endeavours to widen 'the gap between those who honest-
ly serve the Russian cause in Tientsin and those ,who are in an
opposition to this cause because the latter affects the pockets
of rich people refusing to contribute towards the common wel-
fare.
Konovaloff's case has the importance of a question of
principle. It shows that the United Russian Organization in
North China is vested with authority in a degree sufficient to
embrace the entire life of Russian emigrants, to govern and
direct it and to isolate those Russian emigrants who, for rea-
sons of a political or selfish nature, refuse to recognise the
cause, which all Russian anti-communist emigrants must support,
namely- active struggle against communism.
To participate in this struggle is not the business of
some specialists only. It is everybody's duty. Therefore, the
United Russian Organizations in North China insisted that eve-
ry one must fulfil his duty,- some by personal work and others-
by their financial contributions. Thus, all emigrants have
been MOBILISED.
Therefore, Russian emigrants in North China constitute
a POWER. This explains the mad struggle against its influence
on the part of Chilikin and those who are with him.
The Russian emigrant population in Tientsin does not
exceed 5,000. What would happen, if a similar unification could
be carried out here in Shanghai? Imagine 20,000 Russian emi-
grants - the largest foreign community in Shanghai - unified,

惯常且不可接受”……
兹提及居住于北平的俄国人 N.A. Konovaloff 一案，此人最近被从该城市驱逐出境，据称原因是他始终与俄国流亡者及其事务保持距离，但与此同时，根据官方消息，他一直参与某些具有“国际”性质的事务。
“至于 Chilikin 的激烈言论，可以将其描述为布尔什维克式的企图，旨在扩大‘在天津真诚服务于俄国事业的人’与‘反对这一事业的人’之间的隔阂，因为后者影响了那些拒绝为公共福利捐款的富人的钱袋子。
Konovaloff 一案具有原则性问题的重要性。它表明，华北俄国联合组织拥有足以涵盖俄国流亡者全部生活、对其进行管理和指导、并孤立那些出于政治或自私原因拒绝承认所有俄国反共流亡者必须支持的事业（即积极反对共产主义）的俄国流亡者的权威。
参与这场斗争不仅仅是某些专家的事。这是每个人的责任。因此，华北俄国联合组织坚持认为，每个人都必须履行自己的责任——有些人通过个人工作，另一些人则通过财务捐款。因此，所有流亡者都已动员起来。
因此，华北的俄国流亡者构成了一股力量。这就解释了 Chilikin 及其同伙为何疯狂地反对它的影响。
天津的俄国流亡人口不超过 5,000 人。如果在上海也能实现类似的统一，会发生什么情况呢？想象一下，20,000 名俄国流亡者——上海最大的外籍社群——团结在一起，

page_data.en:
-3-
directed by one power, acting as one compact mass.. There would
be no question then of a lack of legal status, poverty, fear of
starvation, Russian homeless children and their denationaliza-
tion.
We firmly believe that the time will come when
such a situation will be established here.

由一个权力机构指挥，作为一个紧密的整体行动……那时就不会再存在缺乏法律地位、贫困、对饥饿的恐惧、俄国无家可归的儿童及其去民族化的问题。
我们坚信，建立这种局面的时刻终将到来。

TRANSLATION FROM THE RUSSIAN NEWSPAPER
"RUSSIAN VOICE" (Russky Golos)
of December 11, 1938, published by the
Russky Golos Publishing Company at
211 Yangtzepoo Road, Wayside, Shanghai.

Irresponsible Action.
---------------------

Taking advantage of the favourable circumstances, the Russian emigrants in the East have indulged in great political activities. Representatives of Japan, the nearest participants of the anti-communistic bloc to this section of emigrants, are co-operating in the said activities. In the opposition to communism an idealistic mutual help has been achieved and made a reality. And it is apparent that this work on the lines in question will be successful only if from either side there will be no irresponsible actions, which in some way or another spoil or bring, so to speak, discord into it.

We do not admit the possibility of such actions on the part of our Japanese friends. They are not possible because the representatives of the Japanese people, in contact with whom we carry on our political activities, carry out the general politics of Japanese Empire and introduce into life the guiding principles of their leading Government centres.

However irresponsible actions on the part of undisciplined representatives of Russian emigrants, much to our regret, still occur and these extremely complicate the course of the general political work in its Russian section. These actions are very much like the actions of a soldier, who when strictly prohibited to fire unless ordered to do so, suddenly fires at the very moment when a shot fired would spoil the plan of a given military action.

At the moment we consider M.N. Tretiakoff's generally known publication made in local Russian newspapers yesterday as being such an irresponsible action.

This action is one of an irresponsible person who does not want to consider anyone or anything. It interferes with the general plan of activities, causes a natural surprise and finally it places people and organisations comprising the strength of Russian anti-communistic unification into a most awkward position.

This action reminds one to a great extent of an officer about whom the following is related when he is said to have shouted at his squad of excellently marching men:
"All you scoundrels are not marching in line- I alone am marching in line!"

M.N. Tretiakoff is not even an officer of the "emigrants'" squad. He is only an ordinary member of the emigrants family. And when he shouts that all of us, or at least the section of Russian emigrants, which is friendly with the Japanese, are not marching in line with him and only he does so, this causes annoyance and makes one wish that this man be compelled to act not as he personally desires, but as is required by the general trend of our activities.

We have no means to compel. But in this instance there is good reason to regret it. At the same time we can only hope that those who have and understand the possibilities, will see to it that the irresponsibility of individuals similar to that of M.N. Tretiakoff be dealt with in due course.

Such actions cause detriment to us and our friends.
The Editorial Staff.

（左侧手写批注：）
D 8212
Dec. 13.

译文选自1938年12月11日出版的俄文报纸

不负责任的行动。
---------------------

利用有利形势，东方的俄国流亡者开展了大量的政治活动。日本代表作为与该部分流亡者关系最近的反共集团参与者，正在合作开展上述活动。在反对共产主义方面，已实现并落实了一种理想主义的互助。显然，只有当双方都不出现以某种方式破坏或所谓带来不和的不负责任行动时，这方面的工作才能取得成功。

我们不承认我们的日本朋友会有此类行动的可能性。这是不可能的，因为与我们进行政治接触的日本人民代表，执行的是日本帝国的总体政策，并将其主要政府中心的指导原则贯彻到生活中。

然而，令人遗憾的是，纪律松散的俄国流亡者代表所采取的不负责任行动仍然发生，这极大地复杂化了俄国部分总体政治工作的进程。这些行动非常像一名士兵的行为，他在被严格禁止除非接到命令否则不得开枪的情况下，却在开枪会破坏某项军事行动计划的那一刻突然开火。

目前，我们认为 M.N. Tretiakoff 昨天在当地俄文报纸上发表的众所周知的出版物，就是这样一种不负责任的行动。

这是一种不顾及任何人或任何事的不负责任之人的行为。它干扰了总体活动计划，引起了自然的惊讶，并最终使构成俄国反共统一力量的个人和组织陷入极其尴尬的境地。

这一行动在很大程度上让人想起关于一位军官的如下叙述：据说他曾对着队列整齐的优秀士兵大喊：
“你们这些流氓都没有排成直线——只有我排成了直线！”

M.N. Tretiakoff 甚至不是“流亡者”队伍中的军官。他只是流亡者群体中的一名普通成员。当他大喊我们所有人，或者至少是与日本友好的那部分俄国流亡者，没有与他保持一致，而只有他保持一致时，这引起了恼怒，并使人希望迫使此人不是按照他个人的意愿行事，而是按照我们活动的总体趋势要求行事。

我们没有办法强迫。但在这种情况下，我们有充分的理由感到遗憾。同时，我们只能希望那些拥有并理解可能性的人，会确保及时处理类似 M.N. Tretiakoff 这样的个人的不负责任行为。

此类行动损害了我们和我们的朋友。
编辑部。

（左侧手写批注：）
D 8212

The opening of a Branch of the National
Organization of Russian Scouts in Wayside.
------------

As from December 11, the National Organization
of Russian Scouts officially opened its Branch in Wayside, Hqrs.
being situated temporarily on Baikal Road Lane 120-5 Flat
6. This organization existed prior to the August hostili-
ties of 1937. Classes are being held in the Professional
School in Wayside on Sundays at 2 p.m.
------------

Free-hand action of House-owners in Tongshan Road.
------------

In Passage 696, which belongs to the Tsun-Kee Estate
Company, poor Russian families have been residing for 8,10
and 12 years at a time. With the opening of the Wayside
district these tenants returned to their homes in a state
of destruction. The house-owners immediately demanded rent
payment from them which they have been paying as from March
1938. The destroyed roofs, burnt up window frames, etc.
have not been repaired and the house-owners emphatically
refuse to repair any of the houses which sustained damage
during the hostilities. There is no water or light. Every-
thing has been cut off as the house-owners consider that
water costs too much and one can live without it. Even the
fire hose is barricaded. With the arrival in Shanghai of new
emigrants the house-owners are demanding that the Russians
should vacate the houses immediately and have gone as far as
terrorising them and saying that they do not wish to rent
the houses to Russians or Japanese, as a matter of principle.
The Shanghai Municipal Council has been collecting rates from
these poor people all the while, although the lavatories and
general dirt are seldom removed. The tenants have appealed to
the Shanghai Municipal Police for protection, but were told
that it is not their business. Similar replies have been
given in the Shanghai Municipal Council and the Russian
Emigrant organizations. Winter is approaching and the
house-owners are throwing the poor people on the street, as
there is no accommodation available anywhere. We draw the
attention of the Japanese Authorities to the above free hand
action and we trust that they will take some steps for the
protection of the lawful rights and requests of the tenants,
and that the free hand action of the house owners of the Tsun-
Kee Estate Company will be curtailed.
------------

Restricted Admission into North China
of Jews from Germany and Italy.
------------

The entire world of humanity, with the exception
of the Communist U.S.S.R., taking into consideration more
and more the terrible danger of contamination of communism,
slowly, but persistently introduces measures of anti-communist
nature. North China, in view of the present state of the

俄国童子军全国组织在大西路开设分部。
------------

自12月11日起，俄国童子军全国组织正式在大西路开设其分部，总部暂时设在贝加尔路120弄5号6室。该组织在1937年8月战事之前就已存在。课程每周日下午2点在大西路职业学校举行。
------------

同山路业主的擅自行动。
------------

在属于俊记地产公司（Tsun-Kee Estate Company）的696弄，贫穷的俄国家庭分别在此居住了8年、10年和12年。随着大西路地区的开放，这些租户回到家中时，房屋已处于毁坏状态。业主立即要求他们支付租金，他们自1938年3月起一直支付租金。毁坏的屋顶、烧毁的窗框等均未修复，业主坚决拒绝修复任何在战事中受损的房屋。没有水和电。一切都被切断，因为业主认为水费太贵，没有水也可以生活。甚至连消防水龙带也被封锁。随着新流亡者抵达上海，业主要求俄国人立即搬离房屋，甚至恐吓他们，声称原则上他们不愿将房屋租给俄国人或日本人。上海公共租界工部局一直在向这些穷人收取捐税，尽管厕所和一般污垢很少清理。租户已向上海公共租界工部局警务处寻求保护，但被告知这不是他们的职责范围。上海公共租界工部局和俄国流亡者组织也给出了类似的答复。冬季即将来临，业主将这些穷人赶上街头，因为到处都没有住所。我们提请日本当局注意上述擅自行动，并相信他们将采取一些措施保护租户的合法权利和诉求，并遏制俊记地产公司业主的擅自行动。
------------

限制德国和意大利犹太人进入华北。
------------

除共产主义苏联外，全人类越来越考虑到共产主义污染的可怕危险，缓慢但坚定地引入具有反共性质的措施。鉴于目前的状况，华北

page_data.en:

whole of China, which is conducting a merciless war
against communism and acting on the basis of strictly
anti-communist principles, is also adopting measures
of safeguarding itself from communistic contamination.
By so doing North China is clearing up its
national and state affairs and by affording protection
to its population against red contamination, at the
same time gives protection to foreigners, residing
within its territory, by safeguarding their interests
from being destroyed and annihilated by communistic
forces and destructive red influence.
In consideration of this, the authorities of
North China have been compelled to give special
attention to the increasing influx to the Far East
from Germany, Austria and Italy of Jews, who are being
expelled from these countries as element suspected of
communism, and which may, moreover consider North
China as part of country favourable to be made use of
for some kind of personal gain, detrimental to the
State.
Information to hand indicates that about 6 to 12
Jews, expelled from the above named countries, have
already arrived in North China, Tientsin in particular,
The local Jewish community received them, but is
exhibiting much anxiety as to how to accommodate these
Refugees.
Taking into consideration the anxiety of the
local Jewish community in the matter of the arriving
refugees from Europe, which affects the prosperity of
the local Jewish residents as well as in view of the
present political (anti-communistic) and economic
state of North China, the Peking Government and the
Japanese Military Authorities, who are looking after
and giving protection to the Province have had to come
to a conclusion that an unlimited influx of Jewish
refugees into North China will be detrimental to the
country and therefore have decided to restrict the
admission of Jews expelled from Germany, Austria and
Italy for reasons that firstly if there will be too
great a number of these refugees in North China this
will result in them becoming a burden to the Jewish
residents of North China. From the point of view of
affording a friendly protection this may prove for the
permanent Jewish residents of North China also a thing
with negative results, which are not desirable to the
Authorities of the Province.
In the second instance there may be amongst the
refugee Jews from Europe a considerable percentage
of red element, which will increase the communistic
contamination in North China, and this is absolutely
inadmissible from the point of view of the anti-commu-
nistic Authorities of North China.
There are in Tientsin about 1000 local Jews, of
which number 700 have been registered in the Anti-Com-
munistic Committee. Therefore an increased number of
Jews, who would be divided into groups and would not
be on good terms amongst themselves, would interfere
with the peace and good order of the Province and cannot
be permitted.
Consequently not only the Japanese and Chinese are
disquietened about the influx of Jewish refugees from
Europe, but also certain foreign circles express in this
matter quite logical objections. In view of this the
authorities of North China have notified the Eastern
passport centres such as Tangku, Shanghai to give special attention to the matter of
admitting Jewish refugees into North China.
page_data.zh:
- 3 -

整个中国正在进行一场无情的反共战争，并严格基于反共原则行事，同时也正在采取措施保护自己免受共产主义的污染。通过这样做，华北正在整顿其国家和政府事务，并通过保护其民众免受红色污染，同时保护居住在其领土内的外国人，确保他们的利益不被共产主义力量和破坏性的红色影响所摧毁和消灭。

鉴于此，华北当局不得不特别关注从德国、奥地利和意大利涌入远东的犹太人日益增加的情况，这些人作为涉嫌共产主义分子被上述国家驱逐，而且他们可能还将华北视为有利于谋取某种个人私利、损害国家利益的地方。

收到的情报显示，约有6至12名从上述国家被驱逐的犹太人已经抵达华北，特别是天津。当地犹太社区接收了他们，但对于如何安置这些难民表现出极大的焦虑。

考虑到当地犹太社区对来自欧洲的抵达难民的焦虑，这影响了当地犹太居民的繁荣，同时也鉴于华北目前的政治（反共）和经济状况，负责照看和保护该省的北京政府和日本军事当局不得不得出结论：犹太人难民无限制地涌入华北将对国家造成损害，因此决定限制从德国、奥地利和意大利被驱逐的犹太人的入境，理由如下：首先，如果华北有过多此类难民，这将导致他们成为华北犹太居民的负担。从提供友好保护的角度来看，这对华北的永久犹太居民来说也可能产生负面结果，这是该省当局所不希望看到的。

其次，来自欧洲的犹太难民中可能有相当比例是红色分子，这将增加华北的共产主义污染，从华北反共当局的角度来看，这是绝对不可接受的。

天津约有1000名当地犹太人，其中700人已在反共委员会登记。因此，数量增加的犹太人，如果他们分成派系且彼此不和，将干扰该省的和平与良好秩序，这是不被允许的。

因此，不仅日本人和中国人对来自欧洲的犹太难民涌入感到不安，某些外国圈子也对此事表达了完全合乎逻辑的反对意见。鉴于此，华北当局已通知塘沽、上海等东方护照签发中心，对允许犹太难民进入华北一事给予特别关注。

✓ Безотвѣтственное выступленіе.

Пользуясь благопріятными обстоятель-
ствами, русская эмиграція на Востокѣ ве-
детъ большую политическую работу. Бли-
жайшіе къ этой части эмиграціи участники
антикоммунистическаго блока, представи-
тели Японіи, содйствуютъ этой работѣ.
Въ борьбѣ съ коммунизмомъ здѣсь достигну-
та и реализирована идейная взаи-
мопомощь. И очевидно, что эта работа въ
одномъ и томъ же направленіи будетъ про-
ходить успѣшно лишь въ томъ случа, если
какъ съ той, такъ и съ другой стороны не бу-
детъ безотвѣтственныхъ выступленій, такъ
или иначе работу срывающихъ, вносящихъ въ
нее какіе — то диссонансы.
Мы не допускаемъ возможности такихъ
выступленій со стороны нашихъ японскихъ
друзей. Они невозможны потому, что
представители японскаго народа, въ контак-
тѣ съ которыми ведется наша политическая
работа, дѣлаютъ общую политику Япон-
ской имперіи, проводятъ въ жизнь дирек-
тивы своихъ руководящихъ правительствен-
ныхъ центровъ.
Но за то безотвѣтственныя выступле-
нія со стороны не дисциплинированныхъ
представителей русской эмиграціи, къ со-
жалѣнію, имѣютъ до сихъ поръ мѣсто и чрез-
вычайно осложняютъ ходъ общей полити-
ческой работы въ ея русскомъ секторѣ. Эти
выступленія очень похожи на дѣйствія
солдата, который при строжайшемъ прика-
зѣ не стрѣлять безъ команды, вдругъ вы-
стрѣлитъ въ тотъ самый моментъ, когда вы-
стрѣлъ грозитъ сорвать намѣченный планъ
оперативнаго дѣйствія.
Такимъ безотвѣтственнымъ выступленіемъ
въ данный моментъ мы считаемъ всѣмъ извѣ-
стное объявленіе М. Н. Третьякова, помѣ-
щенное въ мѣстныхъ русскихъ газетахъ вчера.
Это выступленіе — самостійничество
человѣка, ни съ кѣмъ и ни съ чмъ не желаю-
щаго считаться. Оно нарушаетъ общій планъ
работы, оно вызываетъ естественное недоу-
мѣніе, оно, наконецъ, ставитъ просто въ глу-
пое положеніе людей къ организаціи,
силу русскаго отдѣла антикоммунистиче-
скаго объединенія составляющихъ.
Это выступленіе очень напоминаетъ
объ анекдотическомъ офицерѣ, который
кричалъ на стройно шедшую въ ногу свою
роту:
— Всѣ, мерзавцы, не въ ногу идете,
лишь одинъ я — въ ногу!—
М. Н. Третьяковъ даже не офицеръ «эми-
грантской роты». Онъ просто рядовой членъ
эмигрантской семьи.
И когда вотъ онъ кричитъ, что мы всѣ,
ну хотя бы та часть эмиграціи, которая
находится въ дружественныхъ отношеніяхъ съ
японцами, идемъ не въ ногу и только онъ,
Третьяковъ, идетъ въ ногу, это какъ-то раздра-
жаетъ и вызываетъ желаніе заставить этого
человѣка, идти не такъ, какъ лично онъ жела-
етъ, а такъ, какъ этого требуетъ наше общее
дѣло, нашъ общій строй.
У насъ нѣтъ возможностей заставить.
Пожалѣть объ этомъ въ данномъ случаѣ очень
приходится.
И въ то же время остается надѣяться,
что тѣ, кто эти возможности имѣютъ и по-
нимаютъ, что самостійность отдѣльныхъ лицъ
вредитъ общему дѣлу, помогутъ намъ исжить
личныя, безотвѣтственныя выступленія,
подобныя выступленію М. Н. Третьякова.
Такія выступленія вредятъ и намъ и на-
шимъ иностраннымъ друзьямъ.

✓ 不负责任的言论。

利用有利形势，东方的俄国移民正在进行大量的政治工作。与这部分移民关系密切的反共集团参与者、日本代表，正在协助这项工作。在反共斗争中，这里已经实现并落实了思想上的互助。显然，这种同一方向的工作只有在双方都不出现以这样或那样的方式破坏工作、引入某种不和谐音的不负责任言论的情况下，才能顺利进行。

我们不认为我们的日本朋友会有此类言论。这是不可能的，因为与我们进行政治接触的日本人民代表，执行的是日本帝国的总体政策，贯彻其政府指导中心的指令。

然而，不幸的是，纪律松散的俄国移民代表所发表的不负责任言论，至今仍有发生，并极大地复杂化了其俄语部门总体政治工作的进程。这些言论非常像一名士兵的行为，他在接到严禁擅自开枪的命令后，却在可能破坏既定作战行动计划的那一刻突然开枪。

我们认为，目前众所周知的、刊登在昨日当地俄文报纸上的 M. N. 特列季亚科夫（M. N. Tretyakov）的声明，就是这样一种不负责任的言论。

这是一种不愿与任何人或任何事协商的个人独断行为。它破坏了总体工作计划，引起了自然的困惑，最终使那些构成反共联合组织俄语部门力量的人们陷入了尴尬的境地。

这一言论让人想起那个关于可笑军官的笑话，他对整齐划一正步走的连队大喊：
— 所有混蛋，你们都走错了步子，只有我— 走对了！—

M. N. 特列季亚科夫甚至不是“移民连队”的军官。他只是移民家庭中的一名普通成员。

当他大喊说我们所有人，哪怕是与日本人保持友好关系的那部分移民，都走错了步子，只有他特列季亚科夫走对了步子时，这在某种程度上令人恼火，并使人希望迫使这个人不是按照他个人的意愿，而是按照我们共同事业、我们共同体制的要求去行动。

我们没有能力去强制。在这种情况下，我们不得不对此表示遗憾。

与此同时，我们仍希望那些拥有这种能力并理解个人独断会损害共同事业的人，能帮助我们消除类似 M. N. 特列季亚科夫言论这样的个人不负责任的言论。

此类言论既损害我们也损害我们的外国朋友。

编辑委员会。

限制德国和意大利犹太人进入华北。

除共产主义苏联外，整个人类世界越来越清楚地认识到共产主义传染的可怕危险，虽然缓慢但坚定地开始采取对抗共产主义的措施；而华北，顺应整个中国的局势——在中国正进行着无情的反共斗争，并基于严格的反共原则行事——也在采取措施保护自己免受共产主义瘟疫的侵害。

通过这种方式，华北正在净化其民族和国家生活，并在保护其人口免受红色感染的同时，也庇护居住在其领土上的外国人，保护他们的利益免受共产主义力量和具有全面破坏性的红色影响的毁灭和破坏。

基于这一基本立场，华北当局被迫关注从德国、奥地利和意大利作为涉嫌共产主义分子被驱逐的犹太人不断涌入远东的情况，这些人还可能将华北视为有利于进行某种损害国家生活的个人剥削的国家。

据现有消息，已有6至12名从上述欧洲国家被驱逐的犹太人抵达华北，特别是天津。当地犹太殖民区接收了他们，但对如何安置这些难民表现出许多担忧。

考虑到当地犹太居民对安置来自欧洲的抵达难民的担忧，这一问题与当地犹太常住居民的生活福祉有关；同时也鉴于华北目前的政治（反共）和经济状况，北京政府和负责保卫该地区安全和秩序的日本军事当局，被迫得出结论：犹太人难民无限制地进入华北境内将对国家造成损害，因此决定限制从德国、奥地利和意大利被驱逐的犹太人的入境。其依据是：第一，如果华北有大量上述难民，这将给华北犹太人带来沉重负担。而从对华北犹太常住居民提供友好庇护的角度来看，上述现象可能会给他们带来负面结果和后果，这是该地区当局完全不希望看到的。

第二，来自欧洲的犹太难民中可能有许多红色分子，这将在华北增加和加强传播共产主义瘟疫的红色细胞，从反共的华北角度来看，这是绝对不允许的。

天津当地犹太人约有1000人，其中约700人已在反共委员会注册。因此，向这一数字增加犹太人，这些人分裂成派系并因此彼此间存在误解，将进一步加剧犹太人的内讧，从而破坏国家生活的秩序，这是不能被允许的。

基于以上所有原因，不仅日本人和中国人对来自欧洲的犹太难民涌入感到担忧，而且某些外国圈子也对此表达了完全合乎逻辑的担忧。因此，华北当局已通知塘沽、山海关、哈尔滨和上海等远东护照签发点，要求后者对放行犹太难民进入华北一事给予应有的重视。

CHINA PRESS.

NOV 25 1938

Russian Periodical

Editor, THE CHINA PRESS
Sir,—The appearance of the new Russian periodical “Russky Golos” (Russian Voice) quite naturally provides food for thought to an average Russian resident of Shanghai, inasmuch as the above paper lives fully to the expectations of the present “Wayside populace,” the same being nothing short of a Japanese sheet in Russian language sponsored by the ultra-reactionary factions of the present emigrant colony.

“Russky Golos” differs but a little from her sisters up the North in the “occupied” territory where the freedom of expressing oneself is a forgotten thing of the glorious past and where the absolute subjection alone provides the only means of existence.

Lauding the achievements of the “valiant Nipponese” would be a thing quite permissible for the above sheet, should the same “periodical” not trespass the Rubicon by alluding in its own direct misinterpretation the events in the memorable “Astor House” meeting on Nov. 6. “The meeting showing the unity of Anti-Soviet factions” reminds one of an old proverbial saying—“Poor paper suffers anything.”

The unanimous opinion of greater majority of Shanghai public regarding the aforementioned “Astor House” meet as being nothing else but a farce made by and for the benefit of the Japanese authorities at the expense of the credulity of the unsuspecting foreign public, is too well known to need any further comments.

1938年11月25日

俄文期刊

致《字林西报》编辑先生：

新俄文期刊《Russky Golos》（《俄罗斯之声》）的出现，很自然地引起了上海普通俄国居民的思考，因为上述报纸完全符合当前“路边大众”的期望，它无非是一份由当前移民殖民地中极端反动派赞助的日文报纸的俄文版。

《Russky Golos》与其在“占领”区北方的姐妹刊物差别不大，在那里，言论自由已成为光荣过去中被遗忘的事物，只有绝对的服从才是唯一的生存手段。

如果上述“期刊”没有通过直接歪曲11月6日著名的“礼查饭店”会议事件而越过卢比孔河的话，赞美“英勇的日本人”的成就对该报来说本是完全可以允许的。“展示反苏派系团结的会议”让人想起一句古老的谚语——“可怜的纸张忍受一切。”

上海公众绝大多数人对上述“礼查饭店”会议的一致看法是，这不过是一场由日本当局策划并为其利益服务、以 unsuspecting（毫无戒心的）外国公众的轻信为代价的闹剧，这一观点众所周知，无需进一步评论。

Sunday, October 30, 1938.

SHANGHAI OF THE PAST, PRESENT AND FUTURE.

In connection with the 85th anniversary of the existence of the International Settlement of Shanghai on September 21, 1938 coupled with two other great jubilees i.e. the 95th anniversary of the existence of present day Shanghai and the 85th anniversary of the institution of the Shanghai Volunteer Corps, a historical data review is given in the above entitled article, the last paragraph of the first part of it reading as follows:-
6) The Anglo-Saxon predominance and reign in the Municipal Council of the Settlement have for many years been severely criticised by Chinese, Japanese and other nationalities residing in the Settlement, but deprived of the rights to participate in the affairs of the city, which demanded a more international administration with an increased number of representatives of other nations in the Council. There are no grounds for the refusal of these demands by the rate-payers, however, the question of reform had not been raised and the regulations, established 75 years ago, which have become ancient and have lost sense, continue to exist.
The section dealing with the present status of Shanghai reads as follows in brief:
"Since August 13, 1937, i.e. the opening of hostilities, a large district of the International Settlement of Shanghai, extending to the north and north-West from Soochow Creek found itself in the sphere of military operations and in it prevails the control of Japanese Military Authorities. This control does not affect the French Concession and the part of the International Settlement south of the Soochow Creek.
The territory occupied is governed by the Japanese Naval Landing Party, the Japanese Police and Gendarmerie and the Japanese Consular Police.
Between the Council of the International Settlement and the Consular Body on the one side and the Japanese Authorities on the other, there exist great differences of opinion with regard to the new status of Shanghai in particular and that of China in general.
These differences of opinion arise from the following:-
(1) On January 4, 1938 the Japanese Authorities presented to the Shanghai Municipal Council a number of demands pertaining to the change of the existing status. On February 15, 1938 the British, French and American Authorities declined the Japanese demands re the reforms to be effected in the Municipal Council of Shanghai and continue to regard Shanghai as their colony.
(2) On January 25, 1938, General Tada Hayao, commander-in-chief of the Japanese Troops in central China, stated that foreigners do not wish to recognize the presence of Japanese troops in Shanghai, although they realize that such presence is useless to oppose Japan and it is impossible to maintain the protection of foreign interests without them.
"All that happens in Shanghai is under the control of my responsibility. I will not allow any violation of the neutrality of the International Settlement nor will I permit any person to interfere in the internal affairs of China or to use foreign concessions as bases for anti-Japanese activities." Mr. Tada's statement was made on January 25, 1938, shortly after the fall of Nanking.

（批：Dec B.）
（印：FILE）
P. A. to D. C. (Bn. Br.)

过去的、现在的和未来的上海。

鉴于1938年9月21日是上海公共租界成立85周年纪念日，加之另外两个重大庆典，即现今上海存在95周年纪念日以及上海万国商团成立85周年纪念日，上述标题的文章对历史资料进行了回顾，其第一部分最后一段内容如下：-
6) 工部局董事会中英美人士的主导地位和统治多年来受到居住在租界内但被剥夺参与城市事务权利的中国人、日本人及其他国籍人士的严厉批评，他们要求实行更加国际化的管理，并在董事会中增加其他国家的代表人数。纳税人拒绝这些要求并无理由，然而，改革问题并未被提出，75年前制定的、已变得陈旧且失去意义的规章仍然继续存在。
关于上海现状的部分简要表述如下：
“自1937年8月13日战事爆发以来，上海公共租界向北及西北延伸至苏州河的大片区域处于军事行动范围内，该区域由日本军方当局控制。这种控制不影响法租界和苏州河以南的公共租界部分。
被占领土由日本海军陆战队、日本警察和宪兵以及日本领事警察管辖。
一方面，公共租界工部局和领事团与另一方面，日本当局之间，就上海特别是中国的新的地位问题存在巨大分歧。
这些分歧源于以下原因：-
(1) 1938年1月4日，日本当局向上海公共租界工部局提出了一系列关于改变现有地位的要求。1938年2月15日，英、法、美当局拒绝了日本关于在上海工部局实施改革的要求，并继续将上海视为其殖民地。
(2) 1938年1月25日，华中日军总司令多田骏中将表示，外国人不愿承认日军在上海的存在，尽管他们意识到没有日军就无法反对日本，也无法在没有日军的情况下维持对外国利益的保护。
‘上海发生的一切都在我的责任控制之下。我不允许任何违反公共租界中立的行为，也不允许任何人干涉中国内政或利用外国租界作为反日活动的基地。’多田先生的声明发表于1938年1月25日，即南京沦陷后不久。

（批注：Dec B.）
（印章：FILE）

(3) 1938年3月10日，新任华中日军总司令畑俊六将军在接受记者采访时表达的观点是，只有在外围列强干涉日军军事行动的情况下，才可能与外国势力发生冲突。
(4) 松井将军和畑将军一直非常关注国际租界问题，并多次表示，只要华中新政权保持与日本的友好关系并对国民党及共产党宣战，日军准备支持该新政权。
(5) 1938年3月22日，日本首相近卫文麿公爵在下议院受询时表示，目前很难说日军行动的限度在哪里。“我能说的只是，日本已坚决决定不放弃日军占领的一寸领土。政府也在准备开发被占领土的工业和经济财富。”
(6) 在北京报纸《新民报》1938年1月23日的一期中，发表了一篇题为《废除中国在沪租界》的文章，表达了华北中国政府圈子的观点，其中指出日本打算帮助中国消除外国人的治外法权，手段与在满洲国实现的方式相同。文章评论称，“日本已承诺改善中国条件并在神圣斗争中取得胜利，并为中国收回所有租界，因为它们只是罪犯的避风港，充斥着最恶劣的人群”。

1938年10月25日获悉，日本当局与上海公共租界工部局就改善苏州河以北上海北部地区的生活条件事宜达成某些协议。
赤木先生已被任命为公共租界警务处总监的日本籍助理，他将负责北部地区的警务以及被占领土内的警察局。
希望此后，包括清洁、街道照明和缴纳市政捐税在内的所有其他问题也能得到有利解决，迄今为止绝大多数人未缴纳市政捐税，因为被占领土未使用任何市政服务。

在第三部分关于未来上海的内容中，该报指出：-
“权威消息来源表明，作为亚洲稳定因素的日本，主要关注使中国成为一个独立国家，在这种情况下，在其领土上存在外国租界和 concessions 对一个大国来说是一个可耻且不可接受的事实。

（批注：显然基于Waspael J.B目前的状况）
