Having undertaken the obligation to improve
conditions of living for the population of China
and to assist its Government in all matters, it may
be expected in the near future that the unequal treaties
and extraterritorial rights of foreigners in the territory
of China will be abolished.
This will first of all affect Tientsin, Shanghai and
Canton. Such measures of the Reformed Government of China
will probably give rise to protests from the Foreign Powers,
but they will have to accept this measure.
Our collaborator has been assured that China and
Japan will be inflexible in this matter and should the
Foreign Powers resort to arms for the protection of their
interests, their challenge will be accepted without hesi-
tation.
It is proposed to establish free ports for all nations
of the world in Tientsin, Shanghai and Canton, and one
Municipality for each city with the inclusion of repre-
sentatives of all nationalities in proportion to the
number of population.
Therefore it may be expected, soon, that represen-
tatives of those nationalities who up to now have been
deprived of the right to govern the city, will be admitted
into the administrative spheres of this city.
Such measures, will no doubt, result in an extraordi-
nary flourishing, development and intensive trading and
industrial activity in Tientsin, Shanghai and Canton and
these ports will become leaders in the world trade in the
Pacific.
Old China, with its foreign settlements, antediluvian
regulations, merchants culture and customs is on the wane
and in its wake there will be a new China and new free
people with new culture.
We welcome this regeneration of China to a new life.

------------------S------------------

JAPAN-CHINA CONFLICT.
------------------------------------
(Speech of Mr. Fujiwara, Japanese Representative
at the International Congress of the "World Service"
at Erfuhrt, on September 14, 1938).

Addressing the above Congress, Mr. Fujiwara, extensively
referred to Japan's collaboration with the "World Service"
movement in opposing Jewish influence in general and in
his country and China in particular. He maintained that
the Jews who had settled down in Japan were gradually
indoctrinating the country with a type of literature designed
to offset the existing state of things, etc. and claimed
this to be a menace. He furthermore stated that the pre-
sent conflict has also been instigated by the Jewish and
Masonic elements in China and that Japan had to protect
herself against the common enemy and felt sure that Japan
was really fighting for any, which representative change-
ful that is, that China as a country as the whole. He
also referred to Japan's friendship with the Soviet Union
and the danger of Communism in the country in consequence
particularly since the Civil War. With Chiang Kai Shek's
life and in danger unless he agreed to co-operate with
the Soviet.

- 3 -

既然承担了改善中国人民生活条件并在所有事务上协助其政府的义务，可以预期在不久的将来，不平等条约和外国人在中国领土上的治外法权将被废除。
这将首先影响天津、上海和广州。中国维新政府的此类措施可能会引起外国列强的抗议，但他们将不得不接受这一措施。
我们的合作者得到保证，中国和日本在此事上将坚定不移，如果外国列强诉诸武力以保护其利益，他们的挑战将被毫不犹豫地接受。
提议在天津、上海和广州为世界各国建立自由港，并为每个城市设立一个市政府，其中包括按人口比例分配的所有国籍的代表。
因此，可以预期，那些迄今为止被剥夺城市管理权的国籍的代表将很快被纳入该城市的行政领域。
这些措施无疑将导致天津、上海和广州出现非凡的繁荣、发展以及密集的贸易和工业活动，这些港口将成为太平洋世界贸易的领导者。
拥有外国租界、史前法规、商人文化和习俗的旧中国正在衰落，随之而来的将是一个拥有新文化的新中国和新的自由人民。
我们欢迎中国获得新生。

------------------S------------------

中日冲突。
------------------------------------
（藤原先生，日本代表，于1938年9月14日在埃尔福特举行的“世界服务”国际大会上的演讲）。

在上述大会上发言时，藤原先生广泛提及日本与“世界服务”运动的合作，以反对一般意义上的犹太影响力，特别是在其国家和中国的影响力。他声称，定居在日本的犹太人正逐渐用旨在抵消现有事态等的文学作品灌输该国，并称这是一种威胁。他进一步指出，当前的冲突也是由中国境内的犹太人和共济会分子煽动的，日本必须保护自己免受共同敌人的侵害，并确信日本确实是在为任何……（原文不清）……也就是说，为中国作为一个整体而战。他还提到了日本与苏联的友谊以及该国共产主义的危险，特别是在内战之后。除非蒋介石同意与苏联合作，否则他的生命将面临危险。

Mr. Fujiwara puts the blame of the Japan China conflict
on China, who is alleged to have provoked the conflict
by frequently attacking Japanese troops and the massacre
of peaceful residents including women and children. Japan
did not really wish this conflict to become general, but
it was forced upon her when in August 1937 Chinese attempted
to exterminate 20,000 Japanese residents and drown them in
the Yangtze; moreover they were always penetrating neutral
zones established five years ago by Japan and other Great
Powers, etc. Japan had to defend herself against this
Bolshevist movement. He emphasized that the war has been
inspired by Masonry although there are still people who
are inclined to believe that Japan is engaged in the con-
flict for her own advantages and to extend her possessions.
He begged the Congress to announce to the entire world
that had the Japanese not accepted the challenge of the
Chinese Masons, they would have been expelled from China's
territory and China would have become bolshevist. Such
was the aim of the masonic influences. He added that the
Japanese are not fighting China, but China's government in
the person of Chiang Kai Shek ie. the Jewish-Masonic Bolshe-
vist government and will do so, until the final extermination
of same. This was the reason too that Japan did not declare
war on China. In order to save China from the claws of
Jews, Masons and Bolsheviks Japan has already sacrificed
60,000 soldiers. China will recover through this sacrifice.
In conclusion Mr. Fujiwara assured the Assembly of a
closer co-operation with the "World Service" and that he
would influence some prominent Chinese to come to Erfurt
also so that they would join in the Movement and thus in
time detach 400 million Chinese from Jews and Masons.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE SPECIAL BRANCH 4/2 11/11/38）

藤原先生将中日冲突的责任归咎于中国，据称中国通过频繁攻击日军和屠杀包括妇女和儿童在内的和平居民而挑起冲突。日本并不真的希望这场冲突扩大化，但在1937年8月，当中国人试图消灭2万名日本居民并将他们淹死在长江中时，日本被迫应战；此外，他们还总是渗透进日本和其他大国五年前建立的中立区等。日本必须防御这种布尔什维克运动。他强调，这场战争是由共济会煽动的，尽管仍有人倾向于相信日本参与冲突是为了自身利益和扩张其领地。他恳请大会向全世界宣布，如果日本人不接受中国共济会员的挑战，他们将被驱逐出中国领土，中国将变成布尔什维克国家。这就是共济会影响力的目的。他补充说，日本人不是在与中国作战，而是在与以蒋介石为代表的中国政府，即犹太-共济会-布尔什维克政府作战，并将如此行事，直到将其彻底消灭。这也是日本未对中国宣战的原因。为了将中国从犹太人、共济会员和布尔什维克的魔爪中拯救出来，日本已经牺牲了6万名士兵。中国将通过这种牺牲得到恢复。
最后，藤原先生向大会保证将与“世界服务”进行更密切的合作，并将影响一些知名中国人也来到埃尔福特，以便他们加入该运动，从而随着时间的推移使4亿中国人脱离犹太人和共济会员的影响。

（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处特别支部 4/2 1938年11月11日）

TRANSLATION FROM THE "RUSSIAN VOICE" (Russky Golos)
Published at 211 Yangtsepoo Road, Wayside, Shanghai,
by the "Russian Voice" Publishing Company. Responsible
Editor A. ANTONOFF. Sunday, Oct. 23, 1938.

We are aware that in connection with the case of M.
Tretiakoff, we are expected to provide something, which would define
our attitude in respect of this matter. This, in particular, because
the whole of the case in question took place in the same territory in
which we live and work i.e. in the wayside district.
We have known M. Tretiakoff for a long time. We know that in
the past, during the years of civil war, he had been assisting the
White army by very generous donations. We know that in his hostile
attitude towards the Bolsheviks he stands out for that immediateness
of his feelings which is inherent in common people. Such people,
once they entertain a certain feeling, they show it, more or less
openly, depending on their character and temperament.
Temperamental, M. Tertiakoff exhibited his political feelings
rather openly in order to draw attention to himself of the general
public. Temperamental, Tretiakoff is one of the outstanding figures
of the famous painting "The Cossack Camp". Such characters as are
on the painting or "A letter to the Turkish Sultan" are drawn simply,
without camouflage and in bold expressions.
Such people seldom stop to think what is allowed and what is
prohibited, whilst at the same time, such people, on recognizing the
authority of some person, are remarkable for their absolute honesty
in fulfilling orders or missions entrusted to them.
M. Tretiakoff found himself in the present situation only
because of the fact that in the midst of Russian emigrants of Shanghai
there was no Russian authority, the power of which would restrain
the temperamental tendencies of a Cossack, who belongs to the era of
"The Cossack Camp" in these extraordinary times.
Furthermore, M. Tertiakoff found himself in this present
situation for reasons of certain persons and groups having attempted
to make use of him for their own political purposes and pushed him
into leading and responsible jobs, to which M. Tretiakoff had not been
prepared and in which he greatly risked to become a screen. We are,
therefore, of the opinion that M. Tretiakoff, in the substance of
charges preferred against him, is being punished not alone for his own
faults. These charges, the circumstances of Tretiakoff's arrest, the
very trial of his case are brought about by the abnormal status in which
at the present time the Russian emigrants find themselves.
Being in possession of a Ta-tao passport, and in consequence
of this, finding himself under the protection of a new Chinese govern-
ment, Russian emigrants are at the same time forced, willingly or
unwillingly, to appear in court, which is still that of the Kuomintang
and hostile to the new border authorities. And, so long as this
abnormal state of affairs continues to exist, until then, cases similar
to that of M. Tretiakoff will be decided in a partial manner and,
therefore, to some extent, due to the circumstances in force, illegally
unlawfully.

FILE

The arrest of Volunteers of the Russian Company.
On October 20, three volunteers of the Russian Company,
whilst taking a walk in the district of Shanghai guarded by Japanese
forces, penetrated into the prohibited area, were arrested by
special passes, and were there arrested by Japanese military. So far
the efforts of the officer in charge of the Russian Company to obtain
their release, has been unsuccessful. The Japanese military authorities
are investigating the purpose of their visit into the prohibited area
and they are being faced with such unpleasantnesses as the violation
of military regulations.

Dec. 13
P.A.W.C. (S.P.)

译自《俄罗斯之声》（Russky Golos）
由位于上海杨树浦路211号的“俄罗斯之声”出版公司出版。责任编辑 A. ANTONOFF。1938年10月23日，星期日。

我们意识到，鉴于 M. Tretiakoff 一案，人们期望我们就此事表明我们的态度。这尤其是因为，整个案件发生在我们生活和工作的同一区域，即杨树浦地区。

我们认识 M. Tretiakoff 已久。我们知道，在过去内战期间，他曾通过慷慨的捐赠援助白军。我们知道，在他对布尔什维克的敌对态度中，体现出一种普通民众所特有的情感直率性。这类人一旦产生某种情感，便会根据其性格和气质，或多或少公开地表现出来。

M. Tretiakoff 性情冲动，相当公开地展示其政治情感，以引起公众的注意。性情冲动的 Tretiakoff 是著名画作《哥萨克营地》中的杰出人物之一。画中或《致土耳其苏丹的信》中的人物形象描绘得简单直接，毫无掩饰，表达大胆。

这类人很少停下来思考什么是允许的、什么是禁止的；然而同时，这类人在认可某人的权威后，在执行受托的命令或任务时表现出绝对的诚实。

M. Tretiakoff 陷入目前的境地，仅仅是因为在上海的俄国侨民中缺乏一种能够约束这位属于“哥萨克营地”时代的哥萨克人在非常时期冲动倾向的俄国权威。

此外，M. Tretiakoff 陷入目前的境地，还因为某些个人和团体试图利用他为其政治目的服务，将他推上他并未做好准备的领导性和责任性岗位，使他在其中极大地风险成为挡箭牌。因此，我们认为，就针对 M. Tretiakoff 提出的指控实质而言，他受到的惩罚并非仅因其自身过错。这些指控、Tretiakoff 被捕的情节以及对其案件的审判，均由目前俄国侨民所处的异常状态所导致。

持有大陶（Ta-tao）护照，并因此处于新中国政府保护之下的俄国侨民，同时被迫自愿或非自愿地出庭受审，而该法庭仍属国民党系统，且对新边境当局持敌对态度。只要这种异常状态持续存在，类似 M. Tretiakoff 的案件就会以偏颇的方式裁决，因此在某种程度上，由于现行环境的影响，属于非法或不合法。

档案

俄国连志愿人员被捕。
10月20日，俄国连的三名志愿人员在日军守卫的上海地区散步时，闯入禁区，凭特别通行证进入，随后被日军逮捕。迄今为止，负责俄国连的军官为争取释放他们所做的努力均未成功。日本军方正在调查他们进入禁区的目的，他们正面临违反军规等令人不快的指控。

12月13日
P.A.W.C. (S.P.)

Speech of Major Taki, Representative
of Imperial Japan.

“I, Major Taki, Representative of the Nippon Imperial
Army in North China, had, exactly a year ago, the honour of
taking part in the inauguration of the Anti-Communistic
Committee, the real unification of Russian emigration.
Exactly a year ago, when the Russian emigration was
in itself only an amorphous mass, I had wished them to become
a strong anti-communistic and national unity, would have its
joint Russian Home, would deal with the questions affecting
matters of nationality in a brotherly way, would overcome
obstacles in a united way, would create youth worthy of its
nation, would create public discipline and would embrace
in its activities all matters pertaining to personal, public and
state life in north china. And finally would hold high the
flag of Russian Emigration in the East.
A year has gone by and to-day we see that Russian
unification has been achieved.
The discord amongst emigrants has vanished, the question
of nationalities has been well dealt with and to general moral
satisfaction, at the same time, filling the ranks of anti-
communistic emigration with people of both East and West, which
speaks well of the correct administration of the Anti-Communis-
tic Committee.
The White Russian Home has become a home for all.
Obstacles were done away with by general co-operation and
from this unification, the mutual understanding and mutual
respect amongst the emigrants has increased and the continuation
of the course taken is no longer one to be feared for the
Emigration.
Russian youth in north china is growing stronger in ideas,
and nationally stronger too and is being formed into One and
whole unity.
Sensible realisation of public discipline is penetrating
all the ranks of emigrants and their activities, unemployment is
minimised, the emigrants are gradually taking up active parti-
cipation in state reconstruction of north China and thus prove
that they are not only loyal, but also useful members of the
State.
And the flag of Russian Emigration in north China is
becoming for all honourary whilst the face of emigration
one calling for general respect.
We rejoice at that and we see that our hopes for an
idealistic and national presence of strength amongst the
emigrants are being realised and I sincerely congratulate
Russian emigrants with the success attained on national
Anti-Communistic and Life fronts, whereas I have the right
to greet the Anti-Communistic front with the glad tidings that
the Russian Section of it is becoming larger and stronger.
The past year has been one of success and the future
year should still be better.
I greet the Emigrants”!

News from the Congress of World Service
at Erfuhrt.

At the International Congress held at Erfuhrt from
September 1 to 4th, Mr. Fujiwara, Japanese representative,
made a most interesting report on the Japan-China Conflict.
This report will be published in the next issue of the "Russian
Voice". The world wide international organisation since
1933 is engaged in exposing the activities of Jews, Masons and
Communists in all parts of the world and the Japanese society
has joined it, composed of members interested in those sponsored
by the organisation of the World Service.

大佐泷（Taki）少校演讲，
日本帝国代表。

“我，泷少校，日本帝国陆军华北代表，恰好在一年前，有幸参加了反共委员会的成立仪式，这是俄国侨民真正的统一。
恰好在一年前，当俄国侨民本身只是一群乌合之众时，我曾希望他们成为一个强大的反共和民族统一体，拥有共同的俄国人之家，以兄弟般的方式处理涉及民族事务的问题，团结一致克服障碍，创造无愧于其民族的青年，建立公共纪律，并在其活动中涵盖所有与华北个人、公共和国家生活有关的事项。最后，高举东方俄国侨民的旗帜。
一年过去了，今天我们可以看到，俄国人的统一已经实现。
侨民之间的不和已经消失，民族问题得到了妥善处理，令公众在道德上感到满意，同时，东西方人士充实了反共侨民的队伍，这证明了反共委员会管理的正确性。
白俄之家已成为所有人的家园。
通过普遍合作消除了障碍，通过这种统一，侨民之间的相互理解和相互尊重增加了，继续沿着既定路线前进不再令侨民感到恐惧。
华北的俄国青年在思想上日益强大，在民族性上也更加坚强，并正在形成一个完整统一的整体。
对公共纪律的理性认识正渗透到所有侨民阶层及其活动中，失业现象降至最低，侨民逐渐积极参与华北的国家重建，从而证明他们不仅是忠诚的，而且是国家有用的成员。
华北俄国侨民的旗帜正变得光荣，而侨民的面貌也赢得了普遍的尊重。
我们为此感到高兴，我们看到我们在侨民中实现理想主义和民族力量存在的希望正在成为现实，我衷心祝贺俄国侨民在民族反共和生活战线上取得的成就，同时我有理由以喜讯问候反共战线，即其俄国分部正变得更大、更强。
过去的一年是成功的一年，未来的一年应该更好。
我向侨民们致敬！”

------------------

来自埃尔福特世界服务大会的消息。

在9月1日至4日于埃尔福特举行的国际大会上，日本代表藤原先生就日中冲突做了一份非常有趣的报告。该报告将刊登在下一期《俄罗斯之声》上。这个全球性的国际组织自1933年以来一直致力于揭露世界各地犹太人、共济会和共产主义者的活动，日本社会也已加入其中，其成员对该世界服务组织所赞助的项目感兴趣。

ORDER NO. I OF THE
CENTRAL ANTI-COMMUNISTIC COMMITTEE OF RUSSIAN
EMIGRANTS IN NORTH CHINA.
Tientsin. October 9, 1938.
----------------------------------------

Par. 1.
On this day of October 9, 1938 The Central Anti-Communistic
Committee of Russian Emigrants in North China has been
inaugurated and given recognition by the Authorities of North
China.

Par. 2.
The whole of Russian emigration of North China comes within
the sphere of the C.A.C. through the medium of other anti-
communistic centres namely Committees and Representatives of
cities.

Par. 3.
Henceforth the committees in various parts will be known
as: The Peking Anti-Communistic Committee of Russian Emigrants
in North China, the Tientsin Anti-communistic Committee of
Russian emigrants in North China, the Tsingtao Anti-Communistic
Committee of Russian Emigrants in North China and the Kalgan
Anti-Communistic Representative of Russian Emigrants in North
China.

Par. 4.
The following have been appointed as members of the
Board of C.A.C.: E.N. Pastukhin, Chairman, D.I. Semenoff
in Charge of Economic Section, V.D. Kosmin, in Charge of
Cultural and Education Section, S.Karaeff in Charge of the
Registrar, and N.M. Gubanoff Secretary.
Members to attend conferences of the C.A.C.: Chairmen
of the Committees of Peking, Tientsin, Tsingtao, the Represen-
tative of Kalgan and representatives of Russian national
organisations.

Par. 5.
As from October 9, 1938 the Kalgan Anti-Communistic
Representative Centre of Russian Emigrants in North China
is being inaugurated. Mr. Filatoff will be the Representative
and Mr. Rutkovsky Secretary. Adress: Kalgan, 80 Hsi-Ho-tze.

Par. 6.
E.L. Trukhin is appointed as Chairman of the Tientsin
Anti-Communistic Committee and M.D. Novikoff Chief of its
Economic Section. P.I. Malkoff will be in Charge of the
Registrar of this committee.

(military section)

Par. 1.
In connection with the inauguration in Kalgan of an
Anti-Communistic Representative Centre, Captain Filatoff, its
Chairman, will also act as Chief of the Kalgan Section of
North China District of Far Eastern Military Union.

Ed: E. Pastukhin, Chairman
of the C.A. Committee.

华北俄国侨民中央反共委员会
第一号命令。
天津。1938年10月9日。
----------------------------------------

第1条。
1938年10月9日这一天，华北俄国侨民中央反共委员会正式成立，并获得华北当局的认可。

第2条。
华北全体俄国侨民均纳入中央反共委员会（C.A.C.）的范围，途径是通过其他反共中心，即各城市的委员会和代表。

第3条。
此后，各地委员会名称如下：华北俄国侨民北京反共委员会、华北俄国侨民天津反共委员会、华北俄国侨民青岛反共委员会以及华北俄国侨民张家口反共代表。

第4条。
以下人员被任命为中央反共委员会董事会成员：E.N. Pastukhin，主席；D.I. Semenoff，经济部主任；V.D. Kosmin，文化与教育部主任；S. Karaeff，注册官负责人；N.M. Gubanoff，秘书。
出席中央反共委员会会议的成员包括：北京、天津、青岛委员会主席，张家口代表以及俄国民族组织的代表。

第5条。
自1938年10月9日起，华北俄国侨民张家口反共代表中心正式成立。Filatoff 先生任代表，Rutkovsky 先生任秘书。地址：张家口，西河子80号。

第6条。
E.L. Trukhin 被任命为天津反共委员会主席，M.D. Novikoff 任其经济部主任。P.I. Malkoff 将负责该委员会的注册官工作。

（军事部分）

第1条。
鉴于在张家口成立反共代表中心，该中心主席 Filatoff 上尉还将兼任远东军事联盟华北区张家口分部主任。

编辑：E. Pastukhin，中央反共委员会主席。

Newspaper "Russian Voice".

I have spoken with Purin. His attitude is quite
reasonable and he expresses his determination not to be
dictated to by his "masters". He has just been discharged from
hospital and had nothing to do with the offending article.
He assures me that it is his intention to keep his columns
within reason and if the Japanese demand that he go further

him have his certificate.

S. B. REGISTRY
No. S. B. D. 8149. F. S. 2
Date 19 10 38

Special Branch,
October 18, 1938.

Commissioner,

Sir,

Newspaper, "Russian Voice"

The editor of this paper is one Purin whom
I interviewed two weeks ago. He admitted he
was in Japanese pay but promised he would do all
in his power to keep the paper clean. On the
strength of that assurance I told him the S.M.P.
would furnish him with a certificate for his paper.
From the attached extracts, however, it is only
too apparent that he is simply a channel for
Japanese propaganda. In the circumstances I
suggest the certificate, which has been prepared,
be withheld and that he be informed that the sale
of his paper south of the Creek will be prohibited.

Jhr Robertson
Deputy Commissioner,
Special Branch.

（批：You might just take
the matter up with him & see
his attitude as to attached）

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
19 OCT. 1938

该报编辑名为 Purin，我两周前曾与其面谈。他承认领取日本人的薪水，但承诺将尽其所能保持报纸的纯洁性。基于该保证，我告知他工部局警务处将为其报纸提供许可证。然而，从附带的摘录中可以明显看出，他仅仅是日本宣传的渠道。在此情况下，我建议扣留已准备好的许可证，并通知他禁止在苏州河以南地区销售其报纸。

Translation from Russian weekly newspaper "RUSSIAN VOICE",
October 16, 1938. Published by the "Russian Voice"
Publishing Co., 211 Yangtsepoo Road. Editor - Mr. A.A.
Purin (Antonoff).

------------------

1. Article entitled "Impending reorganization".

"The question of restoration to the S.M.C. of the
occupied districts has not so far been given consideration
by the Japanese Military Authorities, and the districts in
question are regarded as a part of the military occupation
zone. It is reported from authoritative sources that the
administration of these districts will be reorganized, the
proposed changes affecting all sides of life there. One
of the most important questions in future will be a reor-
ganization of the S.M.C. and the inclusion in the Council
of representatives of all national communities existing in
the International Settlement. Under no circumstances will
British representatives be allowed to regard international
Shanghai as their colonial town. It is reported from well
informed sources that Japanese police officers should be in
charge of the Municipal Police stations in the districts
North of creek at present occupied by the Japanese, and
that the police staff will have an international character.
A reorganization is also planned of all administrative
institutions in the area around Shanghai at present under
control of the Japanese authorities."

（批：W.C. / Sp. Beach / C. 4/10）

2. Article entitled "Japanese firm policy".

"Official Japanese sources point dissatisfaction over
the fact that the S.M.C. has caused a group of policemen
from British, American, Chinese and Italian nationality
units and thus in the face of opposition by the police to
prevent what the Japanese have termed 'illegal' activities
in Shanghai. The said sources state that..."
page_data.zh:
译自俄文周报《RUSSIAN VOICE》（《俄罗斯之声》），
1938年10月16日出版。由“Russian Voice”
出版公司发行，地址：杨树浦路211号。编辑——A.A.
普林先生（安东诺夫）。

------------------

1. 题为“即将进行的改组”的文章。

“日本军方当局迄今尚未考虑将占领区
归还给上海公共租界工部局（S.M.C.）的问题，上述
地区被视为军事占领区的一部分。据权威消息来源称，
这些地区的行政机构将进行改组，拟议的变更将影响
当地生活的方方面面。未来的最重要问题之一将是工
部局的改组，以及在董事会中纳入国际租界内所有存
在的民族群体的代表。在任何情况下，都不允许英国
代表将国际化的上海视为他们的殖民城镇。据消息灵
通人士透露，日本警官应负责目前被日本人占领的苏
州河以北地区的各巡捕房，且警察队伍将具有国际化
性质。目前处于日本当局控制下的上海周边地区的所有
行政机构也计划进行改组。”

（批注：W.C. / Sp. Beach / C. 4/10）

2. 题为“日本的坚定政策”的文章。

“日本官方消息来源指出，对工部局从英国、
美国、中国和意大利籍警队中抽调一组警察，从而在
警方反对的情况下阻止日本人所谓的在上海的‘非法’
活动这一事实表示不满。上述消息来源称……”

page_data.en:

However, for reasons unknown, these candidates cannot
obtain employment. It appears from conversations with
the new-comers that they were unemployed in London. The
"London Bobbies" in their conversations also praise
Stalin and the U.S.S.R. It is said that Japanese rate-
payers will raise this question in the Shanghai Municipal
Council."

3. Article entitled "Incomprehensible apology."

"The Shanghai Municipal Council expressed their deep
regrets over the unfortunate incident in the interned
Chinese soldiers' camp, when during the quelling of a riot
caused by them, several men were fatally injured. Families
of those who died from injuries received were given $1,000
each by the S.M.C."

- - - - - - -

在谈话中也赞扬斯大林和苏联。据说日本纳税人将在

August 22, 38
The Graphic Printing & Publishing Co., - change of address.

Information has been received that the equipment
of the Graphic Printing & Publishing Co., 473 Route Cardinal Mer-
cier, formerly owned by D.I. Costoff, has been purchased by cer-
tain Japanese and on 21-8-38 removed to 211 Yangtsepoo Road
where it is temporarily stored at present.
This is believed to be the first step towards the
realisation of the much discussed plan of starting an anti-commu-
nist publication in the Japanese occupied area of Shanghai where
it will be immune from any interference on the part of the police.
Further report will be submitted on this matter
when a more detailed information is available.

(Special Branch) Office Notes
Commissioner.
Sir,
Reference attached application for newspaper
registration and report thereon, there is a strong possibi-
lity of the paper being utilized for Japanese propaganda.
Mr. Purin candidly admits that he expects a subsidy from
the Japanese.
Summing up all the pros and cons, I think the best
course would be to give the paper registration and in the
event of any undesirable matter appearing in its columns, the
question of withdrawal of the certificate and prohibition of
sale of the paper south of the Creek could be considered.
（批：I agree, much better present relations than break off before giving him a chance. He is very anti- French & may be treated amicably if treated tactfully）

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / S. B. REGISTRY / Spec. Branch D. Branch / File No. 8494/32 / 28 / 10 / 38）

REPORT

Subject The "Russian Voice" (Russky Golos)

Made by and Forwarded by C. D. L. Ross

With reference to the application for registration
of the weekly paper "Russian Voice", Mr. A.A. Purin (pen name
A. Antonoff), the responsible editor, was interviewed at
headquarters on September 28. Asked regarding the general
policy of his paper, he explained that the main objects of the
"Russian Voice" were (1) to expose the harmful activities of
the Comintern and (2) to unify Russian anti-communist elements.
He admitted that his group hoped to obtain a subsidy from the
Japanese Military Mission in Shanghai for the publication of
the paper and mentioned that similar arrangements were in force
between Russian anti-communist groups and Japanese Military
Missions in Harbin, Tientsin, Tsingtao, etc. He made no attempt
to deny the pro-Japanese character of the "Russian Voice"
explaining it by the "realities of the situation" and also
by the fact that Japan opposed communism. In his capacity of
responsible editor, Mr. Purin continued, he would do everything
in his power to keep the paper within the bounds of moderate-
ness, to avoid publishing any matter likely to prejudice
the good relations between the Russian community and the
authorities of the foreign settlements and to refrain from
anything that might lead to a breach of peace and order or
come within the term of "mud-slinging".

He was of the impression that in view of the fact
that he had been connected with the Japanese since 1919,
having formerly held certain responsible posts in the Russian
Far East and also participated in the activities of the
International Anti-Communist League (established by Mr. Ober,
Switzerland), his opinion carried a certain amount of weight

报告

主题 《俄罗斯之声》（Russky Golos）

制作人及转呈人 C. D. L. Ross

关于周刊《俄罗斯之声》的注册申请，责任
编辑 A.A. 普林先生（笔名 A. Antonoff）于9月28日在
总部接受了问询。当被问及该报的总体方针时，他解
释说，《俄罗斯之声》的主要目标是 (1) 揭露共产国际
的有害活动，以及 (2) 团结俄国反共分子。
他承认，他的团体希望从上海日本军事代表团
获得出版该报的补贴，并提到在哈尔滨、天津、青岛
等地，俄国反共团体与日本军事代表团之间也存在类似
的安排。他并未试图否认《俄罗斯之声》的亲日性质，
而是用“局势的现实”以及日本反对共产主义这一事实
来解释。普林先生继续说道，作为责任编辑，他将竭尽
全力使该报保持适度，避免发表任何可能损害俄国侨民
社区与外国租界当局之间良好关系的内容，并避免任何
可能导致破坏和平秩序或属于“恶意诽谤”范畴的行为。

他认为，鉴于他自1919年以来一直与日本人
有联系，此前曾在俄国远东担任某些重要职务，并参与
了国际反共联盟（由瑞士的奥伯先生建立）的活动，因
此他的意见在他的

French Municipal Police.
（印：CONFIDENTIAL）
Shanghai, September 22, 1938
Report No. 2896/S

Subject: The "Russky Golos" ("Russian Voice"), a weekly paper.
Reference: Consulting Committee of Russian Affairs attached to
Japanese Headquarters in Shanghai.
A. Purin.
Report No 2869/S of September 15, 1938.

Further to the information given in report No. 2869/S of Sep-
tember 15, 1938, the first issue of the Russian weekly "Russky Golos"
( Russian Voice ) appeared on September 15, 1938. The paper is being
printed by the Graphic Printing Works, a new concern established at
No 211 Yangtzepoo Road. The editorial offices of the paper are locat-
ed at this address. It was formerly located in the French Concession
( see report No 2781/S of August 24, 1938 ).

The official editor of the paper is one N.I. Djogaline. Ac-
tually the direction of the paper is in the hands of one A. Purin,
a pro-Japanese newspaperman, who is well known to the French Police
and who is connected with the Japanese Intelligence Service. Purin
was expelled from the French Concession under Consular Ordinance
No. 8 of January 3, 1938. He is at present living at No. 130 Baikal
Road.

Djogalin, a minor employee of the Graphic Printing Works, is
only a figure-head. Born at Vilna on December 1, 1908, a stoker-ma-
chinist by profession, Djogalin served with the Russian Auxiliary
Detachment of the French Concession from August 13, 1937 to March 23,
1938, but was dismissed for having resigned before the termination of
his contract.

Djogalin is a member of the Union of the New Generation ( an
anti-Communist Russian organization) and is in close touch with one
Kubanoff, former president of the local branch of this organization.
Attached is his photograph.

第2896/S号报告

主题：周报《Russky Golos》（“俄罗斯之声”）。
参考：驻上海日军总部附属俄罗斯事务咨询委员会。
A. Purin。
1938年9月15日第2869/S号报告。

继1938年9月15日第2869/S号报告中所提供的信息之后，俄罗斯周报《Russky Golos》（俄罗斯之声）第一期于1938年9月15日出版。该报由一家位于杨树浦路211号的新成立机构——Graphic Printing Works（图形印刷所）印刷。该报编辑部设于此地址。此前其编辑部位于法租界（参见1938年8月24日第2781/S号报告）。

该报的正式编辑为N.I. Djogaline。实际上，该报的主持权掌握在A. Purin手中，此人是一名亲日报人，为法国警方所熟知，并与日本情报机关有联系。Purin曾根据1938年1月3日第8号领事条例被驱逐出法租界。他目前居住在贝加尔路130号。

Djogalin是图形印刷所的一名低级职员，仅是一个挂名人物。Djogalin于1908年12月1日出生于维尔纳，职业为司炉机械师，曾于1937年8月13日至1938年3月23日期间在法租界俄罗斯辅助队服役，但因在合同期满前辞职而被解雇。

Djogalin是“新一代联盟”（一个反共俄罗斯组织）的成员，并与该组织当地分部的前主席Kubanoff保持密切联系。附有其照片。

page_data.en:
( 2 )

On September 17, 1938 Djegaline applied to the
Shanghai Municipal Police for the registration of his paper.
The matter is at present under investigation.

The No.1 issue of the paper contains no article of
a violent nature; however, one of our officers informs us that
one of the future issues will contain a detailed account of
the "abduction" and deportation of D. Geustoff from the French
Concession. This article will be written by one N. Ermolaeff,
suspected to be an agent provocateur in the pay of the Japanese
and about whom mention was made in our Report No.2764/8 of
August 17, 1938. In case the account should be considered
too violent for publication in the paper, it will be published
in the form of a pamphlet or circular.

The first issue of the "Russky Goloss" contains 8
pages; its size is 35/48.5 c.m. It is a publication of a
national character and of pro-Japanese tendencies. The paper
defines its policy as follows :- "Organ for the struggle
against communism." The objects of the paper are explained
in a leading article a translation of which is attached.

The following articles are worth noticing :-
(1) An article dealing with the Dah Imo Government.
(2) The object of this government, says the writer,
is to eliminate injustice and to enable all classes of the
Chinese people to enjoy in an equal measure the good things
of life. China has made enormous progress during the past
30 years. Men such as Sun Yat Sen, Chiang Kai-shek, Wang Ching
Wei, T.V. Soong, etc. had contributed greatly to the develop-
ment of the country. However, these leaders who belong to the
old Anglo-American formation, have made many serious mistakes
the principal of which was to ignore the principles indicated
by Sun Yat Sen which affirmed the necessity of securing for
China the friendship and support of Japan. The young Chinese
generation had turned their backs to Japan. This was a signal
page_data.zh:
( 2 )

1938年9月17日，Djegaline向上海公共租界工部局警务处申请登记其报纸。此事目前正在调查中。

该报第一期不包含任何暴力性质的文章；然而，我处一名警官告知我们，其中一期将详细记述D. Geustoff在法租界被“绑架”及驱逐出境一事。该文章将由N. Ermolaeff撰写，此人涉嫌为日本收买的挑衅代理人，在我处1938年8月17日第2764/8号报告中曾提及此人。如果该记述被认为过于激烈而不宜在报上刊登，将以小册子或传单的形式出版。

《Russky Goloss》第一期共8页；尺寸为35/48.5厘米。这是一份具有民族性质且倾向亲日的出版物。该报将其方针定义为：“反共斗争机关”。该报的目标在一篇社论中予以说明，译文附后。

以下文章值得注意：
(1) 一篇关于大维摩夫政府（Dah Imo Government）的文章。
(2) 作者称，该政府的目标是消除不公，使中国各阶层人民平等地享受美好生活。中国在过去30年中取得了巨大进步。孙中山、蒋介石、汪精卫、宋子文等人对国家的发发展做出了巨大贡献。然而，这些属于旧英美体系的领导人犯了许多严重错误，其中主要的是忽视了孙中山所指出的原则，即肯定有必要为中国争取日本的友谊和支持。中国年轻一代背弃了日本。这是一个

page_data.en:
( 3 )

for the disintegration of China. In the Sino-Japanese
conflict, the Kuomintang Government finds itself isolated
and abandoned by the whole world. Its fate is sealed. There
is every reason to believe that the Chinese Republic is at its
last breath. It will be replaced by a Chinese monarchy.
(2) The declaration of General Araki that the Sino-
Japanese conflict can only be settled after the overthrow of
bolshevik power in Russia.
(3) A note dealing with extracts from articles
published by the newspapers of the Mladrossy ("Russian Youths")
in the course of which the writer accuses the youths of being
in sympathy with the Soviet leaders.
(4) Several articles pointing out the necessity of
unifying all Russian emigrants.
(5) Article dealing with the condition of the Russian
colony in Shanghai.
In the course of the article, the writer says that
although Russian interests are adequately protected in Shanghai,
one great disadvantage remains in that Russian residents are
not represented on the Municipal Council in the International
Settlement or French Concession.
"It is to be hoped," he adds, "that this question
will be settled to the advantage of Russians after the
reorganization of all the administrative organs in our city --
a reorganization which will follow the cessation of the Sino-
Japanese hostilities."
(6) Article directed against Mr. N.P. Malinovsky,
Honorary President of the Sakai Athletic Association. In 1925,
Mr. Malinovsky, who was then connected with Soviet circles, was
the author of a pamphlet. The article expresses surprise that
Mr. Malinovsky should be occupying the post of President of an
organization which has a national character.
(7) A note, evidently based on Japanese information,
stating that during his recent stay in Hankow the British
page_data.zh:

中国解体的信号。在中日冲突中，国民党政府发现自己孤立无援，被全世界抛弃。其命运已定。有充分理由相信，中华民国已气息奄奄。它将被一个中国君主制政权所取代。
(2) 荒木大将声明，中日冲突只有在推翻俄罗斯的布尔什维克政权后才能解决。
(3) 一则关于摘录Mladrossy（“俄罗斯青年”）报纸发表文章的笔记，作者在文中指责这些青年同情苏联领导人。
(4) 几篇文章指出统一所有俄罗斯侨民的必要性。
(5) 关于上海俄罗斯侨民状况的文章。
在文章中，作者说，虽然俄罗斯利益在上海得到了充分保护，但仍存在一个重大不利因素，即俄罗斯居民在国际租界或法租界的工部局中没有代表。
他补充说：“希望在我们城市所有行政机构重组后——这一重组将在中日敌对行动停止后进行——这个问题能得到有利于俄罗斯人的解决。”
(6) 针对Sakai体育协会名誉主席N.P. Malinovsky先生的文章。1925年，当时与苏联圈子有联系的Malinovsky先生是一篇小册子的作者。文章对Malinovsky先生担任一个具有民族性质的组织的主席职位表示惊讶。
(7) 一则显然基于日本信息的笔记，称英国大使在最近逗留汉口期间充分认识到，中国已不再能够对日本进行 serious resistance（有力抵抗）。

page_data.en:

Ambassador fully realized that China was no longer able to
put up a serious resistance to Japan.

(8) Article analyzing the principles and organization
of the Japanese Empire.

(9) Article signed "A Russian" praising the anti-
Communist bloc. The writer expressed the opinion that "the
defeat of the Komintern in China will be followed by the
victory of Russian nationalism."

(10) Article dealing with the struggle of the forces
of Russian nationalists against Soviet power. As an example

Dealing with the last mentioned affair, the

"In February Dmitri Ivanovitch Goustoff, editor

most influential political leaders in the Far East, was
deported from Shanghai by the French Police. He was taken

for Wenchow. It is not known by whom she had been chartered.
From Wenchow Goustoff was sent to Yunkan to the headquarters
of the Chinese 4th Red Army. From there all traces of the
man were lost. It is evident that the united forces of the
U.S.S.R. and of their friends have started a merciless struggle

(11) Article written by Mr. A.A. ... the
struggle which is developing in the Pacific between Japan,
Great Britain and America.

(12) Various information on the ...
in U.S.S.R.

(8) 分析日本帝国原则和组织的文章。

(9) 署名“一个俄罗斯人”的文章，赞扬反共集团。作者表示认为，“共产国际在中国的失败将随之带来俄罗斯民族主义的胜利。”

(10) 关于俄罗斯民族主义力量反对苏维埃政权的斗争的文章。作为布尔什维克对外国人采取暴力措施的例子，作者引用了在巴黎（他称之为“西欧的共产主义中心”）绑架Koutepoff将军和Miller将军的事件，向著名的俄罗斯爱国者和记者I.L. Solonevitch在索非亚的住所投掷炸弹的事件，以及将记者Goustoff从上海驱逐出境的事件。

在谈到最后提到的事件时，作者说：

“今年二月，《Pareus》杂志编辑、才华横溢的记者兼远东最具影响力的政治领袖之一Dmitri Ivanovitch Goustoff被法国警察从上海驱逐出境。清晨6点，他被带上由Yannoulates兄弟拥有的希腊轮船‘Ahne Vathy’号。该轮驶往温州。不知是由谁包租的。从温州，Goustoff被送往云干（音译）的中国红军第四军总部。从此，此人的下落全无。显然，苏联及其朋友的联合力量已经开始了对反共俄罗斯团体的无情斗争。”

(11) 由A.A. ...先生撰写的文章，论述日本、英国和美国在太平洋地区正在发展的斗争。

(12) 关于苏联境内...的各种信息。

page_data.en:
( 5 )

Extract from leading article in "Roussky Goloss"
--------------------------------------------------

The weekly "Roussky Goloss" is being published with
the object of providing the groups of Russian emigrants in
Shanghai, avowing a national and clearly anti-bolshevik attitude,
with a newspaper organ, responding fully to their aspirations.

In the face of the provocative activities by bolshevik
agents, the Russian emigrant is conscious that he is without
protection for the anti-bolshevik Russian Press of Shanghai does
not give him the impression that it is struggling seriously
against this work of disintegration.

Certain articles on this subject have appeared recently
in the "Shanghai Zaria," but these are only amusing pamphlets, not
serious and which have absolutely failed in their purpose.

We fully realize that in a city like Shanghai, there
is a confusion of political interests amongst the great Powers.
The national interests of the Russian residents do not always
correspond with the interests of certain Powers. For this
reason, Russians should keep apart and not meddle with anything.

It does not mean, however, that Russians, subject to
the jurisdiction of these authorities, are to forget the reasons
which had forced them to leave their country. To renounce their
political creed, the struggle against their enemy who has widely
spread his activities abroad, and the necessity of reorganizing
their forces for the liberation of their land --- one cannot,
even for administrative and political reasons, compel us definitely
to renounce all these ideas.

On the other hand, numerous questions concerning the
domestic life of the Russian colony are, we wonder why, passed
over in silence and the situation becomes more complicated and
embroiled. The Russian Press pays no heed to intelligent,
independent and impartial criticism, and this is the reason
why development of any social activities among Russian emigrants
has failed.
page_data.zh:
( 5 )

《Roussky Goloss》社论摘录
--------------------------------------------------

周报《Roussky Goloss》出版的目的是为上海那些宣称具有民族立场和明确反布尔什维克态度的俄罗斯侨民群体提供一份报纸机关刊物，以充分回应他们的愿望。

面对布尔什维克代理人的挑衅活动，俄罗斯侨民意识到自己缺乏保护，因为上海的反布尔什维克俄罗斯报刊并没有给他留下正在认真对抗这种瓦解工作的印象。

最近，《上海朝霞报》（Shanghai Zaria）上发表了一些关于此主题的文章，但这些只是 amusing pamphlets（有趣的小册子），并不严肃，且完全未能达到其目的。

我们充分认识到，在上海这样的城市，列强之间的政治利益错综复杂。俄罗斯居民的民族利益并不总是与某些列强的利益相符。因此，俄罗斯人应该保持距离，不介入任何事务。

然而，这并不意味着受这些当局管辖的俄罗斯人要忘记迫使他们离开祖国的原因。放弃他们的政治信条，放弃与已在国外广泛展开活动的敌人进行的斗争，以及为了解放国土而重组力量的必要性——即使出于行政和政治原因，也不能强迫我们明确放弃所有这些想法。

另一方面，我们想知道，为什么有关俄罗斯侨民国内生活的许多问题被缄默不语，局势变得更加复杂和纠缠。俄罗斯报刊无视明智、独立和公正的批评，这就是为什么俄罗斯侨民中任何社会活动的发展都失败了的原因。

page_data.en:
( 6 )

We do not want to limit our work to seeking a solution
of the problems which concern only the Russian colony of Shanghai.
We want it to be known as widely as possible that under the
Russian national flag which flies in every part of the world
live and work united and well led Russians.

The time has come to deploy our forces for the
liberation of our country. This movement has been marked by
the creation of a new international force, the formation of the
anti-communist bloc composed of Japan, Italy and Germany. We
are confident that other Powers which have also suffered through
communism will not hesitate to join these three Powers. The
Russian people would have long ago joined this union if they
had not been tied hands and feet, a slave to Communist power.
All our efforts must henceforth be directed towards our internal
unification for this will enable us to take part in the struggle
against Communism. We have all the elements necessary for this
unification:

A common mother ---- our country, Russia.
A common language -- the Russian language.
A common religion -- the Russian orthodox religion.
A common flag ------ the Russian tricolour flag.
A common civilization -- the Grand Russian national
                          civilization.
A common enemy ----- the Communists.
page_data.zh:
( 6 )

我们不想将我们的工作局限于寻求仅涉及上海俄罗斯侨民的问题的解决方案。我们要让尽可能多的人知道，在世界各地飘扬的俄罗斯民族旗帜下，生活和工作着团结且领导有方的俄罗斯人。

现在是部署我们的力量以解放我国的时候了。这一运动的标志是建立了一支新的国际力量，即由日本、意大利和德国组成的反共集团。我们相信，其他同样遭受共产主义苦难的列强将毫不犹豫地加入这三个国家。如果俄罗斯人民没有被束缚手脚，成为共产主义权力的奴隶，他们早就加入了这个联盟。今后，我们所有的努力必须指向内部的统一，因为这将使我们能够参加反对共产主义的斗争。我们拥有实现这一统一所需的所有要素：

共同的母亲——我们的祖国，俄罗斯。
共同的语言——俄语。
共同的宗教——俄罗斯东正教。
共同的旗帜——俄罗斯三色旗。
共同的文明——大俄罗斯民族文明。
共同的敌人——共产主义者。

September 16,1938

To Political Department,
Municipality of the International Settlement,
Shanghai.

On September 18,1938 a group of Russian, Japanese
and Chinese anti-communists will start the publication of
a weekly paper in the Russian language entitled "Russky
Golos" edited by Mr. N.I. Djogalin. The editorial offices
of the paper is situated at 211 Yangtszepoo Road. It is
registered with the Municipality of Great Shanghai ( Dah Dao )
The paper is intended to be an organ of struggle against
communism . Among its collaborators are Russians, Japanese
and Chinese residing in the area protected by the Japanese
forces.

Bringing the above to your notice and enclosing two
copies of the paper, I beg to apply for registration of this
paper at the Municipality of the International Settlement
as a weekly Russian publication.

Yours respectfully,

(Signed) N.I. Djogalin.
Editor.

Subject The "Russky Golos" (Russian Voice) - new weekly publication in
the Russian language.

Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev Forwarded by C. Crawford. D.I.

The appearance on September 18, 1938 of the first issue
of a Russian weekly publication entitled "Russky Golos"
(Russian Voice) is a result of endeavours of a group of Russian
emigrants of pro-Japanese tendencies who came to the notice
of this section in 1936-1937 mostly in connection with the
activities of the so-called "Russian National Union," the
leader of which was D. I. Goostoff. Following the closure of
the magazine "Parus" by the French authorities in December,
1937 and the subsequent deportation of D. I. Goostoff, its
editor and publisher, from Shanghai to Wenchow, the group in
question transferred their activities to the Japanese occupied
area of the Settlement. From that time on there have been
continuous discussions of the plan of establishing a purely
political press organ, an "organ of struggle against communism,"
which would step in the place vacated by the magazine "Parus".

According to information, the Goostoff group, enraged
by the action taken by the French Police in respect of their
leader, at first advocated the idea of publishing a paper
absolutely immune from any interference on the part of the
French and Municipal Police. i.e. edited by a Japanese in the
area under the Japanese control. Apparently, neither the
sanction of the Japanese authorities nor sufficient funds could
have been obtained, and the scheme was abandoned for a time.

Recently a plan originated of establishing a large
Japanese daily newspaper in the Russian language and many
rumours regarding this subject are still current in the Russian
community.

As was reported previously (vide attached copy of
report dated 22.8.38) the removal of the "Graphic Printing &

呈报人：副督察普罗科菲耶夫（D.S.I. Prokofiev） 转呈人：督察克劳福德（C. Crawford, D.I.）

1938年9月18日，一份名为《俄罗斯之声》（Russian Voice）的俄文周报创刊号问世，这是具有亲日倾向的俄国流亡者群体努力的结果。该股在1936-1937年间已注意到该群体，当时主要与其所谓“俄罗斯全国联盟”（Russian National Union）的活动有关，该联盟领导人为 D.I. 古斯托夫（D. I. Goostoff）。1937年12月，法国当局查封了杂志《帆》（Parus），随后将其编辑兼出版人 D.I. 古斯托夫从上海驱逐至温州，此后该群体将其活动转移至租界的日军占领区。从那时起，他们不断讨论建立一份纯政治性报刊的计划，即一份“反共斗争机关报”，以填补《帆》杂志停刊后留下的空白。

据信，古斯托夫集团因法国警方对其领导人采取的行动而愤怒，起初主张创办一份完全不受法国警方和工部局警方干涉的报纸，即由日本人在日军控制区内编辑。显然，由于未能获得日本当局的批准或足够的资金，该计划暂时被搁置。

最近，有人提议创办一份大型俄文日文日报，俄国社区中仍流传着许多关于此事的谣言。

Publishing Co., formerly owned by Goostoff, from the French
Concession to 211 Yangtsepoo Road was the first practical
step towards the realisation of the much discussed plan of
publishing a Russian anti-communist paper in the area North
of the Soochow Creek. The equipment of the "Graphic Printing
and Publishing Co." is reported to be now the property of the
Japanese who have paid certain debts incurred by Goostoff.
It is also reported that the Goostoff group decided to start
the publication of the "Russky Golos" having only very limited
funds at their disposal, in the hope that in future, if the
paper in question is approved by the Japanese, a subsidy might
be secured from them.
The fact that an application is made for registration of
this paper seems to indicate that it is not intended to be of
a violent nature, as might have been anticipated. This is
confirmed by the generally moderate tone of articles appearing
in the first issue.
Attached herewith are summarized translations of a series
of articles from the "Russky Golos" which give a general idea
of the political physiognomy of this publication, the main
features of which are:- Russian nationalism, irreconciliably
hostile attitude towards communism and support of the anti-
communist group of powers - Japan, Italy and Germany in their
struggle against common enemy, the Comintern.
Nicolas Ivanovich DJOGALIN, supposed editor of the "Russky
Golos," is a Russian 32 years of age, native of Vilna. He
is reported to have left Russia for China in 1922 and to have
subsequently resided in Harbin and Mukden for many years.

原由古斯托夫拥有的“图形印刷出版公司”从法租界迁至杨树浦路211号，是实现这一备受讨论的在苏州河以北地区出版俄文反共报纸计划的第一步。据悉，“图形印刷出版公司”的设备现在归日本人所有，日本人偿还了古斯托夫所欠的部分债务。另有消息称，古斯托夫集团决定在资金非常有限的情况下开始出版《俄罗斯之声》，希望如果该报得到日本人的认可，未来能获得他们的补贴。

申请注册该报这一事实似乎表明，其性质并不像人们可能预期的那样激烈。该报创刊号文章总体温和的基调证实了这一点。

随函附上《俄罗斯之声》一系列文章的摘要译文，这些文章大致反映了该出版物的政治面貌，其主要特征为：俄罗斯民族主义、对共产主义毫不妥协的敌视态度，以及支持日本、意大利和德国等反共强国集团对抗共同敌人共产国际的斗争。

尼古拉斯·伊万诺维奇·乔加林（Nicolas Ivanovich DJOGALIN），《俄罗斯之声》的名义编辑，是一名32岁的俄罗斯人，出生于维尔纳（Vilna）。据报道，他于1922年离开俄罗斯前往中国，随后在哈尔滨和沈阳居住多年。

Summarised translation of articles of interest from the
first issue of "RUSSKY GOLOS", Russian weekly newspaper.

1. Leading Article.

"Commencing the publication of weekly newspaper
"Russky Golos" we intend to solve thereby the problem of
creating a press organ which would fully satisfy the needs
of politically active elements of the national thinking,
uncompromisingly hostile towards the bolsheviks part of
Russian emigrant population in Shanghai.

Clearly perceiving the incessant provocative and
disintegrating activities of the bolsheviks, assisted by
their willing and unwilling agents, and heartily wishing
these activities be properly checked, a Russian emigrant
does not see any attempt in this direction on the part of
the local non-bolshevist press.

We, of course, understand that in Shanghai, where
the interests of almost all great powers are intermingled
and where the political aspirations of a considerable part
of Russian emigrants officially do not coincide with the
general trend of foreign policies of certain of these
powers, - Russian emigrants in their political activities
in the Settlement and especially in the French Concession,
have to manoeuvre somehow, to conform themselves to local
conditions or simply to keep still and quiet. The
administrative and Police aspects of a colonial policy
always differ from conditions prevailing in the parent
state, and it would be futile for Russian emigrants to
question the propriety of this or that action of any
colonial authorities.

This, however, does not mean that Russians, who
are living under the jurisdiction of these authorities, must
forget why they had left their Motherland, i.e. forget
their political credo, their political struggle against their
page_data.zh:
俄文周报《俄罗斯之声》创刊号中感兴趣文章的摘要译文。

1. 社论。

“在开始出版周报《俄罗斯之声》之际，我们旨在解决创建一个报刊机关的问题，该机关将充分满足上海俄国流亡人口中对政治活跃、具有民族思想且对布尔什维克持毫不妥协敌视态度的那部分人的需求。

清楚地认识到布尔什维克在其自愿和非自愿代理人的协助下进行的无休止的挑衅和分裂活动，并衷心希望这些活动得到适当遏制，俄国流亡者在本地非布尔什维克报刊上看不到任何在此方向上的尝试。

当然，我们理解，在上海，几乎所有大国的利益交织在一起，且相当一部分俄国流亡者的政治诉求在官方上与其中某些大国的外交政策总体趋势不一致，因此，俄国流亡者在租界，特别是在法租界的政治活动中，必须以某种方式周旋，以适应当地条件，或者干脆保持沉默和安静。殖民政策的行政和警务方面总是与母国的 prevailing 条件不同，俄国流亡者去质疑任何殖民当局这一或那一行动的适当性是徒劳的。

然而，这并不意味着生活在这些当局管辖下的俄罗斯人必须忘记他们为何离开祖国，即忘记他们的政治信条，忘记他们与敌人的政治斗争，

enemy, the network of whose activities covers all
foreign countries, forget the task of the preparation

centre.
Time has arrived when our desire to facilitate

This moment was marked by the appearance on

We believe that all nations which have in any

From this our belief follows our attitude towards
the international anti-communist union as to a force, with
which we must establish business contact and which we

敌人的活动网络覆盖所有外国，忘记为从布尔什维克枷锁中解放出来的祖国服务培养干部的任务。即使是当地行政和警察法规的字面意思也不能要求我们放弃这一权利......”

在涉及俄国流亡者内部生活方面，倡导“健康、公正和独立的批评，无论相关党派是否喜欢这种批评”，文章作者声明，《俄罗斯之声》的关注点不会仅局限于本地事务。
b
“作为散布在世界各地的俄国流亡者的一部分，我们理解他们有组织活动的必要性和重要性。因此，我们希望创造一种局面，使每个人都清楚，在世界各地都能看到的俄罗斯国旗之下，生活着团结在一个强大整体中并由一个中心指挥的俄罗斯人。
时机已经成熟，我们通过实际参与来促进解放祖国事业的愿望，正成为一种切实的可能性。
这一时刻的标志是，在国际反共阵线上出现了一股新力量，即日本、意大利和德国的国际反共联盟的力量。

Subject (in full) The Graphic Printing & Publishing Co., - change of address.
Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev Forwarded by Morgan D.S.I.

Information has been received that the equipment
of the Graphic Printing & Publishing Co., 473 Route Cardinal Mer-
cier, formerly owned by D.I. Goostoff, has been purchased by cer-
tain Japanese and on 21-8-38 removed to 211 Yangtsepoo Road

A. Prokofiev

Memorandum on V.A. Chilikin, editor of the "Novosti Dnia"
(Russian Daily News)

Vassily Alexandrovich CHILIKIN, Russian, was born on
29-10-1892 in Riazan Province, Russia. Prior to 1918 he is re-
ported to have been working as a journalist in Moscow after which
he proceeded to Vladivostok where he was engaged in commercial
pursuits for some time. In 1921 he went to Harbin where he re-
sumed his journalistic activities. He first published a weekly
Russian newspaper entitled "Commercial Telegraph" and in 1923
started the publication of a daily newspaper "Kopeika". During
the three years of the publication of the latter newspaper its
political colour changed from "White" to pro-Soviet and vice-
versa to suit the conveniences of the editor and, consequently,
Chilikin acquired the reputation of being a political opportunist.
In 1926 the "Kopeika" is reported to have been closed by order
of the local Chinese authorities for publishing certain offensive
articles.

In September, 1926 Chilikin came to Shanghai and soon
afterwards started a printing establishment known as the "Asia
Press". In December, 1927 he started the publication of a Russian
daily newspaper entitled "Utro" in the French Concession, which
he later sold to the late Mr. Lembich, owner of the "Shanghai
Zaria", in July, 1928. The newspaper was renamed "Echo" and until
the end of 1928 Chilikin continued to be its editor. In April,
1929 he left for Harbin.

During his early journalistic activities in Shanghai
Chilikin was assaulted in 1927 by two Russians who objected to
an article which appeared in the "Utro". In January, 1928 an un-
successful private criminal prosecution was brought against him
in the former French Mixed Court by the local agency of the Chinese
Eastern Railway, a Soviet concern, in connection with a series of
articles he published regarding the "criminal activities of Bol-
sheviks in Shanghai".
page_data.zh:
关于《Novosti Dnia》（《每日新闻》，俄文日报）编辑 V.A. Chilikin 的备忘录

Vassily Alexandrovich CHILIKIN，俄国人，1892年10月29日出生于俄罗斯梁赞省。据报道，1918年之前他在莫斯科从事记者工作，随后前往海参崴，在那里从事了一段时间的商业活动。1921年他前往哈尔滨，恢复了记者活动。他首先出版了一份名为《Commercial Telegraph》（《商业电报》）的俄文周报，并于1923年开始出版日报《Kopeika》（《戈比报》）。在该报出版的三年期间，其政治色彩从“白党”倾向变为亲苏维埃，反之亦然，以迎合编辑的需要，因此，Chilikin 获得了政治投机分子的名声。据报道，1926年，《Kopeika》因刊登某些冒犯性文章而被当地中国当局下令关闭。

1926年9月，Chilikin 来到上海，不久后开办了一家名为“Asia Press”（亚细亚印刷所）的印刷机构。1927年12月，他在法租界开始出版一份名为《Utro》（《早晨报》）的俄文日报，后来于1928年7月将其出售给已故的 Lembich 先生，后者是《Shanghai Zaria》（《上海霞光报》）的所有者。该报更名为《Echo》（《回声报》），直到1928年底，Chilikin 一直担任其编辑。1929年4月，他前往哈尔滨。

在上海早期的记者活动中，Chilikin 于1927年遭到两名俄国人的袭击，这些人反对《Utro》上刊登的一篇文章。1928年1月，前法公廨受理了一起由中东铁路局（一家苏维埃机构）上海代理机构对他提起的私人刑事诉讼，但未获成功，此事与他发表的一系列关于“布尔什维克在上海的犯罪活动”的文章有关。

page_data.en:
-2-
In April,1930 Chilikin returned to Shanghai from Harbin
and during the same year opened a printing establishment in the
French Concession known as the"Standard Press". About the same
time his wife established the library and bookstore "Skity" at
645 Avenue Joffre which was later removed to 289 Avenue du Roi
Albert. The latter enterprize has ceased to exist.
In March,1933 Chilikin applied to the local French
authorities for permission to publish a Russian daily newspaper
"Kopeika" - a"non-political organ the main purpose of which was
to furnish news to the poorer classes of the Russian community
who could not afford buying larger and more expensive newspapers".
The French Police report regarding this application was unfavour-
able to Chilikin and described him as an unprincipled individual,
political opportunist and suspected Soviet agent. On the other
hand,however, he was recommended by a prominent French resident
as an honest man,full of energy,whose newspaper might eventually
become an instrument of propaganda in the hands of the French
authorities. The necessary permission was granted.
In October,1934 the newspaper was renamed the"Novosti
Dnia" and its editorial and printing offices were removed from
11 Route de Sieyes to 785 Avenue Joffre. At this time its finan-
cial position was described by the French Police as very precarious
However, towards the end of 1934 it became evident that Chilikin
had obtained certain funds from an unknown source. During the
ensuing two years the "Novosti Dnia" gradually increased the
number of its pages and since 1937 has appeared in a 12 page
edition.
The political physiognomy of this newspaper as well its
attitude towards various practical problems with which the local
Russian community is faced are difficult to define. On May,26,
1936 an editorial entitled "JUSTIFIED PRIDE" appeared in the
"Novosti Dnia" in which general principles were outlined of the
policy this newspaper claims to have been following for the past
three years. According to this editorial,the"Novosti Dnia" is an
"absolutely independent non-party organ" of Russian emigres and
page_data.zh:
-2-
1930年4月，Chilikin 从哈尔滨返回上海，并于同年年在法租界开设了一家名为“Standard Press”（标准印刷所）的印刷机构。大约在同一时间，他的妻子在霞飞路（Avenue Joffre）645号建立了图书馆兼书店“Skity”，后来迁至阿尔伯特王路（Avenue du Roi Albert）289号。后一家企业已不复存在。
1933年3月，Chilikin 向当地法国当局申请许可出版俄文日报《Kopeika》，称其为“非政治性刊物，主要目的是为那些买不起更大、更昂贵报纸的俄国社区贫困阶层提供新闻”。法国警方关于此申请的报告对 Chilikin 不利，将他描述为一个无原则的人、政治投机分子和疑似苏维埃特工。然而另一方面，一位著名的法国居民推荐他为诚实之人，充满活力，其报纸最终可能成为法国当局手中的宣传工具。必要的许可被授予。
1934年10月，该报更名为《Novosti Dnia》（《每日新闻》），其编辑部和印刷所从西爱咸斯路（Route de Sieyes）11号迁至霞飞路785号。当时，法国警方形容其财务状况非常岌岌可危。然而，到1934年底，显然 Chilikin 已从不明来源获得了一些资金。在接下来的两年里，《Novosti Dnia》逐渐增加了页数，自1937年以来一直以12版的版面发行。
这份报纸的政治面貌以及它对当地俄国社区面临的各种实际问题的态度难以界定。1936年5月26日，《Novosti Dnia》刊登了一篇题为《正当的自豪》的社论，其中概述了该报声称在过去三年中一直遵循的政策的一般原则。根据这篇社论，《Novosti Dnia》是俄国流亡者的“绝对独立的无党派机关”，

page_data.en:
-3-
pursues only one aim,namely: to facilitate by every means an
improvement of the economic and cultural standard of living of
the Russian community and to struggle against any oppressors of
the Russian people".
References made in the editorial in question re-
garding the various "enemies" of the "Novosti Dnia" show that
Mr. Chilikin's efforts in the direction indicated are far from
being generally appreciated among the Russian community. Indeed,
it is evident to every regular reader of the local Russian press
that for reasons which are not always clear,Mr. Chilikin has
been at war with all other Russian newspapers published in
Shanghai,with the sole exception of the Soviet newspaper" China
Daily Herald" which so far has been immune from his attacks.
It is not known what Mr.Chilikin's ideas are as to how his pro-
fessed aim is to be realised and hardly anything constructive has
ever been suggested by him. On the other hand his vicious at-
tacks on the "National Committee of Russian Emigrants'Associa-
tion" and the "Russian Emigrants' Committee" are well known,as
well as the fact that these two bodies,whatever their weaknesses
may be,represented practically all Russian organizations engaged
in genuine work on behalf of their nationals.
The scandalous campaigns conducted by the "Novosti
Dnia" from time to time in connection with various matters re-
lating to the inner life of the Russian community invariably
create an atmosphere of ill-feeling and animosity on account of
the reckless,irresponsible and invariably vulgar manner they are
carried out and are known to have aroused strong resentment and
indignation in the community.
Mr. Chilikin's activities were often unfavourably
commented upon in the local Russian press and on one occasion
were publicly censured by the "National Committee" referred to
above. However,this worries Mr. Chilikin very little and he still
continues his practice of singling out this or that individual
or organization as the target of his ridicule which very often
go beyond the limits of common decency.
page_data.zh:
-3-
只追求一个目标，即：不择手段地促进俄国侨民经济和文化生活水平的提高，并与任何压迫俄国人民的人作斗争”。
该社论中提及《每日新闻》（Novosti Dnia）的各种“敌人”，表明奇利金先生（Mr. Chilikin）在上述方向上的努力远未在俄国侨民中得到普遍认可。事实上，当地俄文报刊的每一位常规读者都清楚，出于并不总是明确的原因，奇利金先生一直与上海出版的所有其他俄文报纸处于交战状态，唯一的例外是苏联报纸《中国每日先驱报》（China Daily Herald），迄今为止该报未受其攻击。
人们不知道奇利金先生对于如何实现其宣称的目标有何想法，他也几乎从未提出过任何建设性建议。另一方面，他对“俄国侨民协会全国委员会”和“俄国侨民委员会”的恶毒攻击众所周知，而且事实是，这两个机构无论有何弱点，实际上代表了所有真正为本国同胞工作的俄国组织。
《每日新闻》不时就涉及俄国侨民内部生活的各种事项进行的丑闻式宣传运动，由于其鲁莽、不负责任且一贯粗俗的方式， invariably 制造了一种不和与敌意的氛围，并已知在侨民中引起了强烈的怨恨和愤怒。
奇利金先生的活动经常受到当地俄文报刊的不利评论，有一次还遭到上述“全国委员会”的公开谴责。然而，这并未让奇利金先生感到多少困扰，他仍然继续这种做法， singled out 这个或那个个人或组织作为其嘲笑的目标，而这些嘲笑往往超出了基本礼节的界限。

page_data.en:
-4-

Suspicions have been quite openly expressed in certain
circles of the local Russian community that in his activities
Mr. Chilikin is guided and supported by a third party pursuing
aims which have nothing to do with the welfare of the Russian
community. The open pro-Soviet attitude of the "Novosti Dnia"
since the latter part of 1936 bear out these suspicions. Anony-
mous leaflets which have appeared in Shanghai from time to time
go still farther in this direction and brand the editor of the
"Novosti Dnia" as being a Soviet agent-provocateur. Whatever
truth may be in these accusations, there is little doubt that the
"Novosti Dnia" possesses many features characteristic of the
"yellow press".

For the purpose of a summing-up the following characte-
ristics of V.A. Chilikin may be quoted which, although given by
the local Russian magazine "Parus" - Chilikin's arch-enemy -,
nevertheless contains a great deal of truth:-

" Vassily Chilikin, commonly known under the contem-
ptuous name "Vaska Chilikin" is a man devoid of any principles.
It is not known that he ever had any principles. Nothing is sacred
to him: neither Motherland, nor his own people, nor church, nor
God. But he has his POCKET - his holy of holies - and CYNICISM
and IMPUDENCE. Nothing can disconcert him or make him feel
ashamed. Generally speaking, he does not know what shame is: he
was beaten up, insults of all sorts were hurled at him, but he
is utterly indifferent to all this and keeps on following his
own path, along which dollars can be found. Dollars, only dollars -
this is what he wants. For dollars he is ready to sell everything-
honour, Motherland and God. Such a person is publishing a daily
newspaper through the medium of which he can attack various in-
dividuals and institutions, bring dissension and disorganization
into the Russian community.. And he dares call his newspaper an
emigrants' and nationalist newspaper!"....

Being a past master in the art of "mudslinging"
Chilikin was bound to come to the notice of the police authori-
ties of both the French Concession and the International Settlement.
page_data.zh:
-4-

当地俄国侨民的某些圈子相当公开地表示怀疑，认为奇利金先生的活动是由一个第三方指导和支持的，该第三方的目标与俄国侨民的福祉无关。自1936年下半年以来，《每日新闻》公开的亲苏态度证实了这些怀疑。不时在上海出现的匿名传单在这方面走得更远，给《每日新闻》的编辑贴上苏联挑衅特工的标签。无论这些指控有多少真实性，毫无疑问，《每日新闻》具有许多“黄色新闻”的特征。

为了总结起见，可以引用当地俄文杂志《帆》（Parus）——奇利金的死敌——对V.A.奇利金所作的以下特征描述，尽管出自敌手，但仍包含大量真实内容：

“瓦西里·奇利金，通常被轻蔑地称为‘瓦斯卡·奇利金’，是一个毫无原则的人。据所知，他从未有过任何原则。对他来说，没有什么是神圣的：既没有祖国，也没有自己的人民，也没有教会，也没有上帝。但他有他的‘口袋’——他的至圣所——以及‘犬儒主义’和‘厚颜无耻’。没有什么能让他感到不安或羞愧。一般来说，他不知道什么是羞耻：他挨过打，遭受过各种侮辱，但他对此完全漠不关心，继续沿着自己的道路前进，在这条路上可以找到美元。美元，只有美元——这就是他想要的。为了美元，他准备出卖一切——荣誉、祖国和上帝。就是这样一个人，通过出版一份日报，借此攻击各种个人和机构，在俄国侨民中制造分裂和无序……而他竟敢称他的报纸为侨民和民族主义报纸！”....

作为一名“抹黑”艺术的大师，奇利金注定会引起法租界和公共租界警察当局的注意。

page_data.en:
-5-
ment. In August,1935 acting on an impulse that the French Police
authorities were obstructing him and his publication,Chilikin
removed the editorial and printing offices of the "Novosti Dnia"
from the French Concession to 620 Avenue Roch in the Settlement.
According to the French Police,this was the result of a warning
given to Chilikin in connection with several complaints regarding
his blackmailing activities.
In September,1935 an order for the ban on the sale
of the "Novosti Dnia" was issued by the French Authorities,the
reason for the ban being articles published in that newspaper
which contained sarcastic criticism of the policy of the French
Municipal Council. The ban was lifted only after the "Novosti Dnia"
had published a full apology for the article in question.
In December,1936 D.C.(Special Branch) was obliged
to draw Mr. Chilikin's attention to the danger of the prominence
he was giving in his newspaper at that time to a controversy over
the Jewish question and requested him to refrain from further re-
ference to the subject.
In January,1936 upon receipt of a complaint from
Mr.Ch.A. Metzler,Chairman of the Russian Emigrants' Committee,
regarding Chilikin's demagogic campaign against Russian public
and benevolent organizations D.C. ( Special Branch) again called
Mr. Chilikin to his office and requested him to be less vitriolic
in his pronouncements and to avoid publishing articles savouring
exaggeration.
On 25-10-36, 8-1-37 and 13-1-37 in connection with
articles of the "Novosti Dnia" insulting to the German people,
the D.C. (Special Branch) warned the editor of the newspaper to
refrain from publishing anything likely to offend religious or
national feelings of any section of the foreign community in
Shanghai.
On March 25,1937 a complaint was received from
Mr. J.A. Thompson regarding the "dastardly manner" in which the
"Novosti Dnia" had reported the inquest proceeding in H.B.M. Consu-
lar Court on the body of his late daughter. Complainant stated
page_data.zh:
-5-
门。1935年8月，出于一种冲动，认为法国警察当局正在阻碍他及其出版物，奇利金将《每日新闻》的编辑部和印刷厂从法租界迁至公共租界罗赫路（Avenue Roch）620号。据法国警方称，这是针对有关其勒索活动的几起投诉向奇利金发出警告的结果。
1935年9月，法国当局发布禁令，禁止销售《每日新闻》，禁令的原因是该报刊登的文章包含对法国公董局政策的讽刺性批评。只有在《每日新闻》就该文章发表正式道歉后，禁令才被解除。
1936年12月，特别处主任（D.C. (Special Branch)）不得不提请奇利金先生注意，他在当时的报纸上过分突出关于犹太问题的争议所带来的危险，并要求他不再提及该主题。
1936年1月，收到俄国侨民委员会主席Ch.A.梅茨勒先生（Mr. Ch.A. Metzler）关于奇利金针对俄国公共和慈善组织进行煽动性运动的投诉后，特别处主任再次传唤奇利金先生到办公室，要求他在言论中少一些尖刻，避免刊登带有夸张意味的文章。
1936年10月25日、1937年1月8日和1937年1月13日，鉴于《每日新闻》刊登侮辱德国人民的文章，特别处主任警告该报编辑，不要刊登任何可能冒犯上海外侨社区任何部分宗教或民族感情的内容。
1937年3月25日，收到J.A.汤普森先生（Mr. J.A. Thompson）的投诉，称《每日新闻》以“卑鄙的方式”报道了其已故女儿在英国驻沪领事法庭的死因审讯程序。投诉人陈述

page_data.en:
-6-
that the report was "evidently calculated to pander to the scan-
dal-mongering section of the Russian community" and was injurious
to his late daughter's good name. Called up to Headquarters in
this connection Mr. Chilikin tendered his apologies to Mr. Thomp-
son.
Since the outbreak of the Sino-Japanese hostilities
in North-China the "Novosti Dnia" has adopted a pro-Chinese at-
titude (vide attached translation of his letter to M-me Sun Yat-
sen). While there are many Russians in Shanghai who sympathise
with China in her present struggle, Chilikin's manner of support-
ing China has aroused alarm and protests among the Russian commu-
nity. During August, 1937 a complaint was received by the Muni-
cipal Police and two by the Secretary of the Municipal Council
regarding articles published in the "Novosti Dnia" containing
malicious insinuations directed against certain individuals
and institutions in connection with their alleged pro-Japanese
attitude. All complaints draw the attention of the authorities to
the fact that Chilikin's libellous statements are tantamount to
inciting the Chinese against the Russian population in Shanghai.
page_data.zh:
-6-
该报道“显然是为了迎合俄国侨民中喜欢散布丑闻的那部分人”，并损害了他已故女儿的名誉。就此事被传唤至总部时，奇利金先生向汤普森先生表示了歉意。
自华北中日敌对行动爆发以来，《每日新闻》采取了亲华态度（参见附译其致孙逸仙夫人的信件）。虽然上海有许多俄国人同情中国目前的斗争，但奇利金支持中国的方式在俄国侨民中引起了恐慌和抗议。1937年8月期间，公共租界警务处收到一起投诉，工部局秘书收到两起投诉，均涉及《每日新闻》刊登的文章，这些文章包含针对某些个人和机构的恶意暗示，指控他们持有亲日态度。所有投诉都提请当局注意这样一个事实，即奇利金的诽谤性言论等同于煽动中国人反对上海的俄国居民。

TRANSLATION OF FRENCH POLICE REPORT NO. 1320/2 DATED 12.11.37
SUBJECT : Anti-Soviet leaflets distributed in Shanghai on
November 7, the occasion of the 20th anniversary of
the establishment of the Soviets in Russia.

Anti-Soviet leaflets were distributed in Shanghai on November
7 on the occasion of the 20th anniversary of the establishment of
Soviet power in Russia. A certain number of these tracts were
sent through the mails to representatives of the local Russian
and foreign colonies. Others were secretly distributed along
Avenue Joffre and Avenue du Roi Albert. One of the leaflets
sent through the post was addressed to the Commissioner of
the Settlement Police.

These brochures appeal to Russian emigrants to unite
themselves and to be prepared for the final struggle against
the "satanists" who are the oppressors of their country. A list
of persons whom the Russian emigrants can consider as their
enemies in Shanghai is also given. This list enumerates the
names of different representatives of official and commercial
establishments of the Soviet Union in Shanghai, as well as
the collaborators of V. CHILIKIN's Russian publication
"Novosti Dnia."

There is every reason to believe that these tracts and
leaflets were published and distributed by the RODZAEVSKY
(Harbin) Fascist organisation, the Shanghai section of which
is located at 832 Weihaiwei Road.

Attached herewith is a specimen copy, a translation of
which follows:

Shanghai, 7.11.37.
Communism will perish ! Russia will not perish!
....................
For twenty years, CHILIKIN's paper has been slowly suffocating
our unhappy country in a bloody grip.
At the end of these twenty years, we can all state definitely
that the satanists are God forsaken...
and that their attempts to poison public opinion...
world have received a definite rebuff...

法国警察局第1320/2号报告译文，日期为1937年11月12日
主题：11月7日在上海散发的反苏传单，正值俄国苏维埃成立20周年之际。

11月7日，正值俄国苏维埃政权成立20周年之际，上海散发了反苏传单。其中一定数量的传单通过邮件寄送给当地俄国和外侨社区的代表。其他传单则在霞飞路（Avenue Joffre）和阿尔伯特国王路（Avenue du Roi Albert）沿线秘密分发。通过邮政发送的一份传单是寄给公共租界警务处督察长的。

这些小册子呼吁俄国侨民团结起来，为最终对抗压迫他们祖国的“撒旦主义者”做好准备。同时还列出了一份名单，列出了俄国侨民在上海可以视为敌人的人员。这份名单列举了苏联在上海的官方和商业机构的不同代表，以及V.奇利金的俄文出版物《每日新闻》的合作者。

有充分理由相信，这些传单和小册子是由罗德扎耶夫斯基（RODZAEVSKY）（哈尔滨）法西斯组织出版和分发的，其上海分部位于威海卫路832号。

随函附上一份样本，译文如下：

上海，1937年11月7日。
共产主义必将灭亡！俄罗斯不会灭亡！
....................
二十年来，奇利金的报纸一直在用血腥的手段慢慢窒息我们不幸的国家。
在这二十年结束时，我们可以肯定地说，撒旦主义者已被上帝抛弃……
他们毒害公众舆论的企图……
在世界范围内遭到了明确的回击……

sentiment is gaining more and more ground in other lands. We will
soon see our country liberated from the red terror.
Our enemies are impotent.
They proclaim from the roof tops that they do not fear the
emigrants. Nevertheless they kidnap Generals KOUTEPOFF and MILLER.
They claim that they do not fear outside enemies; yet they are
retreating to any real force in a manner that is cowardly. We
have seen this in the Amur River question. Through the medium of
LITVINOFF alias VALAKHFINKELSTEIN they are opposed to pecuniary
subsidisation of emigrants.
Helpless, they are endeavouring by all means to upset and
annihilate the entire Russian emigration movement, their weakest
(from a material point) and strongest (from a moral point)enemy.
The White Russians, still existing after twenty years of "red"
power, represent a living protest against the country's
oppressors.
Russians! Satanism is on the eve of its downfall. The hour
of our return to Russia is nearing.
Recall that it was we, Russians, who first started the
struggle against these satanists, and we must finish it.
Sacrifice yourselves and sacrifice all your belongings
in the struggle. Bring to memory the words of Peter the Great:

Unite yourselves around your chiefs, around your

Each must carry out his duties in accordance with his means.

这种情绪在其他国家越来越占上风。我们将很快看到我们的国家从红色恐怖中解放出来。
我们的敌人是无能的。
他们高声宣扬他们不害怕侨民。然而，他们绑架了库捷波夫将军（General KOUTEPOFF）和米勒将军（General MILLER）。
他们声称不害怕外部敌人；然而，他们在面对任何真正的力量时都以懦弱的方式退却。我们在阿穆尔河问题上看到了这一点。通过李维诺夫（LITVINOFF），又名瓦拉赫芬克尔斯坦（VALAKHFINKELSTEIN），他们反对向侨民提供金钱资助。
由于无助，他们正竭尽全力破坏和消灭整个俄国侨民运动，这是他们最弱（从物质角度看）也是最强大（从道德角度看）的敌人。
在“红色”政权统治二十年后依然存在的白俄，代表着对国家压迫者的活生生的抗议。
俄国人！撒旦主义正处于崩溃的前夜。我们返回俄罗斯的时刻正在临近。
请记住，是我们，俄国人，首先开始了反对这些撒旦主义者的斗争，我们必须完成它。
在斗争中牺牲你们自己，牺牲你们所有的财产。记住彼得大帝的话：“失去的时间等同于死亡！”
团结在你们的领袖和组织周围。不要听信挑衅者和苏联秘密特工的话。
每个人都必须根据自己的能力履行职责。当我们回到祖国时，所有人的良心都必须是清白的。

According to the agreement between V.A.Chilikin and

his side made following suggestions:-

2. All the money due to him V.A.Chilikin will receive in

Moscow for the approval of the Goverment.

In case of the Goverment not approving this project,
V.A.Chilikin will agree to the unision of the newspapers
on one condition that all the money he is receiving now
from his newspaper will be given to him monthly.

18-3-43

ЧТО ПРЕДСТАВЛЯЕТ СОБОЮ БЕЖЕНСКАЯ
КОЛОНИЯ НА КОНЦЕССИИ
Наша беседа с директором административного отдела
ФМП—г. Делори.

В связи с тем, что японские военные власти Шанхая выпустили прокламацию касающуюся всех беженцев евреев, которые прибыли сюда с начала 1937 года и, каковые должны будут в течение трех месяцев переселиться в определенные районы города, наш сотрудник обратился к директору административного отдела ФМС — г. Делори с просьбой осветить цифровыми данными, что представляет собою беженская колония на Концессии.

До сих пор мы не входили в прямой контакт с японскими властями по этому вопросу, т. к. прокламация, подписанная старшими представителями японского флота и армии, только что опубликована, — сообщил г. Делори. — Что касается общего числа европейских беженцев, которые после массовой эвакуации из разных европейских стран расселились на Концессии, то к сегодняшнему дню их на Концессии всего 2.450 человек. Из этого числа 2.000 являются немцами, австрийцами, польскими и чешскими беженцами. Остальные 450 человек являются беженцами из разных европейских стран, прибывшими сюда три-четыре года тому назад, коих мы классифицируем общим именем «лица национальной».

ПОДЛИННОСТЬ БЕЖЕНЦЕВ — КОМИССАРЫ

На вопрос нашего сотрудника, как можно разбить по профессиям проживающих на Концессии беженцев, представитель административного отдела ФМП ответил:

Популярнее других среди них занимаются коммерцией, индустрией и торговлей; все, что можно привести этот слой населения на второй расчет идет главным образом владельцы различных коммерческих предприятий, следует дальнейшее объяснение, — то только одних хозяев кафе у нас 10 человек. Затем идут несколько ресторанов, магазины готового платья, мод, несколько парикмахерских, дамские салоны, комиссионные предприятия и разные другие, включая одно кино.

Есть также и владельцы квартир, часть которых сдают только комнаты, а некоторые сдают комнаты с полным пансионом. Если коснуться этого вопроса, то можно отметить, что много беженцев сняло себе квартиры в свое время в районах аптек и прилегающих к ней улиц. Там даже есть несколько пассажей, квартиры в которых исключительно арендованы и эксплуатируются беженцами.

Такова в общих чертах беженская еврейская колония на Концессии в большей, пока я вам сообщить не могу, потому, что весь этот вопрос находится еще в стадии обследования.

Будет ли Концессия исключена из правил, перечисленных в прокламации, если южнее границы Сеттльмента беженцам разрешено жить и работать, предоставят ли им какие либо другие льготы, или все останется так, как это было сообщено в прессе вчера утром, я сказать точно не могу, мы во всяком случае последим той кооперации, которая с нашей стороны будет необходима и, практически, число беженцев на Концессии представляют собой — всего 15 процентов их общей колонии в Шанхае.

Все эти 2.450 человек прибыли сюда в тот момент результата которого они попадают под ограничения, т. е. с начала 1937 года.

Приезжали в Шанхай и до этого года беженцы из разных стран Европы, большей частью из Германии, но их в Шанхае почти не осталось и общее число таких приехавших небольшое.

Почти что все они эмигрировали в свое время отсюда в страны Южной Америки, в Кубу и в другие места, считая, что там они смогут найти своим профессиям и знаниям большее и лучшее применение, чем здесь.

РОЗМОЖНА СМЕНА РЕЗИДЕНТСКИХ СЕРТИФИКАТОВ В БУДУЩЕМ

Если нам придется приступить к той же операции в отношении беженцев, что и на Сеттльменте, результатом этого может оказаться то, что по истечении нескольких ближайших месяцев населению будут выданы другие резидентские сертификаты. Эта мера не имеет никакого другого характера, как то, чтобы административному отделу ФМП необходимо иметь на руках точное представление о европейском населении на Концессии, а также дать точные цифровые данные в Отдел снабжения провиантом и контроль цен. Это необходимо еще и потому, что некоторые продовольственные продукты, как хлеб и сахар выдаются по карточкам и в связи с возможным массовым переселением в эту систему нужно будет внести соответствующие поправки.

Резидентские сертификаты и выдавались с таким расчетом, что по истечении известного года со дня их выдачи, они должны быть переменены на новые, закончили свою беседу с г. Делори.

B. 登记处

43年3月18日

租界内的难民聚居区究竟是何状况
——我们与法公董局行政处处长德洛里先生的谈话。

鉴于上海日本军方当局发布了一项涉及所有自1937年初以来抵达此地的犹太难民的告示，规定他们必须在三个月内迁入市内指定区域，我社记者遂向法公董局行政处处长德洛里先生请教，希望能以数据说明租界内难民聚居区的状况。

“截至目前，我们尚未就此问题与日本当局进行直接接触，因为这份由日本海陆军高级代表签署的告示刚刚发布，”德洛里先生告知。“至于在欧洲各国大规模撤离后定居于租界的欧洲难民总数，截至今日，租界内共有2,450人。其中2,000人为德国、奥地利、波兰和捷克难民。其余450人是三、四年前抵达此地的来自欧洲其他各国的难民，我们将他们统称为‘国籍人士’。”

难民中的真实身份——委员们

当我社记者询问如何按职业分类居住在租界的难民时，法公董局行政处代表回答：

在他们之中，从事商业、工业和贸易的人最为普遍；如果要进一步细分这一人口阶层，主要是各类商业企业的业主，需要进一步解释的是，仅咖啡馆老板就有10人。其次是几家餐馆、成衣店、时装店、几家理发馆、女士美容院、寄售行以及其他各种行业，包括一家电影院。

还有一些公寓业主，其中一些人只出租房间，而另一些人则提供带全膳的房间。如果谈及这个问题，可以指出的是，许多难民当时在药房附近及其周边街道租下了公寓。那里甚至有几个弄堂，其中的公寓完全由难民租赁和经营。

这就是租界内犹太难民聚居区的大致情况，目前我无法向您提供更多信息，因为整个问题仍处于调查阶段。

如果允许难民在租界以南的地区生活和工作，租界是否会被排除在告示所列规则之外，是否会给予他们任何其他优惠，或者一切是否如昨天上午媒体所报道的那样保持不变，我无法确切说明。无论如何，我们将遵循我们需要提供的合作，实际上，租界内的难民数量仅占他们在上海总聚居人数的15%。

这2,450人都是在受到限制的结果下抵达此地的，即自1937年初以来。

在此之前也有来自欧洲各国（主要是德国）的难民抵达上海，但他们在上海几乎已无留存，此类抵达者的总数很少。

他们几乎都在当时由此移民至南美各国、古巴及其他地方，认为在那里能比在这里更好地发挥他们的专业和知识。

未来可能更换居住证

如果我们不得不对难民采取与公共租界相同的行动，结果可能是几个月后将向居民发放新的居住证。这一措施没有其他性质，只是法公董局行政处需要掌握租界内欧洲人口的准确情况，并向粮食供应和物价管制部门提供准确的数据。这也是必要的，因为面包和糖等一些食品是凭配给卡发放的，鉴于可能发生的大规模迁移，需要对该系统进行相应的调整。

居住证的发放本就考虑到，在发证一定年限后，必须更换为新证，德洛里先生结束了与我们的谈话。

M. V.N. Chilin, 620 avenue Roch. Editor - M.... .loiss.

"TOUSHINTSY" EXERT THEMSELVES
8149-F16
26-1-43

One of the local traitor publications carried recently
a report, allegedly emanating from the Stefany news agency, to
the effect that a certain "territorial cossack division attach-
ed to an infantry unit ( evidently - German ) rendered the
sum of 1510 marks as a X'mas present to the german winter
relief fund!

Commenting on this report the "toushintsy" write:-

What is most valuable in this report is the confirmation
of the fact that side by side with the allied Russian and
anti-fascist armies are fighting our anti-fascist national
units! "Glory and honour to them", concludes the communication
in the 'toushintsy' newspaper.

We do not know if the report is true about a certain cos-
sack division fighting in the ranks of the german-fascist ar-
mies. If there are in Shanghai a number of defeatists and
traitors, it is logically possible to presume that in the west-
ern Europe, too, there are a handful of defeatists grouping
themselves about people like Krasnoff, Shkupsky etc.

However, we are inclined to doubt that it would be possible
to recruit a whole division of emigrants willing to shed their
blood for Germany of Hitler and fight against Russia. We do
not think that a division of voluntary traitors could be re-
cruited even amongst the elder generations of emigrants, and
we regard as absurd any supposition of the possibility of re-
cruiting such a division amongst the youth.

Unlike their elders, Russian emigrant youth in its over-
whelming majority is marked with a healthy patriotism and sin-
cere love for their native country and their people.

And yet, insofar as the existence of a "division" incorpo-
rated in the German army is mentioned, we must presume that
it was formed from the youth or, at least, from people who are
below the middle age. Anyhow, Messrs Krasnoff and such like
representatives of the hopelessly bankrupt leading class of
Russian emigrants will in any circumstances prefer to sell
other people's blood for German marks rather than shed their
own rotten blood and ,in addition, to part with their own
money.

Therefore, if the Stefany Agency's report in question is
true and not invented by the "toushintsy" sheet, then the said
"cossack division" could only have been formed by means of com-
pulsory recruiting, and not on volunteer principle, and its
formation was carried out with the assistance of the German po-
litical police and emigrant "leaders" who have build a warm
little nest for themselves under the protection of German
fascism".

Note x): This is an expression the meaning of which is equi-
valent to "traitor".

25-1-43

1943年1月27日刊登在苏联报纸《今日新闻》（Novosti Dnia）上的一篇社论的译文。出版人——M. V.N. Chilin，罗赫路（Avenue Roch）620号。编辑——M.... .loiss。

“图申齐”（Toushintsy）* 卖力表演
8149-F16
1943年1月26日

当地一家叛徒刊物最近刊登了一则报道，据称源自斯特法尼（Stefany）通讯社，内容称某支“隶属于步兵部队（显然是德军）的领土哥萨克师”向德国冬季救济基金捐赠了1510马克作为圣诞礼物！

“图申齐”在评论这则报道时写道：

这则报道中最有价值之处在于，它证实了我们的反法西斯民族部队正与盟军俄罗斯军队及反法西斯军队并肩作战！“向他们致以荣耀和荣誉”，“图申齐”报纸的通讯以此作结。

我们不知道关于某支哥萨克师在德国法西斯军队行列中作战的报道是否属实。如果上海有一些失败主义者和叛徒，那么从逻辑上讲，可以推测在西欧也有一小撮失败主义者聚集在克拉斯诺夫（Krasnoff）、什库普斯基（Shkupsky）等人周围。

然而，我们倾向于怀疑，是否有可能招募到整整一个师的流亡者，让他们愿意为希特勒的德国流血并反对俄罗斯。我们认为，即使在老一代流亡者中，也不可能招募到一个由自愿叛徒组成的师，而我们认为任何关于在青年中招募这样一个师的可能性的假设都是荒谬的。

与他们的长辈不同，绝大多数俄罗斯流亡青年具有健康的爱国主义精神和对祖国及人民的真诚热爱。

尽管如此，既然提到了并入德军的某个“师”的存在，我们必须推测它是由青年人或至少是中年以下的人组成的。无论如何，克拉斯诺夫先生之流以及那些代表俄国流亡者中已彻底破产的领导阶层的人士，在任何情况下都宁愿出卖别人的鲜血以换取德国马克，也不愿流淌自己腐烂的血液，此外还要掏出自己的钱。

因此，如果所提及的斯特法尼通讯社的报道属实，而非“图申齐”小报杜撰，那么上述“哥萨克师”只能是通过强制征募而非自愿原则组建的，其组建是在德国政治警察和那些在德国法西斯庇护下为自己筑起温暖巢穴的流亡者“领袖”的协助下进行的。

注 x)：这是一个含义等同于“叛徒”的表达。

1943年1月25日

„ТУШИНЦЫ“ СТАРАЮТСЯ.

Одно из местных тушин-
ских изданий недавно опу-
бликовало, якобы, со слов
итальянского телеграфного
агентства «Стефани», сооб-
щение о том, что какая то
«территориальная казачья ди-
визия, прикомандированная
к пехотному отряду (очевид-
но немецкому), пожертвова-
ла 1310 марок в качестве
рождественского подарка для
германской зимней помощи».
Комментируя указанное
сообщение, тушинцы пишут:
«Самым ценным в этом со-
общении является подтвер-
ждение того, что плечо к
плечу с союзными фашистски-
ми анти-коммунистическими
армиями, сражаются и наши
русские белые националь-
ные части». «Честь им и сла-
ва!» — заканчивает свое со-
общение тушинская газетка.
Мы не знаем, соответ-
ствует ли действительности
сообщение о какой то казачь-
ей дивизии, участвующей в
рядах тевтонско-фашистских
полчищ. Если у нас в Шан-
хае имеется некоторое коли-
чество пораженцев и преда-
телей, то логически можно
допустить, что и в Западной
Европе вокруг каких нибудь
Красновых, Бискупских и им
подобных группируется куч-
ка пораженцев.
Однако, мы склонны со-
мневаться, чтобы там можно
было бы собрать целую ди-
визию эмигрантов, которые
добровольно согласились бы
проливать свою кровь за гит-
леровскую Германию и идти
против России. Мы не ду-
маем, чтобы дивизия добро-
вольных предателей набра-
лась бы даже среди эмигран-
тов старшего поколения, а
уж набрать ее среди моло-
дежи или людей ниже сред-
него возраста вряд ли воз-
можно. Между тем, поскольку
речь идет о какой то «диви-
зии» входящей в состав дей-
ствующей германской армии,
то очевидно приходится пред-
полагать, что она укомплек-
тована молодежью или хо-
тя бы, людьми ниже среднего
возраста. Во всяком случае,
господа Красновы и им по-
добные представители безна-
дежно обанкротившегося ру-
ководящего слоя русской
эмиграции при всех обстоя-
тельствах предпочтут торго-
вать чужой кровью и полу-
чать за это германские мар-
ки, чем проливать свою соб-
ственную, гнилую кровь, да
еще к тому же вынимать
марки из собственного карма-
на.
Поэтому, если приведен-
ное сообщение агентства
«Стефани», действительно, со-
ответствует правде, а не из-
мышлено тушинской газет-
кой, то упомянутая «казачья
дивизия» могла бы создана
не на принципе доброволь-
чества, а исключительно
лишь путем принудительного
набора при содействии гер-
манской политической поли-
ции и при благосклонном
участии эмигрантских «ли-
деров», свивших себе теплое
гнездо под крылышком гер-
манского фашизма.
(Подпись неразборчива)
