取代基于男女相互爱情的家庭，一些法西斯“哲学家”站出来捍卫基于男性之间“感情”的“新”关系。众所周知，在众多显赫的纳粹领导人中，从希特勒和赫斯开始，理论在此情况下与同性恋关系的实践并不矛盾。在纳粹冲锋队员、卫兵、警察官员和政治领导人中，性变态已根深蒂固。家庭对于这些人来说，作为一种约束力量已不复存在。统治集团中这些恶棍的淫欲畅通无阻。身体和精神上的畸形儿戈培尔的行为已成为全德国的笑柄。据美国记者贝尔斯（Beiles）称，鲁道夫·赫斯习惯被称为“希特勒夫人”。希姆莱供养着一个由年轻女子和少年组成的后宫。这样的例子当然对那些处于希特勒匪帮下一级阶梯的人具有传染性。

希特勒政权的特点是在纳粹国家的压力下大规模解除婚姻关系。例如，德国人与少数民族代表——波兰人、犹太人、捷克人之间的婚姻被解除。与参与反法西斯示威或反法西斯政治团体的德国人的婚姻也被解除。与非雅利安出身的父母结婚的德国男子和妇女，被剥夺了对在这种“混合”婚姻中所生子女的权利。同样，纳粹国家以极大的残酷性剥夺了所有反法西斯分子对子女的 parental rights（父母权利）。

纳粹国家广泛并对持续对被认为对政权构成危险的男女实施绝育。这套破坏家庭和婚姻的措施体系影响了大量人群，仅在德国本土就不少于两百万个家庭，更不用说在德国占领区拥有不同程度德国人口层的众多家庭，例如在阿尔萨斯-洛林、波兰西部地区、“波希米亚和摩拉维亚保护国”以及苏台德地区。此外，还要加上希特勒分子在欧洲暂时占领地区因暴力行为而破碎的数百万家庭。

如果希特勒分子认为夫妻之间没有必要存在爱情，那么他们也不承认子女对父母的尊重。在希特勒的青年组织中，系统地教导告发父母，监视他们的行为，报告他们表达的观点。盖世太保系统地利用通过青年组织——即通过儿童——收集的关于父母的材料。如果孩子们“揭发”了父母，即使他们未达到法定成年年龄，其证词也被认为是充分的。对于纳粹这个社会主义国家（注：此处原文如此，指纳粹自称的国家社会主义）来说，父母不过是生产军队所需后代的制造者，因此军营应当取代家庭的位置。

只要孩子还留在家庭中，家庭就必须为军营做准备。但第三帝国甚至不敢将这件事托付给家庭。因此，学校中也充斥着军营元素；毕业后，青年进入劳动营，从中回来的青少年在道德上已经败坏，而女孩则常常遭受玷污，因为她们被送去为当地富农和地主——冲锋队领导人服务，而这些人，众所周知，是肆无忌惮的。由此引发的悲剧数不胜数。

希特勒德国将其在破坏婚姻和家庭领域的“文化成就”带到被占领和暂时夺取的国家；希特勒打算用这些来“美化”整个世界。希特勒认为，对被征服国家妇女的施暴是德国士兵的神圣权利。希特勒诉诸社会败类的卑劣情感，诉诸现代德国人心中的野兽，试图破坏人类历史世代形成的婚姻和家庭制度。在反对希特勒主义的斗争中，热爱自由的人民保护着每一个道德健全的人所珍视的东西——父亲和母亲、女儿和儿子、基于爱情的家庭和婚姻，保护文明免受食人野兽的侵害。

I. 兹瓦维奇（I. Zvavich）。

主题：1941年11月7日《Novosti Dnia》（今日新闻）上关于据称德军在苏联犯下暴行的一篇文章。
以下为刊登于1941年11月7日《Novosti Dnia》上题为“以血还血！以命抵命！”的文章摘录译文：-
“德国法西斯恶棍正像疯狂的野兽一样，疯狂地实施着他们的血腥暴行”……
“在阿尔尼亚（Alnia），德国人枪杀了一名学童舒拉·马尔莫夫（Shura Marmoff），在他的口袋里发现了一片学生用来削铅笔的安全刀片。这名男孩被指控携带武器……”
“在一个名为赫梅利尼克（Hmelnik）的地方，韦恩克（Wernke）中尉命令将所有留胡子的老人带到一个广场。二十名最年长的白发男子被带来。每三人一组，他们的胡子被系成一个结。整整一天，这些不幸的人一直脸朝上站在那里。到了晚上，他们的胡子被浸透煤油并点燃。德国法西斯分子欣赏着 helpless 受害者在痛苦中疯狂燃烧的场面。”
“在别洛斯托克（Belostok）附近的一个村庄，成千上万的路人看到了以下景象：-
在村边有5根顶端尖锐的木桩。每根木桩上都有一具女尸。所有尸体都赤身裸体，头部和乳房被割掉，腹部被剖开。附近躺着在同一地点被杀害的儿童尸体”。
“上述事实之类的事情数不胜数”……
“野兽从不折磨它们的受害者，而德国士兵——希特勒的这些道德败坏的畸形儿——却这样做，从‘法西斯地牢’逃出的齐布斯卡娅（Zibuskaya）夫人写道：-
……士兵们强行闯入卧室，在你母亲面前强奸了你的姐姐杰尼娅（Jenia）。然后他们割下她的一只乳房，并在伤口上撒盐，随后让她赤身裸体地被吊在一根杆子上。她一直挂在那里，直到一名骑摩托车路过的士兵看见她并将她枪杀。
我遭受了几乎同样的折磨，但当他们切割杰尼娅时，我从窗户跳出去逃跑了。他们向我开火，打伤了我的一只手臂，但我还是成功逃脱了……
我现在充满了仇恨和愤怒，我想把每个德国士兵撕成碎片，把他的肉扔给狗吃……

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY
No. S. D8147 E.16(6)
Date. 3 - 9 - 41

" MORE CONSIDERATION FOR DEMANDS OF WORKERS - AND
STRIKES WILL CEASE".

Commenting on the local strike situation the newspaper
points out that 1,500 wharf coolies resumed work after their
just demands had been satisfied by the administration of the
Whangpoo Wharf.

" The abnormal situation prevailing in our city at pre-
sent has for a long time been the cause of strikes, to which the
lower paid Chinese employees are often compelled to resort in
order to obtain even an insignificant improvement of their sad
material circumstances threatening them with continuous starva-
tion.

At the same time one cannot fail to note that certain
large firms and institutions have long ago granted corresponding
H.C.L. increases to their staff. However, the increases were grant-
ed in such a manner, that senior foreign employees, who had been
drawing sufficiently high salaries, received very large increases
amounting in some cases to 200%, whereas the lower paid Chinese
employees have received considerably smaller increases, which
just enable them to make both ends meet.

It is not to be wondered therefore that the strike
wave not only does not subside, but on the contrary continues to
grow, causing serious disorganization of the economic life in
this city, which already cannot boast of living a peaceful life".

5-9-41

“更多考虑工人的要求——罢工将会停止”。

该报在评论当地罢工时局时指出，在黄浦码头管理处满足了其正当要求后，1500名码头苦力恢复了工作。

“目前我们城市中存在的异常局势长期以来一直是罢工的原因，低收入的中国雇员往往被迫采取罢工手段，以获得哪怕是一点点对其悲惨物质状况的改善，这种状况威胁着他们面临持续的饥饿。

同时，不得不注意到，某些大型公司和机构早已向其员工发放了相应的生活成本津贴（H.C.L.）增加额。然而，增加额的发放方式使得原本薪水就足够高的外籍高级员工获得了非常大幅度的增加，在某些情况下高达200%，而低收入的中国员工获得的增加额则要小得多，仅能勉强维持收支平衡。

因此，罢工浪潮不仅没有平息，反而继续扩大，导致这座城市经济生活的严重混乱，而这本已无法夸耀拥有和平的生活，这就不足为奇了”。

1941年9月5日

SUBJECT: Article in the "Novosti Dnia" containing objectionable remarks.

In accordance with the instructions of the
A.C. ( Special Branch ), Mr. V.A. CHILIKIN, publisher of
the "NOVOSTI DNIA", was communicated with by 'phone on
17-7-41 in connection with the attached translation of
extracts from an article which appeared in his paper
on 16-7-41.

His attention was drawn to the passage, a
translation of which reads as follows:-

"There are two Russians in the service of
the Germans who spread German propaganda
over radio. One of these renegades was at
one time employed as a business manager in
the Russian newspaper which has its offices
in Avenue Joffre."

It was pointed out to Mr. Chilikin that
while politics etc. may be discussed in a general way,
insulting expressions such as "renegade" used in respect of local residents who can be easily identified,

In reply Mr. Chilikin promised to bear this
point in mind and also stated that in future he would
consult the Special Branch in cases of doubt prior to
publication of items concerned.

Translation of extracts from a leading article which appeared
in Russian newspaper "NOVOSTI DNIA" on 16-7-41. Published by
Mr. V.A. Chilikin, 620 Avenue Foch. Editor - Mr. A.I.Veiss.

EXPOSE HITLER'S LIES!

Pointing out that German propaganda is very active
throughout the world and that it is necessary to counter-
act this propaganda by every means possible, the newspaper
inter alia writes:-

"The struggle against Hitler's propaganda is the
struggle against his fifth column. It is the duty of every
Russian patriot to counteract its pernicious effect in all
its forms whenever and wherever possible.

We would like to mention that a Russian fifth co-
lumn is already active in Shanghai, but without success. Thus,
for instance, there are two Russians in the service of the
Germans who spread German propaganda over radio. One of these
renegades was at one time employed as a business manager in
the Russian newspaper which has its offices in Avenue Joffre (1).
The Germans have several radio stations and three Russian
newspapers which publish undisguised German propaganda (2).
It also is very strange that Reuter, United Press and
International News Service agencies often carry information
emanating from Berlin. However, despite all this we are
confident that local Russians will not swallow German bait.
Numerous letters received by this newspaper bear evidence that
Russian emigrants are fully in favour of the Soviet Union and
Motherland."

"Here in Shanghai the Germans endeavour to attract on
their side as many Russians as possible. To the shame and dis-
grace of certain " White Russian gentlemen" we must state that
there are partisans of Germany amongst them. We will not
mention their names nor do we intend to give the names of paid
Russian agents of the German propaganda service and Gestapo.
In due time they will be branded with the names they
deserve."

"Russian population in Shanghai will never allow
themselves to be influenced by the German propaganda machine.
But this is not enough. We should not only refuse to be
influenced by German propaganda, but also destroy its effects
wherever they are in evidence."

Translator's notes:

(1) The only Russian newspaper with the offices in Avenue
Joffre is the "Shanghai Zaria".

(2) Russian newspapers whose attitude towards the present
Soviet-German war may be described as openly "defeatist"
in respect of the Soviet Government are " Russian Times",
"Our Way " and " Russian Vanguard".

b/nh 17-7-41.
page_data.zh:
1941年7月16日俄文报纸《NOVOSTI DNIA》（今日新闻）上发表的社论摘录译文。由福煦路620号的 V.A. Chilikin 先生出版。编辑 - A.I. Veiss 先生。

揭露希特勒的谎言！

该报指出，德国宣传在全世界非常活跃，有必要通过各种可能的手段 counteract 这种宣传，其中写道：-

“反对希特勒宣传的斗争就是反对他的第五纵队的斗争。每一位俄罗斯爱国者都有责任在任何时候、任何地方尽可能 counteract 其各种形式的有害影响。

我们要提到的是，上海的俄罗斯第五纵队已经在活动，但没有成功。例如，有两名俄罗斯人为德国人服务，通过无线电传播德国宣传。其中一名叛徒曾在一家位于霞飞路(1)的俄罗斯报社担任业务经理。德国人有几个广播电台和三份公开发表毫不掩饰的德国宣传的俄罗斯报纸(2)。同样奇怪的是，路透社、合众社和国际新闻社经常刊载源自柏林的信息。然而，尽管如此，我们相信当地俄罗斯人不会吞下德国的诱饵。本报收到的大量信件证明，俄罗斯侨民完全支持苏联和祖国。”

“在上海，德国人努力争取尽可能多的俄罗斯人站在他们一边。令某些‘白俄绅士’感到羞愧和耻辱的是，我们必须指出，他们中间有德国的支持者。我们不会提及他们的名字，也不打算公布德国宣传机构和盖世太保付费的俄罗斯代理人的名字。在适当的时候，他们将受到他们应得的称号的谴责。”

“上海的俄罗斯人口绝不会让自己受到德国宣传机器的影响。但这还不够。我们不仅应该拒绝受德国宣传的影响，还应该在其显现之处消除其影响。”

译者注：

(1) 唯一办公地点在霞飞路的俄罗斯报纸是《Shanghai Zaria》（上海黎明报）。

(2) 对当前苏德战争的态度可描述为对苏联政府公开持“失败主义”态度的俄罗斯报纸是《Russian Times》（俄罗斯时报）、《Our Way》（我们的道路）和《Russian Vanguard》（俄罗斯先锋报）。

b/nh 1941年7月17日。

Special Branch /Station. File No.................... Date July 14, 1941.

SUBJECT: Cartoon in the "Novosti Unia" derogatory to Russian Emigrants Committee - Editor interviewed.

With reference to the attached cartoon which appeared in the "Novosti Unia" yesterday, Mr. V.A. CHILIKIN, publisher of the newspaper in question, was interviewed by the A.C. ( Special Branch ) on 14-7-41 at Headquarters.

It was pointed out to him that the Police strongly object to articles, cartoons etc. tending to create friction between the Soviet and emigrant sections of the Russian community and likely to lead to a breach of the peace in the Settlement. He was also reminded of his letter dated 25-9-37 in which gave an undertaking to (a) "cease attacks on White Russians in this community" and (b) to refrain from publishing objectionable or abusive matter of any kind".

In reply Mr. Chilikin expressed his regrets for the appearance of the cartoon which, according to him, was due to an oversight on the part of his editor. At the same time he raised the point of alleged discrimination on the part of the Police in favour of other local newspapers such as the "Far Eastern Times", which he said frequently attacked him.

He was told that his allegation was entirely unfounded.

A. Prokopieff
D. I.

主题：《Novosti Unia》报刊登贬损俄国侨民委员会的漫画——已约谈编辑。

就昨日《Novosti Unia》报刊登的附呈漫画一事，该报出版人 V.A. CHILIKIN 先生于1941年7月14日在总局接受了特科助理总监（A.C.）的约谈。

向他指出，警方强烈反对那些旨在制造苏联派与俄侨社区之间摩擦、并可能导致租界内破坏和平的文章、漫画等。同时提醒他注意其1937年9月25日的信函，他在信中承诺 (a) “停止攻击本社区的白俄”，以及 (b) “ refrain from publishing objectionable or abusive matter of any kind”（ refrain from publishing... 此处原文为英文，意为：避免刊登任何令人反感或辱骂性的内容）。

作为回应，Chilikin 先生对漫画的刊登表示遗憾，据他称，这是由于其编辑的疏忽所致。同时，他提出警方涉嫌歧视，偏袒其他本地报纸，如《远东时报》（Far Eastern Times），他说该报经常攻击他。

被告知他的指控毫无根据。

A. Prokopieff
D. I.

Appeal of the Russian Emigrants Committee
to Russian emigrant community in Shanghai
which appeared in all Russian newspapers
on 9-7-41.

TO RUSSIAN EMIGRANT COMMUNITY IN SHANGHAI

In view of the present events in our Motherland, where
torrents of Russian blood are now being shed, the Rus-
sian Emigrants Committee calls upon all members of the
local Russian emigrant community to refrain from visit-
ing any places of amusement and to discontinue holding
of any soirees, balls and other similar entertainments in-
cluding those arranged for charity purposes.
During the present fateful days through which our Mother-
land is passing every honest Russian emigrant should de-
vote himself and all his thoughts to our long suffering
country and pray to God to help our Great People in its
present sufferings and to restore the Holy Russia in all
her former Glory and Greatness.

N.A. IVANOFF
Chairman of the Russian Emigrants
Committee

July 8, 1941
Shanghai.

俄国侨民委员会致上海俄国侨民社区的呼吁书
该呼吁书于1941年7月9日刊登在所有俄文报纸上。

致上海俄国侨民社区

鉴于我们祖国目前发生的 events，那里正流淌着大量俄国人的鲜血，俄国侨民委员会呼吁当地俄国侨民社区的所有成员避免前往任何娱乐场所，并停止举办任何晚会、舞会及其他类似娱乐活动，包括那些为慈善目的安排的活动。
在我们祖国经历的这些决定命运的日子里，每一位诚实的俄国侨民都应将自身及全部思想奉献给我们长期受难的祖国，并向上帝祈祷，帮助我们的伟大人民度过目前的苦难，恢复神圣俄罗斯昔日的荣耀与伟大。

N.A. IVANOFF
俄国侨民委员会主席

1941年7月8日
上海。

Rumour of future destruction of the
Russian Daily News Paper Offices.

At 10 p.m. 2-7-41 a telephone message was received
from Mr. V. A. Chilikin, Publisher of the Russian Daily
News No. 620 Avenue Foch, reporting that he had received
information that an attempt would soon be made to destroy
his newspaper offices at the above address.

On receipt of the above report F.P.S. Usenko, C.D.C.
91 and the undersigned immediately proceeded to the scene
and there interviewed Mr. V.A. Chilikin. He stated that :
at about 8.45 p.m. 2-7-41 a Mr. Nicolay Klenoff, who
resides at Lane No. 456 House No. 79 Rte Prelupt (F.C.)
and who has on previous occasion, been employed by Mr.
him to repair his printing machines, came to his offices
and informed him that he had heard a rumour, that some
Russians, working for Germans, were planning to destroy
the Russian Daily Newspaper Plant, but refused to state
from whom he had heard same.

Mr. N. Klenoff then told Mr. Chilikin that, that was
all he had heard at present, but should he obtain any
definite proof of same being true, he would immediately
inform Mr. V.A. Chilikin in person.

Mr. Chilikin further stated that he would call Mr.
N. Klenoff to his office on the morning of the 3-7-41
when he could be questioned by investigating officers.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / SPECIAL BRANCH）

关于《Russian Daily News》报社将来可能遭到破坏的谣言。

1941年7月2日晚上10点，接到《Russian Daily News》出版人 V. A. Chilikin 先生（地址：福煦路620号）的电话留言，报告称他收到消息，有人企图不久后破坏上述地址的他的报社办公室。

收到上述报告后，法租界警务处（F.P.S.）Usenko、中央侦探课（C.D.C.）91号及本人立即赶赴现场，并在那里约谈了 V.A. Chilikin 先生。他陈述如下：
1941年7月2日晚上约8点45分，一位 Nicolay Klenoff 先生来到他的办公室。Klenoff 先生住在法租界（F.C.）Prelupt 路（音译）456弄79号，此前曾受 Chilikin 先生雇佣修理印刷机。他告知 Chilikin 先生，他听到一个谣言，称一些为德国人工作的俄国人正计划破坏《Russian Daily Newspaper》印刷厂，但他拒绝说明是从何处听到此消息的。

随后 N. Klenoff 先生告诉 Chilikin 先生，这就是他目前所听到的一切，但如果他获得确凿证据证明此事属实，他将立即亲自通知 V.A. Chilikin 先生。

Chilikin 先生进一步表示，他将于1941年7月3日上午叫 N. Klenoff 先生到他的办公室，以便调查人员对其进行询问。

Telephone messages of a threatening
nature received by the Russian Daily
News.

At 7.15 p.m. 22/6/41, a telephone message was
received from the Russian Daily News, 620 Avenue Foch,
to the effect that telephone calls of a threatening
nature had been received and requesting Police protec-
tion.

A visit was paid to the scene and Mr. V.A. Chilikin,
Publisher of the said newspaper interviewed. He stated
that at about 4.30 p.m., 5 p.m. and 6 p.m. 22/6/41, he
received three telephone messages. Each was from a
different person who declined to identify himself. All
spoke guttural Russian and all the messages were in a
similar vein to the effect that "Our Germans have now
attacked your Russia and within the next two or three
days we will attack your newspaper office and smash all
the windows."

Mr. Chilikin requested that a police officer be
posted outside the premises for the next few days.

C.P.C. posted.

page_data.en:
Translation of an article which appeared in Russian newspaper
"Novosti Dnia" on 14-4-41. Published by Mr. V.A. Chilikin,
620 Avenue Foch, Editor - Mr. A.I. Veiss.

A PROBLEM OF THE DAY FOR THE S.M.C.

Municipal Council should increase the number of
Russian residents participating in the activities
of its committees

Soviet citizens should be included
in these committees

（批：Con.
Sir
I /
[签名]
16/4）

The question of the proposed reform of the Shanghai Muni-
cipal Council has naturally brought up the old question of Rus-
sian representation.

However, a serious consideration of this question will
show that it is not so easy to solve it as it may seem.

Of course, there cannot be any doubt that Soviet citizens
are fully entitled to representation on the S.M.C., if the usu-
al criterion is to be applied in this case. But, as is generally
known, the Soviet Union's attitude in her relations with China
is quite different than those of other powers, and therefore it
seems to us that the question of inclusion of Soviet councillors
in the S.M.C. cannot be decided in a hap-hazard manner.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL
COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE
16 APR 1941）

In any case, we think that should a Soviet citizen's can-
didature for the post of Municipal Councillor be nominated, he
would have to carefully consider his consent not only from the
viewpoint of his qualifications to work in this capacity, but
also from the viewpoint of conformity of such functions with
the general policy of his country. This is a very important
point, insofar as unity of thought of the Soviet people is ge-
nerally recognized and rests on an objective foundation.

In other words, the problem of inclusion of Soviet repre-
sentatives in the Shanghai Municipal Council is in the first
place a problem affecting Soviet citizens themselves, and inso-
far as they have not shown any desire to participate in the ac-
tivities of the directing organs of the municipal administration,
page_data.zh:
1941年4月14日俄文报纸《Novosti Dnia》刊登文章的译文。
由 V.A. Chilikin 先生出版，地址：福煦路620号，编辑 - A.I. Veiss 先生。

上海公共租界工部局的当日议题。

工部局应增加参与其委员会活动的俄国居民人数

苏联公民也应被纳入这些委员会

（批：Con.
Sir
I /
[签名]
16/4）

上海公共租界工部局拟议改革的问题自然引发了关于俄国代表权的旧问题。

然而，认真考虑这一问题将会表明，解决它并不像看起来那么容易。

当然，如果在此案中适用通常的标准，毫无疑问苏联公民完全有权在上海公共租界工部局中获得代表权。但是，众所周知，苏联在与中国的关系中的态度与其他列强截然不同，因此我们认为，将苏联议员纳入上海公共租界工部局的问题不能以随意的方式决定。

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL
COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE
16 APR 1941）

无论如何，我们认为，如果提名苏联公民担任市政议员候选人，他不仅需要从具备担任此职资格的角度，还需要从该职能是否符合其国家总体政策的角度，仔细考虑是否同意接受提名。这是一个非常重要的点，因为苏联人民的思想统一性是普遍公认的，并建立在客观基础之上。

换句话说，将苏联代表纳入上海公共租界工部局的问题，首先是一个影响苏联公民自身的问题，而且既然他们尚未表现出参与市政管理机构指导机构活动的愿望，

page_data.en:
- 2 -

the latter was quite right in not bringing up the question of
Soviet representation.

Insofar as Russian emigrants are concerned, the question
acquires a somewhat different aspect and presents its own pe-
culiar points, although of a quite different nature than the
considerations referred to above. The first peculiar point is
that certain emigrant circles are still under the influence of
political and quasi-political ideas and therefore, being not
accustomed to serious work, are likely to obstruct the activities
of the municipal apparatus by the introduction of various un-
necessary "interpellations"...

Of course, we do not think that such activities real-
ly could have a disintegrating effect on the work of a well or-
ganized body, such as the Municipal Council, but why should
anything be added to a mechanism, which is likely to obstruct
and not to improve its functioning?

This is why, while remaining on the platform of de-
fense of the interests of the Russian community in Shanghai,
we do not at present raise the question of Russian representa-
tion on the S.M.C.

But, on the other hand, we deem it expedient and im-
portant to stress the necessity of increasing the number of
Russian residents working in the various committees of the
S.M.C.

As our readers, probably, remember, the "Novosti Dnia"
was successful in insisting on the inclusion of Messrs Gran
and Zakharoff in such committees.

Now, insofar as this experiment has shown definite
results, it is to be expected that the S.M.C. will make a lar-
ger use of the experience possessed by the Russian community.

This measure will be useful both in itself and as a
means of securing the participation of Russian residents in
municipal affairs and and giving them an opportunity of gain-
ing experience in municipal work.
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

那么后者不提出苏联代表权问题是完全正确的。

至于俄国侨民，这个问题呈现出 somewhat different aspect（略有不同的方面），并具有其自身的特殊点，尽管性质与上述考虑因素完全不同。第一个特殊点是，某些侨民圈子仍然受到政治和准政治思想的影响，因此，由于不习惯于严肃的工作，他们可能会通过引入各种不必要的“质询”来阻碍市政机构的运作……

当然，我们不认为此类活动真的会对像工部局这样组织良好的机构的工作产生瓦解作用，但是，为什么要向一个可能会阻碍而非改善其运作的机制中添加任何东西呢？

因此，虽然站在捍卫上海俄国社区利益的立场上，我们目前不提出在上海公共租界工部局中设立俄国代表权的问题。

但是，另一方面，我们认为强调增加在上海公共租界工部局各委员会中工作的俄国居民人数是必要且重要的。

正如我们的读者可能记得的那样，《Novosti Dnia》曾成功坚持将 Gran 和 Zakharoff 先生纳入此类委员会。

现在，既然这一实验已显示出明确的结果，可以预期上海公共租界工部局将更多地利用俄国社区拥有的经验。

这一措施本身就有用，同时也是确保俄国居民参与市政事务并使他们有机会获得市政工作经验的手段。

page_data.en:
- 3 -

It is possible that the principles referred to above
will not prevent Soviet citizens from participation in the work
of committees of the S.M.C. It goes without saying that the
participation in public life of our city of citizens of a count-
ry with the most developed public life in the world will be a
great asset to the entire cosmopolitan community of this city.

At present, when the new Municipal Council will have
to overcome a number of difficulties, a mobilization of elements
capable of work, is one of its most important tasks.

It would not be wise to neglect the possibility of uti-
lizing the forces of the Russian community.

We think that our plan of securing the participation
of Russian residents in the work of the various municipal commit-
tees, i.e. in practical work, is under the present circumstances
the most expedient means of cooperation between the Russian com-
munity of the municipal authorities.

We hope that the municipal authorities will not leave
this suggestion without a consideration.

16-4-41.
page_data.zh:
- 3 -

上述原则可能不会阻止苏联公民参与上海公共租界工部局委员会的工作。不言而喻，拥有世界上最发达公共生活的国家的公民参与我们城市的公共生活，将是这座城市整个国际社区的一大财富。

目前，当新工部局必须克服许多困难时，动员有能力工作的元素是其最重要的任务之一。

忽视利用俄国社区力量的可能性是不明智的。

我们认为，我们确保俄国居民参与各市政委员会工作（即实际工作）的计划，在目前情况下是俄国社区与市政当局之间最权宜的合作方式。

我们希望市政当局不会对此建议不予考虑。

1941年4月16日。

page_data.en:
Очередная задача ШМС.
Муниципальный Совет должен расширить число русских резидентов, работающих в его комиссиях.
Советские граждане должны быть приглашены в состав этих комиссий.

Вопрос о реформе Шанхайского Муниципального Совета естественно возбудил в умах русской колонии старый вопрос о русском советнике.

Однако, если не подходить к этому вопросу с кондачка, его далеко не так легко решить, как кажется.

Дело в том, что, конечно, не может быть никаких сомнений, что советский гражданин имеет все права на представительство в ШМС, если применять обыкновенные критерии, играющие роль в данном случае. Но, как известно, Советский Союз в своих отношениях с Китаем занимает совершенно особую позицию, отличную от позиции других государств и поэтому, думается, и в вопросе об участии советских советников в ШМС нельзя решать задачи с плеча.

Во всяком случае, с нашей точки зрения, советский гражданин, кандидатура которого была бы выставлена на пост муниципального советника, должен был бы тщательно обсудить свое согласие не только с точки зрения своей пригодности работать на этом посту, но и под углом соображений таких функций с основной линией его страны. Обязательность этого весьма важна, поскольку ку автономия советского народа является общепризнанной, а Китай под собою объединяет одну страну.

Другими словами, проблема участия советских представителей в Шанхае есть проблема политическая, а не только техническая, и поэтому ее следует решать очень осторожно.

них не проявлялось желания участвовать в работе руководящих органов муниципальной администрации, последняя поступила вполне правильно, не выдвинув кандидатуру советских резидентов.

Несколько иначе обстоит вопрос об эмигрантах, который имеет свои «но», конечно, иного свойства, чем соображения, приведенные выше. Первое «но» сводится к тому, что некоторые эмигрантские круги все еще находятся под влиянием политических идей, и поэтому, благодаря неприязни к серьезной работе смогут затруднить работу муниципального аппарата внесением в него ненужных «интерпелляций»...

Мы не думаем, конечно, что эти действия смогут действительно оказать разлагающее влияние на работу такого хорошо налаженного механизма, как ШМС, но для чего придавать машине то, что будет хоть сколько-нибудь мешать, а не улучшать ее деятельность?

Вот почему, оставаясь на платформе защиты интересов русской колонии в Шанхае — мы не поднимаем сейчас вопроса о русском советнике в ШМС.

Но за исключением нужным и нужным голосом необходимости участия русских в комиссиях ШМС.

Как показывает опыт, работа в комиссиях ШМС дает возможность русским резидентам принести пользу городу и своей колонии. За время работы в комиссиях ШМС русские резиденты показали себя хорошими работниками и принесли городу большую пользу.

надо полагать, что Муниципальный Совет шире использует опыт русской колонии. Такое начинание будет полезно не только само по себе, но и, как способ вовлечения русских в муниципальную работу, как способ приобщения их к муниципальному опыту.

Возможно, что те принципиальные соображения, о которых нами писалось выше, могут не помешать советским гражданам принять участие в комиссиях ШМС — не приходится говорить, что участие в общественной жизни нашего города граждан любой общественности сферы мира будет большим приобретением для всей международной колонии нашего города.

Во всяком случае, в настоящее время, когда новому муниципалитету предстоит преодолеть целый ряд трудностей, мобилизация деловых сил является одной из важнейших его задач.

И пренебрегать при этой задаче силами резидентов той же русской колонии будет неправильно.

Мы полагаем, что предлагаемая мера поможет привлечь к муниципальной работе новые силы и даст возможность использовать опыт и знания русских резидентов для блага всего города.

Надо надеяться, что новый муниципалитет оценит по достоинству предложение о привлечении русских резидентов к работе в комиссиях ШМС и примет соответствующие меры для осуществления этой важной задачи.

Р. Фукс.

工部局的当前任务。
工部局应当增加在其各委员会中工作的俄籍居民的人数。
苏联公民应被邀请加入这些委员会。

关于上海工部局改革的问题，自然在俄侨群体中激起了关于俄籍董事这一老问题。

然而，如果不草率行事，解决这个问题远非看起来那么容易。

事实是，当然毫无疑问，如果适用在此情况下起作用的通常标准，苏联公民完全有权利在工部局中获得代表权。但是，众所周知，苏联在与中国的关系中占据着与其他国家完全不同的特殊地位，因此，我们认为，在苏联顾问参与工部局的问题上，也不能轻率地解决任务。

无论如何，从我们的观点来看，如果被提名为市政董事候选人的是一位苏联公民，他不仅应从其胜任该职位的角度，还应从其职能与其国家基本方针相协调的角度，仔细考虑其是否同意任职。这种必要性非常重要，因为苏联人民的自治是公认的，而中国在其之下统一为一个国家。

换句话说，苏联代表参与上海事务的问题是一个政治问题，而不仅仅是技术问题，因此应非常谨慎地解决。

鉴于他们并未表现出参与市政管理机构领导层工作的愿望，工部局不提出苏联居民候选人的做法是完全正确的。

关于流亡者（白俄）的问题则略有不同，其存在的“但是”当然与上述考虑的性质不同。第一个“但是”在于，某些流亡者圈子仍然受到政治思想的影响，因此，由于对严肃工作的厌恶，他们可能会通过引入不必要的“质询”来阻碍市政机构的工作……

我们当然不认为这些行动真的能对像工部局这样运作良好的机制产生腐蚀性的影响，但为什么要给机器添加哪怕是一点点阻碍而非改善其运行的东西呢？

因此，立足于保护上海俄侨利益的立场——我们目前不提出在工部局中设立俄籍董事的问题。

但我们强调俄籍居民参与工部局各委员会工作的必要性和呼声。

经验表明，在工部局各委员会工作使俄籍居民有机会为城市及其社群带来益处。在工部局各委员会工作期间，俄籍居民证明自己是优秀的工作人员，并为城市带来了巨大的好处。

可以推测，工部局将更广泛地利用俄侨群体的经验。此举不仅本身有益，而且作为让俄国人参与市政工作、使他们接触市政经验的一种方式，也是有益的。

有可能，上述原则性考虑并不妨碍苏联公民参与工部局的各委员会——毋庸赘言，任何社会领域的公民参与我们城市的公共生活，都将是我们城市整个国际社群的一大收获。

无论如何，在目前新市政当局面临克服一系列困难之际，动员商业力量是其最重要的任务之一。

在此任务中忽视同一俄侨群体居民的力量将是错误的。

我们认为，所提议的措施将有助于吸引新的力量参与市政工作，并利用俄籍居民的经验和知识造福整个城市。

希望新市政当局能充分重视关于吸引俄籍居民参与工部局各委员会工作的提议，并采取相应措施实施这一重要任务。

R. Fuchs.

IT IS HIGH TIME TO DO SO!

One cannot but welcome the initial steps taken by
the S.M.C. in order to put the public life of this city on a
sounder basis.

In the first place, being beneficial in themselves,
these steps will bring about definite results. Secondly, the
new "bills" should be regarded as constituting a certain pre-
cedent in the sense of extension of the Council's functions.
Indeed, a study of local conditions - which obvious-
ly abnormal at present -will show that many of Shanghai sores
cannot be cured without an intervention on the part of the ad-
ministration.
And these sores require prompt attention and treat-
ment.

So much has been written in our journal regarding
the present high cost of living that our readers would cer-
tainly be tired of this question but for the fact that they
themselves feel the heavy burden of the continuously rising
prices.

To many thousands ( and if the Chinese population is
included - to many tens of thousands ) of residents this means
starvation.

The problem of opening of a network of cheap eating-
houses, provision stores etc., which should function not as cha-
ritable institutions, but be based on principles of pub-
lic mutual aid, acquires an urgent character.

The first word in this matter belongs to the munici-
pal administration, as otherwise all plans of putting the pub-
lic life in this city on a sounder basis will remain on pa-
per.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE 4 APR. 1941）

是时候这样做了！

人们不得不欢迎工部局为使本市公共生活建立在更坚实基础之上而采取的初步步骤。

首先，这些步骤本身有益，并将带来确定的结果。其次，新的“法案”应被视为在扩展工部局职能方面构成某种先例。的确，对当地状况的研究——目前显然不正常——将显示，若无行政当局的干预，上海的许多弊病无法治愈。
而这些弊病需要迅速关注和治疗。

本刊已就当前高昂的生活成本撰写了如此多的文章，以至于如果不是读者亲身感受到物价持续上涨带来的沉重负担，他们肯定会对这个问题感到厌倦。

对成千上万（如果包括中国人口，则是数万）居民来说，这意味着饥饿。

开设一个廉价食堂、食品店等网络的问题变得紧迫，这些机构不应作为慈善机构运作，而应基于公共互助的原则。

在此事上，市政当局必须率先发声，否则所有将本市公共生活置于更坚实基础之上的计划都将停留在纸面上。

（印章：上海工部局总监办公室 1941年4月4日）

Шанхай, 2 апреля.
Давно пора!

Начинания ШМС, направленные к оздоровлению жизни нашего города нельзя не приветствовать.
Во первых, эти начинания полезны сами по себе и дадут определенные результаты.
Во вторых, новые «законопроекты» надо считать своего рода прецедентом в смысле того расширения функций муниципалитета, о каком нами уже писалось.
Действительно, всматриваясь в шанхайскую жизнь сейчас — жизнь явно ненормальную — видишь, что без указки, без административного вмешательства, многие из ее язв не излечишь.
А эти язвы требуют скорого лечения.
Мы уже столько раз писали о дороговизне, что этот вопрос, наверное, набил бы оскомину нашему читателю, если бы он не испытывал на себе всю тяжесть растущих цен, если бы эти цены не давили бы его.
На лицо систематическое недоедание тысяч (а если считать китайское население) десятков тысяч.
Так становится во весь рост проблема широкой сети дешевых столовых, дешевых потребительских пунктов и т. д., построенных не на началах благотворительности, а на основах общественной взаимопомощи.
Администрации должно принадлежать первое слово в этом деле, иначе все разговоры об оздоровлении шанхайской жизни останутся разговорами.
Теперь, соприкасаясь с первым, идет второй вопрос — вопрос о социальном страховании.
Не надо закрывать глаза на то, что бесплатная медицинская помощь поставлена в нашем городе несравненно хуже, чем в городах Европы и Америки, а между тем, Шанхай достаточно крупный центр, чтобы не отставать в этом отношении от кого бы то ни было.
Разве в этом направлении нельзя сделать много (одновременно улучшая положение многих десятков тысяч, которых отнюдь не дает им... хлеба с маслом).
В связи с наступающими переговорами в Шанхайский Муниципальный Совет, шанхайской общественности необходимо поставить во весь рост проблему «реформ» именно этого рода, то есть настаивать на вменении в обязанность муниципалитету принять на себя решение ряда задач, направленных к улучшению материального положения резидентов.
Если бы Шанхай не жил бы в течении последних лет мыслью о том, что вот-вот все кончится и «возвратятся золотые дни Аранжуэца», если бы эти годы были бы потрачены на выработку «иммунитета» против чревоугодных войною бедствий, наше положение было бы многим лучше, чем оно сейчас.
Но «лучше поздно, чем никогда».
Законопроект ШМС показывает с полной убедительностью, что высшая муниципальная администрация начинает понимать необходимость вмешательства в те сферы жизни, которые раньше не входили в состав ее компетенции.
Этот хороший почин должен быть расширен.
Мы твердо убеждены в том, что в своей деятельности, направленной к улучшению общего положения, муниципальные власти будут опираться на широкие общественные круги и организовывать их.
Перед шанхайской общественностью раскрываются огромные перспективы полезной, нужной, необходимой работы.
И мы убеждены, что для решения ее понадобится достаточно опытных руководителей, умеющих разрешить все стоящие вопросы.
Нужен только общий командующий организм.
И этот организм мы надеемся услышать в ближайшие дни. Сегодняшний день будет днем...

上海，4月2日。
早就该这样了！

工部局旨在改善我们城市生活的举措不得不令人欢迎。
首先，这些举措本身有益，并将产生确定的结果。
其次，新的“法案”应被视为一种先例，意味着我们此前曾写过的市政职能的扩展。
的确，审视当前的上海生活——明显不正常的生活——可以看到，若无指引，若无行政干预，其中的许多弊病是无法治愈的。
而这些弊病需要迅速治疗。
我们已经写过如此多次关于物价高昂的文章，以至于如果不是读者亲身感受到价格上涨的全部重压，如果不是这些价格压迫着他们，这个问题肯定会让我们的读者感到厌烦。
成千上万（如果计算中国人口，则是数万）人的系统性营养不良已成事实。
因此，建立广泛的廉价食堂、廉价消费点等网络的问题变得突出，这些设施并非建立在慈善基础上，而是建立在公共互助的基础上。
在此事上，行政当局必须拥有首要发言权，否则所有关于改善上海生活的谈论都只会是空谈。
现在，紧接着第一个问题的是第二个问题——社会保险问题。
不要闭眼不看这样一个事实：我们城市的免费医疗援助设置远不如欧洲和美国的城市，然而，上海是一个足够大的中心，在这方面不应落后于任何人。
难道在这方面不能做很多事情吗（同时改善许多数万人的处境，他们目前甚至无法获得...面包和黄油）。
鉴于即将进行的上海工部局选举，上海公众有必要全面提出此类“改革”问题，即坚持要求市政当局承担解决一系列旨在改善居民物质状况的任务。
如果上海在过去几年里没有生活在这样一种想法中，即一切即将结束，“阿兰胡埃斯的黄金日子”即将回归；如果这些年被用来制定针对战争带来的灾难性贫困的“免疫力”，我们的处境会比现在好得多。
但“迟做总比不做好”。
工部局的法案以充分的说服力表明，最高市政当局开始理解有必要干预那些以前不属于其职权范围的生活领域。
这一良好的开端应当扩大。
我们 firmly 相信，在其旨在改善总体状况的活动中，市政当局将依靠广泛的公众圈子并组织他们。
上海公众面前展现出有用、必要、必需工作的巨大前景。
我们确信，为了解决这一问题，需要足够多的有经验的管理者，他们懂得如何解决所有现存问题。
只需要一个统一的指挥机构。
我们希望在这个机构在未来几天内听到声音。今天将是...的一天

Commr. of Police.
Sir:
Information 11/1/41
（签名）

POLICE MUST HAVE RUSSIAN INSPECTORS.

A.C. (SWB) We have 13 Russian Sub-Inspectors who have for many
years been serving in the police in a self-denying manner,
have often risked their lives and rendered meritorious
service to the community.

Several days ago we noted the promotion of Sub-In-
spector P.M. PAVCHINSKY, one of the old Russian members of the
Shanghai Municipal Police, who was appointed assistant chief
of the Kashing Road Police Station, while remaining in his pre-
sent rank (1).

THIS FIRST PROMOTION OF A RUSSIAN MEMBER OF THE PO-
LICE UNDOUBTEDLY BRINGS UP THE QUESTION OF PROMOTION OF SEVE-
RAL RUSSIAN VETERAN MEMBERS OF THE MUNICIPAL POLICE TO A
HIGHER RANK.

At present there are in the Criminal Investigation
Department of the S.M.Police several outstanding Russian de-
tectives in the rank of Sub-Inspector, which has been the high-
est rank a Russian member could attain, irrespective of his
merits. There also are several Russian Sub-Inspectors in the
Uniform Branch of the Police.

However, up to the present, despite many years of ser-
vice accompanied with the risk of life, despite the outstand-
ing services rendered by these guardians of peace and order in
Shanghai, there still is no Russian Inspector in the Force, al-
though Russian Sub-Inspectors not only fully deserve this pro-
motion, but in many cases are more deserving candidates than some
of their colleagues who were made Inspectors recently.

During the course of several years of self-denying
service these Russian detectives should deserve more considera-
tion on the part of their senior officers, because there is no
work, which would be of a more risky and self-denying nature

警务处长。
先生：
1941年1月11日情报
（签名）

警方必须拥有俄国籍督察。

A.C. (SWB) 我们有13名俄国籍副督察，他们在警队中多年来一直无私奉献地服务，经常冒着生命危险，为社区做出了值得称道的贡献。

几天前，我们注意到上海公共租界工部局警务处的老资格俄国籍成员之一、副督察 P.M. PAVCHINSKY 获得晋升，他被任命为嘉善路巡捕房助理巡官，同时保留其现有职级 (1)。

这是警务处俄国籍成员的首次晋升，这无疑提出了将几名市政警察中的俄国籍资深成员晋升至更高职级的问题。

目前，在工部局警务处刑事侦缉处（Criminal Investigation Department）有几名杰出的俄国籍侦探，其职级为副督察，这一直是俄国籍成员无论功绩如何所能达到的最高职级。在警务处制服部门（Uniform Branch）也有几名俄国籍副督察。

然而，迄今为止，尽管这些上海治安与秩序的守护者多年服务并伴随生命风险，尽管他们做出了杰出贡献，但警队中仍然没有一名俄国籍督察，虽然俄国籍副督察不仅完全配得上这一晋升，而且在许多情况下比最近被任命为督察的一些同事更具备资格。

在这些年的无私奉献服务过程中，这些俄国籍侦探理应得到其上级官员更多的关照，因为没有什么工作比他们一直在从事的工作更具风险性和自我牺牲精神，

Every Shanghailander knows the good work, which all
these Russian members of the Municipal Police have been car-
rying out in Shanghai, where there are so many international
criminal elements, the struggle against whom requires special
skill, personal qualities, experience, courage and real fearles-
sness with which each of these men look straight in the face

The majority of Russian members of the Force who
have been promoted to the rank of Sub-Inspector started their
respective careers in the Police at the time when Russians
were engaged on equal terms with foreigners as ordinary con-
stables. They were promoted to the rank of Sergeant for me-
ritorious work and not by appointment, as is now the practice,
and therefore they have rendered substantial and priceless
service to many residents and ratepayers of this city at the

他们的工作时刻面临着被杀或受伤的风险。

在市政警察成员中，有一些制服副督察，他们的名字为整个俄国和外侨社区所熟知，因为这些名字每天都因侦破各种严重犯罪而出现在报刊上。在一些俄国籍副督察的服务记录中，此类案例不在少数。

这些侦探是：反鸦片科侦探副督察 D.D.I. A. ALEXANDROFF；虹口巡捕房侦探副督察 D.D.I. A. LOSIAKOFF；中央巡捕房侦探副督察 D.D.I. V.V. OVOIANNIKOFF；汇山巡捕房（Wayside Station）侦探副督察 D.D.I. S.I. SHIROKIH；南市巡捕房侦探副督察 D.D.I. D.P. SMIRNOFF；以及警队老成员、侦探 P.P. ANOVILOFF、A.O. MIPTINSKY 和 I.V. GOLOUBOFF。

在制服部门有以下几位警队老资格的俄国籍成员：制服副督察 S.I. A. VERHOVSKY、S.I. A.A. LANDROFF 和 S.I. P.M. PAVCHINSKY。

每个上海人都知道所有这些市政警察中的俄国籍成员在上海所做的出色工作，那里有如此多的国际犯罪分子，与他们斗争需要特殊的技能、个人素质、经验、勇气以及真正的无畏精神，这些人中的每一个都直面死亡。

大多数已晋升为副督察职级的警队俄国籍成员，是在俄国人与外国人以同等身份担任普通巡捕（constables）时开始其警察生涯的。他们是因为工作有功而晋升为警长（Sergeant），并非像现在这样通过任命，因此，在他们警察工作的初期，就为本市的许多居民和纳税人提供了实质性和无价的服务。

侦破一系列重大犯罪，取缔危险的武装团伙和伪造者，取缔恐怖组织，五名俄国籍成员在与匪徒的不平等搏斗中丧生，以及俄国籍警员中出现多名伤残人员——这难道不构成上海公共租界工部局警务处俄国籍成员对其上级官员和公众做出的值得称道的服务吗？

将副督察晋升为督察，对被晋升者而言在经济上并无太大意义，主要具有道德价值。薪资差异不应在此问题中起主要作用。

每一位市政警察的俄国籍副督察，以及每一位上海俄国居民，都将获得道德上的满足感，他们有充分的权利和理由为他们的同胞感到自豪，因为这些同胞正自觉地在这个拥有数百万人口的城市中为和平与秩序的利益而工作。

我们认为，上海的俄国社区将完全赞同并支持我们的观点。

在市政警察刑事侦缉处和制服部门服务的13名俄国籍副督察，应根据其功绩，因其无私奉献的工作而获得奖励。

NOVOSTI DILA, JANUARY 10, 1941.

Полиция должна иметь русских инспекторов.
Мы имеем 13 русских субинспекторов, самоотверженно работающих в полиции, оказавших большие заслуги, зачастую рисковавших своей жизнью и принесших большую пользу обществу.

Несколько дней тому назад мы сообщали о повышении одного из старых русских служащих шанхайской муниципальной полиции — суб-инспектора, П. М. Цветинского, назначенного помощником начальника полицейского участка Кингрод, с сохранением чина суб-инспектора.
Это повышение первого русского агента полиции не случайно, а является следствием повышения роли русских в служебных отделах муниципальной полиции в последнее время.
В настоящее время в рядах уголовного розыска отдела муниципальной полиции имеется ряд выдающихся русских детективов в чине суб-инспекторов, которые являются незаменимыми помощниками русских офицеров полиции. Мы не можем перечислить всех заслуг этих русских суб-инспекторов перед русской и иностранной публике, так как эти имена не сходят со страниц местных газет, будучи связаны с раскрытием тех или иных крупных преступлений. Подобных дел есть немало в послужном списке каждого из этих русских суб-инспекторов.
Таковыми детективами являются детективы политического отдела, суб-инспектор Б. С. Маклаевский детектив полицейского участка Хонкью — суб-инспектор А. И. Белошеин, детектив Центрального полицейского участка, суб-инспектор В. И. Овсяников, детектив полицейского участка района Вейсайд, суб-инспектор Э. И. Гигаров, детектив полицейского участка Ляуза, суб-инспектор Д. П. Суков, детективы отдела русских служащих Т. Т. Коновалов, А. Ф. Рогальский и И. В. Голубев.

Все указанные выше русские суб-инспекторы, помимо своих прямых обязанностей, выполняют также и другие поручения начальства, связанные с охраной общественного порядка и спокойствия. Их работа высоко ценится как русским населением, так и иностранной публикой, которая часто обращается к ним за помощью и советом.
Таким образом, можно сказать, что русские суб-инспекторы являются неотъемлемой частью шанхайской полиции и играют важную роль в поддержании порядка и безопасности в городе.

Как это практикуется сейчас, поэтому они приносят существенную и неоценимую пользу многочисленным резидентам и малочисленным шиком нашего города уже с первых шагов своей работы.
Достаточно напомнить нашим читателям раскрытие таких крупных преступлений, как ограбление в 1939 году известного в Шанхае немецкой фирмы «Карлсон», крупные аферы И. И. Иванова и его шайки, которая оперировала в чисто международном масштабе, попытка поджога склада Македам, где была выловлена вся шайка поджигателей и афера со страховкой сорвалась, попытка похищения китайских бандитов братьев Артур и других.

Согласно мнению полиции производство в чин инспекторов теперь производится по заслугам и по порядку в зависимости от выслуги лет, знания языка и исполнения своего долга.
Раскрытие крупных преступлений, таких как террористические акты, убийства, грабежи и другие, требует от сотрудников полиции высокой квалификации, опыта и мужества. Русские суб-инспекторы, работая в полиции, проявляют себя как настоящие профессионалы, способные решать самые сложные задачи.
Их вклад в борьбу с преступностью неоспорим, и они заслуживают уважения и признания со стороны всего общества.

《每日新闻》，1941年1月10日。

警方必须拥有俄国籍督察。
我们有13名俄国籍副督察，他们在警队中无私奉献地工作，做出了巨大贡献，经常冒着生命危险，并为社会带来了巨大益处。

几天前，我们报道了上海公共租界工部局警务处的一名老资格俄国籍雇员——副督察 P. M. Tsvetinsky（音译）的晋升消息，他被任命为金罗德（Kingrod，音译）巡捕房助理巡官，保留副督察职级。
这第一名俄国籍警员的晋升并非偶然，而是近期俄国人在市政警察各部门中角色提升的结果。
目前，在市政警察刑事侦缉处队伍中，有一批杰出的俄国籍侦探担任副督察职级，他们是俄国籍警官不可或缺的助手。我们无法列举所有这些俄国籍副督察对俄国和外侨公众的所有功劳，因为这些名字与当地报纸上披露的各种重大犯罪案件的侦破紧密相连，从未离开过版面。在每个俄国籍副督察的履历中，此类案件不在少数。
此类侦探包括：政治部侦探、副督察 B. S. Maklaevsky（音译）；虹口巡捕房侦探、副督察 A. I. Beloshein（音译）；中央巡捕房侦探、副督察 V. I. Ovsianikov（音译）；韦赛德（Wayside，音译）地区巡捕房侦探、副督察 E. I. Gigarov（音译）；辽扎（Liauza，音译）巡捕房侦探、副督察 D. P. Sukov（音译）；以及俄国雇员部的侦探 T. T. Konovalov（音译）、A. F. Rogalsky（音译）和 I. V. Golubev（音译）。

上述所有俄国籍副督察，除了履行其直接职责外，还执行上级下达的其他与维护公共秩序和安宁相关的任务。他们的工作受到俄国居民和外侨公众的高度评价，后者经常向他们寻求帮助和建议。
因此，可以说，俄国籍副督察是上海警察不可或缺的一部分，并在维持城市秩序和安全方面发挥着重要作用。

正如目前的做法一样，因此，从他们工作的第一步起，他们就为本市众多居民和少数权贵（原文不清，可能指特定群体）带来了实质性和无价的益处。
足以提醒我们的读者回忆以下重大犯罪的侦破情况：1939年上海知名德国公司“卡尔森”（Carlson，音译）遭抢劫案；I. I. Ivanov（音译）及其团伙的大型欺诈案，该团伙以纯粹的国际规模运作；马凯丹（Makedam，音译）仓库纵火未遂案，当时整个纵火团伙被抓获，保险欺诈阴谋破产；绑架中国匪徒兄弟 Arthur 等人（原文表述混乱，似指前文提到的Sofer兄弟或其他人）的企图。

根据警方的观点，目前晋升督察职级是根据功绩、资历年限、语言知识和职责履行情况按顺序进行的。
侦破恐怖主义行为、谋杀、抢劫等重大犯罪，要求警察人员具备高水平的资格、经验和勇气。俄国籍副督察在警队工作中表现出真正的专业能力，能够解决最复杂的任务。
他们在打击犯罪方面的贡献是不容置疑的，他们值得全社会的尊重和认可。

September 2, 1940.

On or about August 5, Mr. Chilikin, editor of the
"Novosti Dnia" (Russian Daily News), complained of receiving
telephone messages in which threats were used. At this time, the
Far Eastern Times, a newspaper printed in the Russian language
and owned by a Japanese subject, published articles condemning
Mr. Chilikin as a Comintern agent responsible for acts of terro-
rism. In a conversation with Mr. Gubb, Deputy Secretary, it was
agreed that no written reply be sent in answer to Mr. Chilikin's
letter dated August 5, and addressed to the Secretary and
Commissioner General.

This, in view of the fact that Chilikin called at Police
Headquarters when the animosity which has been and is still
exhibited between his newspaper and that of Mr. K. Kuroki, was
thoroughly discussed.

I personally am of the opinion that Mr. Chilikin greatly
exaggerated any actual threats used against him over the tele-
phone. If, as he intimates, he is constantly in need of Police
protection, it is surprising to find him frequenting all kinds
of places of amusements at all hours.

Mr. Chilikin states he is pro-Soviet in sympathies. Many
reports allege that he is an active Soviet agent. Whichever
view is accepted there is no doubt Mr. Chilikin has only
himself to blame for any threats issued against him for his
double-dealing is notorious and he is otherwise thoroughly
unscrupulous.

From a political point of view, I do not consider Mr.
Chilikin or his newspaper office to be in any extraordinary
danger at the moment, hence police protection as now afforded
is unnecessary.

Certified true copy
(signature)
------------------
JHS.
page_data.zh:
1940年9月2日。

8月5日前后，《Novosti Dnia》（《俄罗斯日报》）编辑奇利金（Chilikin）先生投诉称，他接到含有威胁内容的电话留言。在此期间，一份由日本臣民拥有、以俄文出版的报纸《远东时报》（Far Eastern Times）刊登文章，谴责奇利金先生是负责恐怖主义行为的共产国际代理人。在与副秘书古布（Gubb）先生的谈话中，双方商定，不对奇利金先生8月5日致秘书兼总巡捕的信函发出书面回复。

这是因为，当奇利金前来警察总局时，已就其报社与黑木（K. Kuroki）先生报社之间过去存在且目前仍在持续的敌意进行了充分讨论。

我个人认为，奇利金先生大大夸大了通过电话对他发出的任何实际威胁。如果像他暗示的那样，他不断需要警方保护，那么发现他在各种时间频繁出入各类娱乐场所就令人惊讶了。

奇利金先生声称自己同情苏联。许多报告指称他是活跃的苏联特工。无论接受哪种观点，毫无疑问，奇利金先生因任何针对他的威胁而受到的指责只能归咎于他自己，因为他的两面派手法臭名昭著，且在其他方面完全肆无忌惮。

从政治角度来看，我认为奇利金先生或其报社目前并未处于任何非凡的危险之中，因此目前提供的警方保护是不必要的。

核证无误副本
（签名）
------------------
JHS.

Translation of an article which appeared in the "Diovani

THREE YEARS IMPRISONMENT TO FABREN
- for conducting gambling den -

if Articles 266-270 of the Chinese Criminal Code
will be enforced in Badlands

Gambling has always been prohibited in China and an
appropriate provision to this effect is contained in Ar-
ticles 266 - 270 of the Chinese Criminal Code.

According to this law, persons conducting public gamb-
ling, professional gamblers and those who allow their premises
to be used for public gambling, may be punished with imprisonment
of not more than three years and fine of $ 3,000.

Article 270 provides for a similiar punishment of Guardi-
ans of law giving protection to such persons, the punishment
in their case being increased by 1/2.

It should be noted that in respect of owners of opium
dens and heroin dealers, the Code provides for a court-martial
and capital punishment.

be left at our offices for only another week, and will be
taken away after that.

I think that this is much
too early, as all foreign newspapers at present are under police
protection, and our newspaper requires this protection
particularly.

I hope, Mr. Phillips, that
you will agree with my views, and will do whatever you can to
leave us this protection.

Thanking you, I remain
Yours truly

(Signed) V. Chilikin

SHANGHAI, 30 August 1940

Major Bourne
Commisioner,
Shanghai Municipal Police.

Dear Sir,
Some three weeks ago, I
received, along with other foreign editors, threats against my
life. As a result of this, the Municipal Police, with your
permission, placed two Chinese policemen on guard at our
offices, and for these three weeks we have had no trouble at
all.

Only today I was informed
by the Chengtu Road Station Inspector Mr. Lees that the policemen were
to be left at the newspaper for only one more week, after
which they would be taken away.

I think that this is much
too early yet, as most of the foreign newspapers continue to
stay under police protection, which our newspaper needs now more
than ever.

I hope, Mr. Commissioner,
that you will agree with our views and our necessities and will
permit the continuance of the police guard.

Thanking you, I remain,
Yours Truly
Vas. Chichin

page_data.en:
Translation of articles which appeared in Japanese-sponsored
Russian newspaper "Far Eastern Times" on 4.8.40. Edited
and published by Mr. K. Kuroki, 409 East Seward Road.

1. Article entitled "CHILIKIN AND HIS GANG - IN SERVICE
OF RED TERROR" - The "Novosti Dnia" throw true light
on assassination of Ch. E. Metzler - Criminal inciting
of one part of population against another - Authorities
should pay their attention to this nest of agents of
Comintern.

If on the day of the dastard assassination of Mr. Ch. E.
Metzler, Chairman of the Russian Emigrants' Committee, the true
motive of this terrorist act could be doubted by anybody, yester-
day's issue of the Soviet paper "Novosti Dnia" has dispelled all
doubts.

The "Novosti Dnia", by applying a series of petty
dishonest tricks, misrepresentations, and hints has in black on
white corroborated in an eloquent manner that Mr. Metzler's
assassination is a deed of their new masters - agents of the
Comintern so successfully operating in Shanghai.

This, in the first place, is apparent from the
awkward attempts to concoct a version, dictated by their red
masters, regarding the alleged organization of the assassination
"somewhere" on the other side of the creek, merely mentioning
that information to this effect has been obtained "from well
informed private circles".

We, as well as the majority of Russian residents in
Shanghai, know perfectly well these "well informed private sources"
although we cannot avail ourselves of these sources as freely as
the lads from Chilikin's gang.

These criminal "sources" have organized and carried
out the assassination of Mr. Ch. E. Metzler and now continue their
dastard provocative activities through the medium of Chilikin
whom they have bought over lock, stock and barrel.

The assassination was planned with a view to bringing
discord within the emigrant community, and now the same agents
of the Comintern hope to profit considerably from this crime
page_data.zh:
1940年8月4日日本支持的俄文报纸《远东时报》（Far Eastern Times）所刊文章的译文。由西华德路409号K. Kuroki先生编辑出版。

1. 标题为“奇利金及其团伙——服务于红色恐怖”的文章——《每日新闻》（Novosti Dnia）揭示了Ch. E. 梅茨勒遇刺案的真相——煽动一部分居民反对另一部分的犯罪行为——当局应关注这个共产国际代理人巢穴。

如果在俄罗斯移民委员会主席Ch. E. 梅茨勒先生遭到卑鄙暗杀的那一天，还有人怀疑这一恐怖行为的真实动机，那么昨日苏联报纸《每日新闻》的版面已消除了所有疑虑。

《每日新闻》通过运用一系列卑劣的欺骗手段、歪曲事实和暗示，白纸黑字地雄辩地证实，梅茨勒先生的遇刺是其新主子——在上海活动得如此成功的共产国际代理人——所为。

首先，这一点从他们笨拙地试图编造由其红色主子授意的版本中显而易见，该版本称暗杀组织工作是在“河对岸某处”进行的，仅仅提到此类信息是从“消息灵通的私人圈子”获得的。

我们以及上海大多数俄罗斯居民都非常清楚这些“消息灵通的私人来源”，尽管我们不能像奇利金团伙的那些家伙那样自由地利用这些来源。

这些犯罪的“来源”组织并实施了对Ch. E. 梅茨勒先生的暗杀，现在继续通过他们已完全收买的奇利金进行卑鄙的挑衅活动。

策划这次暗杀是为了在移民社区内部制造不和，现在同样的共产国际代理人希望从这一罪行中大获利益

page_data.en:
- 2 -

by utilising the obedient hired scribes in the "Novosti Dnia".
To start with, a story has been invented regarding
a motor car alleged to have arrived to Mr. Metzler's house
several days ago, in which "apart from two Chinese and two
representatives of an Asiatic race, there was a foreigner".
The bad disservice rendered to his masters by Chilikin
by involving "two representatives of an Asiatic race" in this
episode is quite apparent, as anyone who is even superficially
familiar with the methods of "work" of the Comintern agents, knows
that there are large cadres of subordinate agents at their
disposal, comprised of representatives of all known Asiatic races.
Thus, even supposing that the said episode is likely
to have taken place, it does not in any way change the main point
of this affair - the organization of the assassination by agents
of the Comintern.
Furthermore, in an article under the provocative
headline "Competitors", a stupid and inexperienced scribe from
Chilikin's gang has made a mess of intrigues around Mr. Metzler
and the Emigrants' Committee, originated by the very same bosses
of the "Novosti Dnia", the formation of Association of Russian
Emigrants, the newspaper "Far Eastern Times" and the series of
articles which is being published in this paper regarding the
history of representation of the Russian community in Shanghai.
It is precisely this part of yesterday's "Novosti Dnia"
that was intended to "honestly" carry out the task entrusted to
this paper and to make the finest possible mess of Mr. Metzler's
assassination.
However awkwardly has this task been carried out,
it has to a certain extent reached its goal : the communists
have succeeded in having publicly carried out one of their basic
tasks, namely, - to instigate, wherever possible, one part of the
population against another.
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

利用《每日新闻》中那些听话的雇佣文人。起初，他们编造了一个故事，称几天前有一辆汽车抵达梅茨勒先生家，车上“除了两名中国人和两名亚洲种族代表外，还有一名外国人”。

奇利金在这一事件中牵涉进“两名亚洲种族代表”，从而给他的主子帮了倒忙，这是显而易见的，因为任何哪怕只是 superficially 熟悉共产国际代理人“工作”方法的人都知道，他们手下拥有由所有已知亚洲种族代表组成的大批下属代理人。

因此，即使假设所述事件确实发生过，这也丝毫不会改变此事的重点——即暗杀是由共产国际代理人组织的。

此外，在一篇题为“竞争者”的挑衅性标题文章中，奇利金团伙中一名愚蠢且缺乏经验的文人搞砸了围绕梅茨勒先生和移民委员会的阴谋，这些阴谋正是由《每日新闻》的同一批老板发起的，包括俄罗斯移民协会的成立、《远东时报》以及本报正在发表的关于上海俄罗斯社区代表权历史的一系列文章。

昨日的《每日新闻》正是这部分内容旨在“诚实地”执行赋予该报的任务，并将梅茨勒先生遇刺案搅得一团糟。

然而，无论这项任务完成得多么笨拙，它在一定程度上达到了目的：共产党人成功地公开执行了他们的一项基本任务，即尽可能煽动一部分居民反对另一部分居民。

page_data.en:
- 3 -

On account of his stupidity Chilikin's youthful
assistant included in his mess the exact address of the
institution to which the attention of people affected by the
communist propaganda should be directed.

Leaving aside, for the time being, all the lies and
misrepresentations regarding our newspaper, we strongly and
emphatically protest against the impudent and unscrupulous
outburst of the "Novosti Dnia".

Chilikin, his gang and their common masters hope in
vain that the situation in the International Settlement will
enable them not only to carry out terrorist acts with impunity,
but also to continue in peace "good work" despite any revelations.

Inciting of one part of the population against another
in an act punishable by laws of any country, and we shall insist
that Chilikin's provocative outburst, however well it has been
paid for, be nipped in the bud.

The Consular Body have just adopted the decision
regarding suppression of terrorism of any kind by every means.
To-day's criminal outburst of the "Novosti Dnia" render that
paper as direct associate in the present terrorist acts and
the authorities must in good time call the hired agents-
provocateurs to order.

Fully sharing the viewpoint of the Consular Body and
all administrative authorities regarding the necessity of
suppressing terror we, on our part, will render every assistance
within our power to the measures adopted by them.

In particular, having taken note of the recent
criminal outburst of Chilikin's "Novosti Dnia", we warn this
paper and its genuine and fictitious proprietors, that the "Far
Eastern Times" will not leave without attention a smallest
detail of their "work" of facilitating and developing terrorism
and will struggle against this in a most energetic manner and
by every means at out disposal.
page_data.zh:
- 3 -

由于愚蠢，奇利金的年轻助手在他的混乱叙述中包含了确切地址，指出受共产主义宣传影响的人们应注意该机构。

暂时撇开关于我们报纸的所有谎言和歪曲不谈，我们强烈且坚决地抗议《每日新闻》无耻且肆无忌惮的爆发。

奇利金、他的团伙及其共同的主子徒劳地希望，公共租界的局势不仅能让他们逍遥法外地实施恐怖行为，还能让他们在任何揭露面前继续平静地进行“良好工作”。

煽动一部分居民反对另一部分居民是任何国家法律都惩罚的行为，我们将坚持要求将奇利金的挑衅性言论，无论其报酬多么丰厚，扼杀在萌芽状态。

领事团刚刚通过了一项决定，即采取一切手段镇压任何形式的恐怖主义。今日《每日新闻》的犯罪性言论使该报成为当前恐怖行为的直接同伙，当局必须及时命令这些受雇的代理挑衅者守规矩。

我们完全赞同领事团和所有行政当局关于镇压恐怖主义必要性的观点，我们将尽己所能协助他们采取的措施。

特别是，鉴于奇利金的《每日新闻》最近的犯罪性言论，我们警告该报及其真正和名义上的所有者，《远东时报》不会忽视他们促进和发展恐怖主义“工作”的任何细微细节，并将以最大精力和利用我们掌握的一切手段与之斗争。

page_data.en:
- 4 -

2. Article entitled "Unwanted mourners"
Stressing the point that the assassination of
Mr. Ch. E. Metzler was carried out on instructions of the
Comintern, the article takes note of a sudden change in the
attitude of the "Novosti Dnia" towards the late Ch. E. Metzler,
who, as is well known, always was the target of that paper's
insinuations. Mr. Chilikin, it is alleged, has been
instructed by the Comintern agents to pose as mourner and to
express his sympathies to the Russian emigrants community
in connection with the crime, but this "volte face" will deceive
no Russian emigrant. Chilikin has nothing whatever to do
with their mourning.
page_data.zh:
- 4 -

2. 标题为“不受欢迎的哀悼者”的文章

文章强调Ch. E. 梅茨勒先生的遇刺是奉共产国际指令执行的，并注意到《每日新闻》对已故Ch. E. 梅茨勒态度的突然转变，众所周知，梅茨勒一直是该报影射攻击的目标。据称，奇利金已接到共产国际代理人的指示，要扮演哀悼者的角色，并就这一罪行向俄罗斯移民社区表示同情，但这种“彻底转变”骗不了任何俄罗斯移民。奇利金与他们的哀悼毫无关系。

page_data.en:
August 4,1940

Report of "Novosti Dnia" re: inauguration of "Association of
Russian Emigrants" at 409 East Seward Road denied by Gen.Kosmin.

With reference to the endorsement of D.C. ( Spe-
cial Branch ) on the attached translation from the "No-
vosti Dnia" of 3-8-40, General V.D. Kosmin was communi-
cated with by phone on 3-8-40.
He stated that there is no truth in the report
of the "Novosti Dnia" regarding the proposed inaugura-
tion of the "Association of Russian Emigrants in Shang-
hai" on August 7 at No. 409 East Seward Road.
General Kosmin,it will be recalled, was mentio-
ned in previous reports on this matter as the moving
spirit in the scheme of establishing the above menti-
oned Association.
page_data.zh:
1940年8月4日

科斯明将军否认《每日新闻》关于在西华德路409号成立“俄罗斯移民协会”的报道。

关于特别处（Special Branch）对附上的1940年8月3日《每日新闻》译文的批示，已于1940年8月3日通过电话与V.D. 科斯明将军联系。

他表示，《每日新闻》关于拟于8月7日在西华德路409号成立“上海俄罗斯移民协会”的报道不实。

page_data.en:
Translation of extracts from an article which appeared in the
"NOVOSTI DNIA" of 3-8-40 . Publisher - Mr. V.A. Chilikin,
620 Avenue Foch. Editor - Mr. A.I. Veiss.

ASSASSINATION OF Ch.E. METZLER

was worked out in detail by the criminals who visited vi-
cinity of his home previously and saw his motor car.

...." At this time a black motor car was slowly
proceeding along the opposite side of the road. The assas-
sin jumped into it. Apart from driver there were 3or 4 Chi-
nese in the car. Perhaps they were not Chinese, but represen-
tatives of other Asiatic nations - I could not tell exactly.."

...." The Police refused to furnish any information
yesterday as to the ownership of the car in question... but
from well informed private sources we were able to find out
during the evening that the garage to which the motor car be-
longs, is located "somewhere" on the other side of the Creek".

...."A few days prior to the assassination a motor
car arrived to Mr. Metzler's home. Apart from two Chinese and
two representatives of an Asiatic race there was a foreigner
in the car.
According to the Chinese who witnessed this
"visit" the foreigner explained something to his companions
pointing out to them Mr. Metzler's motor car which was ranked
near the entrance to Apartment No 208.
However, we have been unable to ascertain whe-
ther or not this had anything to do with the assassination"..

...." Although Mr. Ch.E. Metzler in his capacity of
the head of the Russian Community had many enemies who did not
share his opinions, there are no reasons whatever to suppose that
these enemies have made arrangements for his liquidation. The
struggle between Mr. Ch.E. Metzler and these persons was a
matter of principle only.
Political intrigues originated following the
organization by some irresponsible elements in Shanghai and
certain " Harbin stars" of a new Russian organization named
"Association of Russian Emigrants" which was to commence its
activities about two months ago. However, not only Mr. Ch. E.
Metzler, but the majority of members of the Russian community
refused to recognize the necessity of this organization.
Mr. Metzler's opposition compelled the lea-
ders of the new organization to postpone the beginning of their
activities. However, it became known yesterday that in the
absence of any rival the new organization proposes to start
its activities on August 7 at 10.00 a.m. at 491 Bund Road.
At the same address is located the newspaper "Far East-
ern Times".
The latter newspaper published during the past
two weeks a series of articles entitled "Reorganization of
Russian community in Shanghai" which contained references of
not a flattering character to Mr. Metzler who was accused of
a number of things."

1940年8月3日《每日新闻》所载文章摘录译文。出版人——V.A. 奇利金先生，福煦路620号。编辑——A.I. 韦斯先生。

Ch.E. 梅茨勒遇刺案

是由此前曾探访其住所附近并见过其汽车的罪犯详细策划的。

……“当时，一辆黑色汽车正沿马路对面缓慢行驶。刺客跳入车内。除司机外，车内还有3或4名中国人。也许他们不是中国人，而是其他亚洲民族的代表——我无法确切分辨……”

……“警方昨天拒绝提供有关涉事汽车归属的任何信息……但从消息灵通的私人来源，我们在晚间获悉，该汽车所属的车库位于‘河对岸某处’。”

……“在暗杀发生前几天，一辆汽车抵达梅茨勒先生家。除两名中国人和两名亚洲种族代表外，车内还有一名外国人。
据目睹此次‘拜访’的中国人称，那名外国人向同伴解释了一些事情，指着停在208室公寓入口附近的梅茨勒先生的汽车。
然而，我们未能查明这是否与暗杀有关……”

……“虽然Ch.E. 梅茨勒先生作为俄罗斯社区领袖有许多不认同其观点的敌人，但没有任何理由推测这些敌人安排了对其的清除。梅茨勒先生与这些人之间的斗争仅仅是原则问题。
政治阴谋始于上海一些不负责任分子和某些‘哈尔滨明星’组织了一个名为‘俄罗斯移民协会’的新俄罗斯组织，该组织原定于约两个月前开始活动。然而，不仅Ch. E. 梅茨勒，而且俄罗斯社区的大多数成员都拒绝承认该组织的必要性。
梅茨勒先生的反对迫使新组织的领导人推迟开始其活动。然而，昨日获悉，在没有任何竞争对手的情况下，新组织提议于8月7日上午10时在外滩路491号开始活动。
同一地址也是《远东时报》报社所在地。
该报在过去两周发表了一系列题为‘上海俄罗斯社区重组’的文章，其中包含对梅茨勒先生不利的提及，他被指控犯有多项罪行。”

这在多大程度上并未改变事件的实质——即由共产国际代理人组织的谋杀案。

此外，在那篇带有挑衅性标题《竞争者》的短评中，奇利金（Chilikin）团伙中的一名年轻笔杆子愚蠢地将围绕 K. E. 梅茨勒（K. E. Metzler）和难民委员会的阴谋混为一谈，而这些阴谋正是由《每日新闻》（Novosti Dnia）的所有者、俄罗斯难民协会的组织者以及《远东时报》（Far Eastern Times）报纸及其刊登的关于上海俄罗斯难民代表机构历史的文章所策划的。

正是在昨天《每日新闻》的这一部分中，意图“诚实地”执行收到的任务，以更猛烈地掩盖由杀害 K. E. 梅茨勒的凶手所煮成的这锅粥。

尽管这一课完成得并不成功，但其目标在某种程度上还是达到了：共产党人得以在其活动基础之一——即煽动一部分居民反对另一部分居民——在任何可能的地方进行印刷传播。

出于年轻人的愚蠢，这位追随奇利金的人将其市侩式的文章以及应当引导那些被共产主义宣传扭曲了大脑的人们注意力的确切地址也塞了进去。

暂时搁置针对我社论的谩骂和歪曲不谈，我们对《每日新闻》无耻且厚颜无耻的行径提出坚决而明确的抗议。

奇利金、他的团伙及其共同所有者徒劳地希望，上海国际化的环境使他们不仅能够不受惩罚地实施恐怖行为，而且能够不顾任何揭露，继续从事同样的持续活动。

煽动一部分居民反对另一部分居民是对国家后果最为危险的行为，我们将坚持要求制止并惩罚奇利金及其同伙的挑衅行径，无论这些现象多么令人厌恶。

只有犯罪者才面临惩罚。恐怖主义和挑衅必须被制止并受到惩罚。

《每日新闻》的行径使其成为当前恐怖主义的直接共犯，当局有义务及时责令受雇的挑衅者守规矩。

我们完全赞同领事团及所有行政当局关于不可……

Непрошенные болѣльщики
4-VIII

«Цѣль оправдываетъ сред-
ства», — это основной
лозунгъ большевиковъ. Стре-
мясь къ той или иной цѣли,
они сегодня могутъ говорить
одно, завтра — противо-
положное тому, что говорятъ
сегодня...
Вотъ — жгучая злоба дня
— убійство К. Э. Меццера.
Для насъ это — тяжелая
драма въ нашей эмигрант-
ской семьѣ. Въ нашей душѣ
она оставляетъ глубокій
слѣдъ.
Для насъ это несомнѣнно
ударъ по эмиграціи со
стороны тѣхъ, кто заинтере-
сованъ въ разложеніи рус-
ской анти-коммунистической
эмигрантской семьи, кто
борется съ объединеніемъ
эмиграціи, всячески мѣшаетъ
этому объединенію.
Убійство К. Э. Меццера —
сильный ударъ по эмигра-
ціи, сдѣланный опытной
рукой враговъ эмиграціи —
агентовъ Коминтерна.
Это такъ хотя бы только
потому, что какъ только К.
Э. Меццеръ сталъ безжизнен-
нымъ трупомъ, немедленно
послѣдовалъ отвѣтный ударъ
со стороны большеви-
ковъ.
А объ этомъ отношеніи мы
знаемъ хорошо, читая изо
дня въ день большевистскія
изданія противъ К. Э.
Меццера и Старой Газеты.
Старая Газета въ категориче-
ской формѣ отвѣчала за
К. Э. Меццера, правда, не
являясь газетой эмигрант-
ской колоніи.
А теперь эта газета пи-
шетъ, что идетъ большая
борьба въ эмигрантской
семьѣ, что «большевики»
убили К. Э. Меццера якобы...

И еще дальше отмѣчаетъ:
«Хотя К. Э. Меццеръ, по
своему положенію главы
русской колоніи, и имѣлъ
много идейныхъ враговъ, —
нѣтъ никакихъ основаній
предполагать, что эти вра-
ги приняли мѣры къ его
ликвидаціи. Борьба между
К. Э. Меццеромъ и этими
лицами носила чисто прин-
ципіальный характеръ».
Въ этой послѣдней фразѣ
сдѣланъ тонкій намекъ. Этотъ
намекъ сквозитъ и въ другихъ
мѣстахъ отчета объ убійствѣ,
тамъ, гдѣ указывается на
представителей «другихъ
азіатскихъ народностей». Ко-
роче, Чичеринъ пытается сва-
лить вину «съ больной голо-
вы на здоровую», заметаетъ
слѣды, ведущіе къ комму-
нистическимъ очагамъ, какъ ли-
са, дѣлаетъ петли, сбивая съ
правильнаго пути разслѣ-
дованіе этого дѣла.
Обстоятельства и шан-
хайскій коминтерновскій
центръ приказали Чичерину
прикосаться и гордо шав-
хинской эмигрантской ко-
лоніи.
Чичеринъ прикосался.
Чичеринъ даже траурное
объявленіе на первой стра-
ницѣ помѣстилъ, — смотрю-
те, какъ я вамъ сочувствую и
какъ васъ понимаю...
Въ моменты глубокой пе-
чали бываютъ у человѣка
настроенія, когда напро-
тившаго и завѣдомо неис-
кренняго «болѣльщика» (да
простятъ мн читатели это
большевистское словечко)
хочется взять за шиворотъ
и съ силой вышвырнуть вонъ
изъ дома...
Къ нашему трауру Чиче-
ринъ абсолютно посторонній
человкъ. Мало того, Чиче-
ринъ въ дѣловомъ и идейномъ
контактѣ съ Коминтерномъ,
виновникомъ нашего траура.
На этомъ дѣлѣ Чичеринъ и
К-о пытаются создать гран-
діозную провокацію. Ис-
пользовать это дѣло для
того, чтобы еще болѣе
разстроить антикоммуни-
стическіе ряды эмиграціи.
Но эта попытка должна
дать результаты какъ разъ
обратные тѣмъ, какихъ Чиче-
ринъ и Ко добиваются.
Смерть главы эмигрант-
ской колоніи, предсѣда-
теля Эмигрантскаго Коми-
тета, К. Э. Меццера, не
разстраиваетъ эмигрантскихъ
рядовъ. За эти годы борь-
бы съ Коминтерномъ, рос-
сійская эмиграція выно-
сила и не такіе удары,
теряла не мало своихъ со-
ратниковъ и руководителей.
И всегда перестроившись,
замѣнивъ выбывшихъ изъ
строя руководителей, про-
должала свое дѣло борь-
бы.
Такъ будетъ сдѣлано и те-
перь.
И при новомъ руководи-
тельствѣ, конечно, будетъ
учтенъ опытъ прошлаго и
будутъ предприняты мѣры
къ тому, чтобы на будущее
оградить себя отъ непро-
шенныхъ «болѣльщиковъ», отъ
непрошенныхъ ходатаевъ на
русскихъ дѣлахъ въ боль-
шевистскомъ лагерѣ.
Это — давно назрѣвшая
необходимость.
То, что эта необходи-
мость не была проведена
въ жизнь до сихъ поръ, сви-
дѣтельствуетъ о большой
ошибкѣ К. Э. Мецце-
ра въ политикѣ.
page_data.zh:
不请自来的“支持者”
8月4日

“目的证明手段合理”，这是布尔什维克的基本口号。为了追求这样或那样的目标，他们今天可以说一套，明天则说与今天完全相反的话……

这就是当下令人痛心的焦点——K. E. 梅茨勒（K. E. Metzler）遇刺案。对我们而言，这是我们难民家庭中的一场沉重悲剧。它在我们的心灵深处留下了深刻的印记。

毫无疑问，这是来自那些致力于瓦解俄罗斯反共难民家庭、反对难民团结并千方百计阻碍这种团结的人对难民群体的一次打击。

K. E. 梅茨勒遇刺案是难民群体的敌人——共产国际代理人——以老练的手段对难民群体给予的重击。

之所以如此判断，至少是因为 K. E. 梅茨勒刚一变成冰冷的尸体，布尔什维克方面立即就进行了反击。

而我们对此种关系非常清楚，因为我们日复一日地阅读布尔什维克出版物针对 K. E. 梅茨勒和《旧报》（Staraya Gazeta）的攻击。《旧报》以断然的口吻为 K. E. 梅茨勒辩护，尽管它并非难民社区的报纸。

而现在，这家报纸写道，难民家庭内部正在进行激烈的斗争，“布尔什维克” allegedly（据称）杀害了 K. E. 梅茨勒……

并进一步指出：“虽然 K. E. 梅茨勒作为俄罗斯社区领袖的地位使他拥有许多思想上的敌人，但没有理由假设这些敌人采取了消灭他的措施。K. E. 梅茨勒与这些人之间的斗争纯粹具有原则性质。”

在这最后一句话中做了一个微妙的暗示。这种暗示也贯穿于有关谋杀案报道的其他地方，那里提到了“其他亚洲民族”的代表。简而言之，齐切林（Chicherin）试图“将责任从病头推卸到健康头”，像狐狸一样制造迷踪，抹去指向共产主义巢穴的痕迹，使对该案的调查偏离正确方向。

形势和上海共产国际中心命令齐切林去接触并傲慢地对待沙皇时代的难民社区。

齐切林去接触了。
齐切林甚至在头版刊登了讣告，——看，我是多么同情你们，多么理解你们……

在深切悲痛的时刻，人们会有这样一种心情，想要抓住对面那个明知不真诚的“支持者”（请读者原谅我这个布尔什维克词汇）的衣领，用力将他赶出家门……

对于我们的哀悼，齐切林绝对是个局外人。不仅如此，齐切林在事务和思想上与造成我们悲痛的罪魁祸首——共产国际——保持着联系。

在此事上，齐切林及其同伙试图制造一场巨大的挑衅。利用此事进一步扰乱难民中的反共阵营。

但这一尝试产生的结果恰恰应与齐切林及其同伙所期望的相反。

难民社区领袖、难民委员会主席 K. E. 梅茨勒之死，并不会扰乱难民的队伍。在与共产国际斗争的这些年里，俄罗斯难民承受过甚至更沉重的打击，失去过不少战友和领导人。

并且总是通过重组，替换掉离任的领导人，继续其斗争事业。

现在也将如此行事。

当然，在新的领导下，将吸取过去的经验教训，并采取措施，以便在未来保护自己免受不请自来的“支持者”、免受布尔什维克阵营中在俄罗斯事务上不请自来的说客之害。

这是一种早已成熟的必要性。

这种必要性至今未能付诸实施，证明了 K. E. 梅茨勒在政治上的重大失误。

Sir,
At 4.45 p.m. 4-8-40 a telephone message was received
at this station from Mr. V. A. Chilikin Publisher of the
Russian Daily News 616-622 Avenue Foch reporting that he
had received two telephone calls this inst, threats being
made against his life.
The undersigned and C.D.S. 192 proceeded to the scene
and made the following enquiries. The two telephone calls
were sent through to the office of the Russian Daily News
at 10 a.m. and 3 p.m. 4-8-40 respectively. The senders,
a different person on the second occasion, abused Mr.
Chilikin in Russian, and threatened that they would take
his life some time. Considerable acrimony is known to
exist between Mr. Chilikin's paper and the Far Eastern
Times edited by a 'T. Kuroki, Japanese. The Far Eastern
Times went as far as to publish an article on 3-8-40
accusing Chilikin of being concerned in the assassination
of Mr. Metzler on 2-8-40. Mr. Chilikin maintains that the
reason for the attacks on his newspaper made by the Far
Eastern Times is the pro S.M.C. policy adopted by the
former's paper, and that the telephone calls this inst.
have been no doubt sent by some disgruntled Russian employ
ees of the Far Eastern Times. A C.P.C. has been detailed
for duty outside the main entrance to the Russian Daily
News, for the time being. Mr. Chilikin is making arrange-
ments with the landlord owning this block of houses, for
Chilikin's Russian watchman to be on duty at the alleyway
entrance leading to the rear of the premises from 6 p.m.
so that only bona fide tenants would be allowed through
the gates

"NOVOSTI DNIA", August 4, 1940.

Убийцы К. Э. Мецлера наняли автомобиль в Хонкью
- сообщает полиция.
Гараж принадлежит корейцу.

Со вчерашнего дня рас следование об убийстве Мец лера перешло в ведение де тективам угрозыска при глав ном штабе полиции Сеттль мента.
Как вчера сообщила по лиция, автомобиль, на кото ром приехали убийцы и на котором они скрылись, был нанят в гараже на одной из улиц Хонкью. Этот гараж принадлежит корейцу.
Таким образом полиция Сеттльмента считает, что убийцы и его сообщники приехали и скрылись в се верной части города, по «ту сторону» канала.
Одновременно детективы продолжают расследование о китайце, арестованном у вхо да в Эмигрантский Комитет на Мультмейн род.
Китаец до вчерашнего ве чера продолжал хранить пол ное молчание, отказываясь что либо сообщить о себе и о тех лицах, для кого он сделал за Комитетом.
Одновременно полиция взяла на подозрение одно лицо, дежурившее около квартиры К. Э. Мецлера на Наньян род в утро совер шенного убийства. Однако полиция пока что не аресто вывает это лицо, продолжая свои наблюдения за ним и за лицами, с которыми оно соприкасается. Полиция вче ра отказалась сообщить ка кие либо сведения о подозре ваемом и даже не сообща ет, к какой национальности он принадлежит.
Ничего не сообщает по лиция и о результатах экс пертизы, произведенной экс пертами баллистического от дела полиции в отношении пуль, извлеченных из тела К. Э. Мецлера.
Вчера утром секретарь Эмигрантского Комитета М. Г. Яковкин нанес визит лорд мэру ШСМ Фу Сюэ-чню, в связи с убийством К. Э. Мец лера — но никаких сообще ний относительно этого ви зита до вечера сделано не было.
ТРЕВОГА В ЭМИГРАНТ СКИХ КРУГАХ.
В местных эмигрантских кругах некоторое волнение вызвали слова представителя японского Посольства Кен Цуруми, который позавчера на пресс-конференции зая вил, что отныне «все дела по выдаче документов, виз и паспортов» власти будут вести с новым «Обществом Российских Эмигрантов».
Самым Кен Цуруми ясно дал понять, что после смерти К. Э. Мецлера японские власти намерены дать свое признание не Русскому Эмигрантскому Комитету, а новому Обществу, которое было создано после примера Харбинского БРЭМ (1) и открытие которого было сильно opponировано покойным Mr. Metzler.

Translation of an extract

"A certain amount of excitement has been caused in local emigrant circles by the statement of Mr. Ken Tsurumi, representative of the Japanese Embassy, who during the course of a press conference held the day before yesterday said that henceforward the authorities will communicate with the newly formed "Association of Russian Emigrants" in "all affairs relating to the issuing of documents, visas and passports".

By these words Mr. Tsurumi has clearly given to understand that following the death of Mr. Ch. E. Metzler the Japanese authorities intend to grant their recognition not to the Russian Emigrants Committee, but to the new Association which was formed after the example of the Harbin BRÉM (1) and the inauguration of which was strongly opposed by the late Mr. Metzler."

Translator's note: BRÉM - Bureau for Russian Emigrants Affairs.

G. Prokopiev
D. S. I.

“NOVOSTI DNIA”（《今日新闻》），1940年8月4日。

警方通报：K. E. 梅茨勒的凶手在虹口租用了一辆汽车。
车库属于一名朝鲜人。

自昨日起，梅茨勒谋杀案的调查已移交至公共租界警察总局刑事侦缉处侦探负责。
据警方昨日通报，凶手乘坐并用于逃逸的汽车是在虹口某条街道的一家车库租用的。该车库归一名朝鲜人所有。
因此，公共租界警方认为，凶手及其同伙是从城市的北部，即运河“对岸”来到此处并逃逸的。
与此同时，侦探们继续调查在多伦路（Multmain Rd.）移民委员会入口处逮捕的一名中国人。
直到昨晚，该中国人一直保持完全沉默，拒绝透露关于他自己以及他代表委员会接触的那些人的任何信息。
同时，警方怀疑在谋杀案发生当天早晨在南洋路（Nanyang Rd.）K. E. 梅茨勒公寓附近值守的一个人。然而，警方目前尚未逮捕此人，而是继续对他以及与他接触的人员进行监视。警方昨天拒绝透露关于嫌疑人的任何信息，甚至未说明其国籍。
警方也未通报警察总局弹道科专家对从 K. E. 梅茨勒体内取出的子弹进行的鉴定结果。
昨天上午，移民委员会秘书 M. G. Yakovkin 因 K. E. 梅茨勒被杀一事拜访了上海公共租界工部局总董傅筱庵，但截至晚上并未发布关于此次访问的任何消息。

Ken Tsurumi 清楚地表明，在 K. E. 梅茨勒死后，日本当局打算承认的不是俄罗斯移民委员会，而是这个新成立的协会；该协会是效仿哈尔滨的 BRÉM (1) 建立的，其成立曾遭到已故的梅茨勒先生的强烈反对。

“日本大使馆代表 Ken Tsurumi 先生在前天举行的新闻发布会上表示，今后当局将在‘所有涉及签发文件、签证和护照的事务’与新成立的‘俄罗斯移民协会’进行沟通，这在当地移民圈中引起了一定程度的震动。

Translation of articles which appeared in Japanese sponsored
Russian newspaper "Far Eastern Times" on 4.8.40. Edited
and published by Mr. K. Kuroki, 409 East Seward Road.

1. Article entitled "CHILIKIN AND HIS GANG - IN SERVICE
OF RED TERROR" - the "Novosti Dnia" threw true light
on assassination of Ch. E. Metzler - Criminal inciting
of one part of population against another - Authorities
should pay their attention to this nest of agents of
Comintern.

If on the day of the dastard assassination of Mr. Ch. E.
Metzler, Chairman of the Russian Emigrants' Committee, the true
motive of this terrorist act could be doubted by anybody, yester-
day's issue of the Soviet paper "Novosti Dnia" has dispelled all
doubts.

The "Novosti Dnia", by applying a series of petty
dishonest tricks, misrepresentations, and hints has in black on
white corroborated in an eloquent manner that Mr. Metzler's
assassination is a deed of their new masters - agents of the
Comintern so successfully operating in Shanghai.

This, in the first place, is apparent from the
awkward attempts to concoct a version, dictated by their red
masters, regarding the alleged organization of the assassination
"somewhere" on the other side of the creek, merely mentioning
that information to this effect has been obtained "from well
informed private circles".

We, as well as the majority of Russian residents in
Shanghai, know perfectly well these "well informed private sources";
although we cannot avail ourselves of these sources as freely as
the lads from Chilikin's gang.

These criminal "sources" have organized and carried
out the assassination of Mr. Ch. E. Metzler and now continue their
dastard provocative activities through the medium of Chilikin
whom they have bought over lock, stock and barrel.

The assassination was planned with a view to bringing
discord within the emigrant community, and now the same agents
of the Comintern hope to profit considerably from this crime

1940年8月4日在日本资助的俄罗斯报纸《远东时报》上刊登的文章译文。由 K. Kuroki 先生编辑和出版，地址：西华德路东段409号。

1. 标题为“奇利金及其团伙——服务于红色恐怖”的文章——《今日新闻》揭示了 Ch. E. 梅茨勒遇刺案的真相——煽动一部分人口反对另一部分的犯罪行为——当局应关注这个共产国际代理人巢穴。

如果在俄罗斯移民委员会主席 Ch. E. 梅茨勒先生遭到卑鄙暗杀的那天，任何人还可能怀疑这一恐怖行为的真正动机，那么昨天的苏维埃报纸《今日新闻》已经消除了所有疑虑。

《今日新闻》通过一系列卑鄙的欺骗手段、歪曲和暗示，白纸黑字地雄辩地证实，梅茨勒先生的遇刺是其新主人——在上海成功活动的共产国际代理人的所作所为。

首先，这从他们笨拙地编造由其红色主人授意的版本中显而易见，该版本声称暗杀是在小溪“对岸”的“某处”组织的，仅提及此类信息是从“消息灵通的私人圈子”获得的。

我们以及上海大多数俄罗斯居民都非常清楚这些“消息灵通的私人来源”；尽管我们不能像奇利金团伙的那些家伙那样自由利用这些来源。

这些犯罪“来源”组织并实施了 Ch. E. 梅茨勒先生的暗杀，现在继续通过他们已彻底收买的奇利金进行卑鄙的挑衅活动。

策划这次暗杀是为了在移民社区内部制造不和，现在同样的共产国际代理人希望从这一罪行中获利颇丰

by utilising the obedient hired scribes in the "Novosti Dnia".

To start with, a story has been invented regarding
a motor car alleged to have arrived to Mr. Metzler's house
several days ago, in which "apart from two Chinese and two
representatives of an Asiatic race, there was a foreigner".

The bad disservice rendered to his masters by Chilikin
by involving "two representatives of an Asiatic race" in this
episode is quite apparent, as anyone who is even superficially
familiar with the methods of work" of the Comintern agents, knows
that there are large cadres of subordinate agents at their
disposal, comprised of representatives of all known Asiatic races.

Thus, even supposing that the said episode is likely
to have taken place, it does not in any way change the main point
of this affair - the organization of the assassination by agents
of the Comintern.

Furthermore, in an article under the provocative
headline "Competitors", a stupid and inexperienced scribe from
Chilikin's gang has made a mess of intrigues around Mr. Metzler
and the Emigrants' Committee, originated by the very same bosses
of the "Novosti Dnia", the formation of Association of Russian
Emigrants, the newspaper "Far Eastern Times" and the series of
articles which is being published in this paper regarding the
history of representation of the Russian community in Shanghai.

It is precisely this part of yesterday's "Novosti Dnia"
that was intended to "honestly" carry out the task entrusted to
this paper and to make the finest possible use of Mr. Metzler's
assassination.

However awkwardly has this task been carried out,
it has to a certain extent reached its goal : the communists
have succeeded in having publicly carried out one of their basic
tasks, namely, - to incite, wherever possible, one part of the
population against another.

通过利用《今日新闻》（Novosti Dnia）中那些听话的受雇文人。

首先，编造了一个故事，称几天前有一辆汽车抵达梅茨勒（Metzler）先生寓所，车内“除两名中国人和两名亚洲种族代表外，还有一名外国人”。

奇利金（Chilikin）在此事件中牵涉“两名亚洲种族代表”，从而对其主子帮了倒忙，这一点显而易见，因为任何对共产国际代理人工作手段稍有了解的人都知道，他们手下拥有庞大的下级代理人队伍，由所有已知的亚洲种族代表组成。

因此，即使假设上述事件确实可能发生，这也丝毫不会改变此事的主要要点——即由共产国际代理人组织的暗杀行动。

此外，在一篇题为《竞争者》的挑衅性标题文章中，奇利金团伙中一名愚蠢且缺乏经验的文人对围绕梅茨勒先生和移民委员会的阴谋活动搞得一团糟，而这些阴谋正是由《今日新闻》的同一批老板发起的，包括俄罗斯移民协会的形成、《远东时报》（Far Eastern Times）以及该报正在连载的关于上海俄罗斯社区代表权历史的一系列文章。

恰恰是昨天《今日新闻》的这一部分，旨在“诚实地”执行赋予该报的任务，并尽可能充分地利用梅茨勒先生被暗杀一事。

尽管这项任务执行得笨拙不堪，但在一定程度上达到了其目标：共产党人成功地公开执行了他们的一项基本任务，即——在可能的地方，煽动一部分居民反对另一部分居民。

On account of his stupidity Chilikin's youthful
assistant included in his mess the exact address of the
institution to which the attention of people affected by the
communist propaganda should be directed.

Leaving aside, for the time being, all the lies and
misrepresentations regarding our newspaper, we strongly and
emphatically protest against the impudent and unscrupulous
outburst of the "Novosti Dnia".

Chilikin, his gang and their common masters hope in
vain that the situation in the International Settlement will
enable them not only to carry out terrorist acts with impunity,
but also to continue in peace "good work" despite any revelations.

Inciting of one part of the population against another
in an act punishable by laws of any country, and we shall insist
that Chilikin's provocative outburst, however well it has been
paid for, be nipped in the bud.

The Consular Body have just adopted the decision
regarding suppression of terrorism of any kind by every means.
To-day's criminal outburst of the "Novosti Dnia" render that
paper as direct associate in the present terrorist acts and
the authorities must in good time call the hired agents-
provocateurs to order.

Fully sharing the viewpoint of the Consular Body and
all administrative authorities regarding the necessity of
suppressing terror we, on our part, will render every assistance
within our power to the measures adopted by them.

In particular, having taken note of the recent
criminal outburst of Chilikin's "Novosti Dnia", we warn this
paper and its genuine and fictitious proprietors, that the "Far
Eastern Times" will not leave without attention a smallest
detail of their "work" of facilitating and developing terrorism
and will struggle against this in a most energetic manner and
by every means at our disposal.

由于愚蠢，奇利金的年轻助手在他的混乱叙述中列出了确切的地址，指出受共产主义宣传影响的人们应将注意力转向该机构。

暂且不论关于我们报纸的所有谎言和歪曲报道，我们强烈且坚决地抗议《今日新闻》这种厚颜无耻且肆无忌惮的爆发。

奇利金、他的团伙及其共同的主子徒劳地希望，公共租界的局势不仅能让他们逍遥法外地实施恐怖行为，还能让他们在任何揭露面前继续平静地进行“良好工作”。

煽动一部分居民反对另一部分居民的行为在任何国家的法律中都是应受惩罚的，我们将坚持要求将奇利金的挑衅性言论，无论其报酬多么丰厚，都扼杀在萌芽状态。

领事团刚刚通过了一项决议，决定采取一切手段镇压任何形式的恐怖主义。今天《今日新闻》的犯罪性言论使该报成为当前恐怖行为的直接同伙，当局必须及时命令这些受雇的挑衅代理人守规矩。

我们完全赞同领事团及所有行政当局关于镇压恐怖主义必要性的观点，我们将尽己所能，为他们所采取的措施提供一切协助。

特别是，鉴于奇利金的《今日新闻》最近的犯罪性言论，我们警告该报及其真实和名义上的所有者，《远东时报》绝不会忽视他们助长和发展恐怖主义的“工作”中的任何细微细节，并将以我们所能支配的一切手段，最有力地对此进行斗争。

2. Article entitled "Unwanted mourners"
Stressing the point that the assassination of
Mr. Ch. E. Metzler has carried out on instructions of the
Comintern, the article takes note of a sudden change in the
attitude of the "Novosti Dnia" towards the late Ch. E. Metzler,

文章强调查尔斯·E·梅茨勒（Ch. E. Metzler）先生的暗杀是奉共产国际指令执行的，并注意到《今日新闻》对已故的查尔斯·E·梅茨勒的态度突然转变，众所周知，梅茨勒一直是该报含沙射影攻击的目标。据称，奇利金已接到共产国际代理人的指示，要扮演哀悼者的角色，并就此次罪行向俄罗斯移民社区表示同情，但这种态度的急剧转变骗不了任何俄罗斯移民。奇利金与他们的哀悼毫无关系。

CHINA PRESS
JUL 3 1 1940

“I Am Owner”
Editor Denies
Soviets Buy
Russian Daily

Denial that the Russian Daily
News has been sold to Soviet
interests, as intimated in a com-
peting “White” Russian news-
paper here, was made to THE
CHINA PRESS yesterday by Mr.
Vassili Chilikin, editor and
publisher of the daily.
“I am the sole owner of the
Russian Daily News,” he declared.
Mr. Chilikin said it was “stupid”
to report that his newspaper has
been bought by the Soviets because
it had adopted the new orthography
that came into use in Russia after
the revolution.
The “White” Russian newspaper
report stated that persistent rumors
of an impending Soviet purchase of
the Russian Daily News seemed to
have been corroborated when the
newspaper introduced the new ortho-
graphy in its Sunday issue, and
filled several pages with pictures of
the Red Fleet.
page_data.zh:
CHINA PRESS
1940年7月31日

“我是所有者”
编辑否认
苏联人购买
俄文日报

《每日俄文新闻》（Russian Daily News）编辑兼出版人瓦西里·奇利金（Vassili Chilikin）先生昨日向《字林西报》（THE CHINA PRESS）否认了该报已被出售给苏联利益集团的说法，此前本地一家竞争性“白俄”报纸曾暗示此事。
“我是《每日俄文新闻》的唯一所有者，”他宣称。
奇利金先生称，报道他的报纸被苏联人购买是“愚蠢的”，理由是该报采用了革命后在俄罗斯开始使用的新正字法。
那家“白俄”报纸的报道指出，当《每日俄文新闻》在其周日版中引入新正字法，并用数页篇幅刊登红海军照片时，关于苏联即将收购该报的持续谣言似乎得到了证实。

Translation of an article which appeared in Russian news-
paper "NOVOSTI DNIA" on 29-7-40. Publisher - Mr/ V.A.
Chiliatin, 620 Avenue Foch. Editor - Mr. A.I. Veiss.

WE WON'T PAY TAXES
until conditions of our life have been improved.

Foreign residents of Lane 609 East Seward Road de-
cided not to pay municipal taxes until they have proper
police protection and until sanitary conditions in the vi-
cinity have been improved.

- We live in horrible conditions, said one of the
residents.

Almost every night beggars die in our alleyway.
The Police do not show themselves in our district
and recently I was robbed twice.

Sanitary carts appear irregularly and never appear
during periods of rain.

All our protests at the Police station of the dis-
trict have so far been without any result.

We will not pay a cent in taxes until the above
conditions have been improved, stated the resident of the
alleyway.

（手写签名及印章部分字迹模糊，无法准确辨识）
page_data.zh:
1940年7月29日俄文报纸《今日新闻》刊登文章的译文。出版人——V.A. 奇利亚廷（Chiliatin）先生，福煦路620号。编辑——A.I. 韦斯（Veiss）先生。

我们不缴税
直到我们的生活条件得到改善。

东瑟华德路609弄的外国居民决定，在获得适当的警察保护以及附近卫生状况得到改善之前，不缴纳市政税。

“我们生活在糟糕的环境中，”一位居民说。

几乎每晚都有乞丐死在我们的小巷里。
警察不在我们辖区露面，最近我被抢劫了两次。

环卫车出现没有规律，而且在雨季期间从不出现。

我们在该区警察局提出的所有抗议迄今均未取得任何结果。

在上述条件得到改善之前，我们不会缴纳一分钱的税款，这位小巷居民表示。
